title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The initial capacity of 800 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The active material titanium disulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and carboxymethyl cellulose in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of titanium disulfide. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 4 mg/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing titanium disulfide with ketjen black; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the titanium disulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Argyrodite sulfide ion-conductive solid with mixed bromine-iodine substitution and production method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite phosphosulfide having the composition Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x) and to an all-solid-state battery comprising the same. A mixed-halogen argyrodite phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 520 degrees C. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiBr to the argyrodite phase is 0.1, and the room-temperature conductivity is 3.5 mS/cm. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. Specific examples are Li7P3S11 and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein 0.2 <= x <= 0.65.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The 1.0 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 90% of its capacity after 500 cycles. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising fluoroethylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1. The UV-crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 1.0 mS/cm. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm are obtained. The membrane of 30 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyethylene oxide and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The polyethylene oxide electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of polyethylene oxide and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 30 micrometers or less.

title: Silicon-substituted sulfide ion-conductive solid with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation
abstract: Described is a moisture-resistant sulfide in which the soft acid silicon binds the sulfur and reduces reaction with water vapor. The water uptake at 10% relative humidity is 0.5 wt% and the conductivity is 3.2 mS/cm. Suitable compositions include Li7P3S11. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. The silicon substitution amount is 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. The negative electrode may be metallic lithium with a fluorinated protective layer. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li7P3S11 material. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. Because H2S generation is reduced, the safety of the manufacturing process and the ionic conductivity are improved.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a silicon substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by cold isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The lithium battery is operated at 80 degrees C under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor powder
abstract: A solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor powder from a suspension in an organic solvent is provided. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. An all-solid-state battery comprising the LLZO material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). Heat treatment at 450 degrees C after drying at 180 degrees C gives a conductivity of 1 mS/cm or more. The reaction is performed in a stirred reactor having a volume of 10 L or more, and the precipitate is washed with fresh solvent. Dissolution and precipitation give a homogeneous composition and improved grain boundary resistance and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 2.5 wt% to 10 wt%.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor with a residual solvent content of 0.3 wt% or less. The reaction at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C for 24 hours gives a precipitate yield of 95% or more. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure. The reaction is performed in a stirred reactor having a volume of 10 L or more, and the precipitate is washed with fresh solvent. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. The disclosure is applicable to Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and beta-Li3PS4. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in an all-solid-state battery. The liquid-phase route yields fine particles with a narrow size distribution and improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 3.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate dissolved in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate and lithium difluorophosphate as an additive in an amount of 3 wt%. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The cell charged to 4.4 V retains 85% of its capacity after 300 cycles. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 3 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 300 cycles is 85% with the electrolyte. The 1.5 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 3 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The stack shows stable operation over 200 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 650 to 800 degrees C. The gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The gadolinium-doped ceria solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 10 micrometers. A power density of 0.8 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Densified garnet oxide solid electrolyte and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A sintered garnet pellet with a relative density of 97% and a method of hot pressing the same are described. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li2ZrO3, LLZO, and LLTO material. The dopant tungsten occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.15 to 0.5, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. The solid electrolyte is preferably lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. An argyrodite phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. When v is 0.3, the cubic phase fraction is 97% or more and the conductivity is 1 mS/cm. The cell may include a lithium nucleation additive to prevent short circuit. A lithium battery using the garnet sintered body as a separator shows improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)W(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.15 <= v <= 0.5.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 20 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate based electrolyte of 20 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C. The titania nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 20 micrometers or less.

title: Iodine-substituted argyrodite ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor for an all-solid-state battery has an argyrodite crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x). A mixed-halogen argyrodite phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 520 degrees C. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. The LGPS and Li6PS5Cl material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The ion-conductive component may be Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The ceramic ion conductor powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. The argyrodite phase has a cubic lattice and a conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C measured by AC impedance on a pressed pellet. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. Compared with Li6PS5Cl, the iodine-substituted argyrodite shows a higher conductivity and better moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.075 or less, and wherein 0.1 <= x <= 0.55.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. A lithium battery pack comprising 4 modules of the stacked cells is also described. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNbO3 shell with high coverage and lithium battery
abstract: Described is a cathode particle coated with a nanometer-thick LiNbO3 shell that lowers the interfacial resistance. In an embodiment the material is lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. The coated active material shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 100 cycles with a sulfide ion-conductive solid. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The sulfide component may be prepared by a liquid-phase route in tetrahydrofuran or acetonitrile. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ion-conductive solid particles during pressing. Because the shell is amorphous and continuous, the growth of interfacial resistance is reduced and the electrochemical window is improved.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 75% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 30% or more.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide dissolved in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate and 1,3-propane sultone as an additive in an amount of 3 wt%. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. The stable passivation film formed by 1,3-propane sultone suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at 1.2 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.3 V. The cell retains 88% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive 1,3-propane sultone decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The additive 1,3-propane sultone forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M and 1,3-propane sultone as an additive.

title: Surface mount solid electrolytic capacitor and method of reducing leakage current
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. A capacitance of 47 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the tantalum anode. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 15 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of tantalum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) doped with polystyrene sulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 15 milliohms or less.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 600 to 750 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 5 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The solid electrolyte layer of samarium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 5 micrometers. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 600 to 750 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C. A power density of 1.5 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 600 to 750 degrees C operating range.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising samarium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid resistant to hydrolysis under humid air and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and to a method of handling it in a dry room. The silicon substitution amount is 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ion-conductive solid layer of the all-solid-state battery. The powder is formed into a sheet by kneading with a fibrillated PTFE binder and roll-pressing without a solvent to a thickness of 30 micrometers to 80 micrometers. The silicon content of 4 mol% to 16 mol% suppresses H2S generation to 20 cm3/g or less while the conductivity remains 0.7 mS/cm or more. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li6PS5Cl material. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The ion-conductive solid is a lithium ion conducting material for an all-solid-state battery. Because H2S generation is reduced, the safety of the manufacturing process and the ionic conductivity are improved.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 6 hours is 60% or more.

title: Li2O-containing vitreous sulfide ion-conductive solid and heat treatment method
abstract: A glassy sulfide ion-conductive solid with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ion-conductive solid particles during pressing. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 12 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 50% to 85% by X-ray diffraction. A solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The ion-conductive solid shows improved cycle life and ionic conductivity compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 50% to 85%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more during cycling is described. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a nickel-plated copper current collector is also provided. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene; a lithium salt comprising lithium perchlorate; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 60 degrees C.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more during cycling is described. The structure with the copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The uniaxial pressing step at 200 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. A lithium battery pack comprising 16 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

assignee_raw: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Tantalum-doped garnet solid electrolyte sintered body with high relative density
abstract: A garnet solid electrolyte sintered body having an average grain size of 8 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. The grain size is 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers and the relative density is 93% or more after sintering at 1170 degrees C to 1320 degrees C. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the solid electrolyte in the solid-state lithium battery. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1170 degrees C to 1320 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. A sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. Because lithium volatilization is suppressed, the cubic phase is retained and the sinterability is improved.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a sintering temperature of 1170 degrees C to 1320 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 93% or more.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises nickel sulfide impregnated in graphene and a carbon coating on the composite. The active material nickel sulfide is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1000 mAh/g and retains 85% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the nickel sulfide cathode. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the nickel sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 85%. The nickel sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with graphene by ball milling.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising nickel sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with p-toluenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 15 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The capacitor rated at 10 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The equivalent series resistance is 15 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of niobium; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) doped with p-toluenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 15 milliohms or less.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 50 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The lithium battery is operated at 80 degrees C under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The warm isostatic pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 16 cells and a case is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li2WO4 shell with high coverage
abstract: A positive electrode active material having a coating layer with a coverage of 90% or more and an average thickness of 6 nm to 30 nm is provided. Nickel accounts for 80 mol% of the transition metals, and the heat treatment is performed at 400 degrees C. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. Examples of the ion conductor include lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and Li3InCl6. The precursor may be precipitated from ethyl acetate and dried before use. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 280 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 75% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.5 nm to 75 nm.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite cell. The solid electrolyte of lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite is a dense ceramic of 96% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The stack shows stable operation over 50 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 600 to 750 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 90% of its capacity after 300 cycles. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The 1.5 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 2 wt%.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass ion-conductive solid containing a thio-LISICON phase
abstract: This disclosure concerns a Li2S-P2S5 glass of 75:25 composition that is converted by quenching and reheating into a crystallized conductor. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. An all-solid-state lithium battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. After heat treatment at 320 degrees C for 3 hours, the conductivity rises from 0.2 mS/cm for the glass to 4 mS/cm. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li7P3S11, argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4. The glassy matrix absorbs volume change of the electrode and improves the ionic conductivity of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 40% to 75%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNb(1-z)TazO3 shell with high coverage and lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium niobium tantalum oxide formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. Suitable compositions include lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), Li3InCl6, argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and lithium fluoride (LiF). The core particles have a median diameter D50 of 1 micrometers and nickel content of 60 mol% or more. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 60 mol% or more of the transition metals. A hexachloride of yttrium or indium may serve as the catholyte. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. A halide phase of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type having a trigonal or monoclinic structure is also formed, and its composition is adjusted by yttrium or indium substitution. The Li2ZrO3, Li3InCl6, Li6PS5Cl, and LiF material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. The lithium niobium tantalum oxide shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 50% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 60 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.2 nm to 6 nm.

title: Method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: Provided is a method in which a solvate complex of Li3PS4 is precipitated from 1,2-dimethoxyethane, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated. The solid electrolyte obtained by the method has an ionic conductivity of 4.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a residual solvent content of 1 wt%. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The dissolution of P2S5 in the solvent is followed by precipitation of a complex that contains one to three solvent molecules per formula unit. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. Specific examples are Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and beta-Li3PS4. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte. Dissolution and precipitation give a homogeneous composition and improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C, and wherein the reaction temperature is 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a stainless steel current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The uniaxial pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The structure with the stainless steel current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 4 stacked cells. A solid electrolyte sheet of 20 micrometers is used as the separator.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 4 stacked cells
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 300 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The laminate of 4 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 25 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 16 stacked cells. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 10 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. A 10 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 700 to 850 degrees C. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 700 to 850 degrees C operating range. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 700 to 850 degrees C. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 85%. The capacity retention after 100 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 85% of its capacity after 100 cycles is also described. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the titanium disulfide cathode. The cathode with a loading of 4 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. In an embodiment the cathode is pressed against a sulfide solid electrolyte layer instead of a separator. Polysulfide dissolution from the titanium disulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising titanium disulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Electrochemical gas sensor with a gadolinium-doped ceria solid electrolyte for detecting hydrogen
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting hydrogen comprises a gadolinium-doped ceria ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising platinum, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 500 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. The sensor operating at 500 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for hydrogen. The multilayer structure with the gadolinium-doped ceria ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The sensor shows a response time of 2 seconds to a step change of hydrogen concentration at 500 degrees C. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising platinum, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of hydrogen.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite cell. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 500 to 650 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide solid electrolyte powder
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte with a residual solvent content of 1 wt% or less. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure. The ion-conductive component may be argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11. The cubic argyrodite-type structure tolerates chlorine and bromine on the 4a and 4d sites. The reaction at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C for 24 hours gives a precipitate yield of 95% or more. The Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte. The wet-chemical process is suitable for coating an active material and improves the sinterability and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 2.9 mS/cm or more, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C, and wherein the reaction temperature is 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. A lithium battery pack comprising 16 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 3 micrometers. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 3 micrometers and a relative density of 97%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 700 to 850 degrees C. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The reversible cell with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Niobium-doped garnet ion-conductive solid sintered body with high relative density for lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sintering method for a garnet ion-conductive solid using a mother powder cover and a lithium excess of 5 mol%. An oxide stable up to 5 V versus Li/Li+ can be used on the positive electrode side. A pellet of 500 micrometers thickness sintered at 1250 degrees C shows a conductivity of 0.6 mS/cm and a relative density of 95%. The LLZO, LATP, and Li2ZrO3 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The negative electrode may be metallic lithium with a fluorinated protective layer. Sintering is performed at 1250 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. The method gives reproducible densification and improved high-voltage stability and sinterability at a lower cost.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.01 <= v <= 0.7, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an average grain size of 0.5 micrometers to 30 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 0 mol% to 20 mol%.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 500 to 650 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 10 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer of scandia-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the scandia-stabilized zirconia cell.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 10 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a sulfur cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%. The positive electrode mixture comprises the sulfide active material, a sulfide solid electrolyte of Li6PS5Cl in an amount of 20 wt% to 40 wt%, and carbon, for use in an all-solid-state lithium-sulfur battery. The cathode with a loading of 2 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyvinylidene fluoride. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided. A separator coated with carbon nanotubes traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. With a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising sulfur and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The combination of fluoroethylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. With 2 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M and fluoroethylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and succinonitrile as a plasticizer. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The membrane further contains a ceramic filler of Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet in an amount of 10 wt% to 30 wt% to form a composite electrolyte. The anion is covalently bonded to the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. The niobium anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 20 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the niobium anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with p-toluenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. A capacitance of 100 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles doped with p-toluenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide dissolved in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive in an amount of 1 wt%. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The 1.0 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 1 wt%.

title: Ceramic ion conductor slurry with controlled viscosity and solid content for doctor blade casting
abstract: Disclosed is a wet coating method in which a slurry of a ceramic ion conductor is cast on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. The wet film is dried at 80 degrees C and the dried layer has a thickness of 6 micrometers to 30 micrometers. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. The solvent has a donor number of 10 or less so that the ceramic ion conductor does not react with the solvent during slurry processing. The dried layer shows an ionic conductivity of 1.3 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a thickness of 15 micrometers. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. The slurry allows roll-to-roll production of the layer and improves the sheet formability of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising anisole in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 60 degrees C to 100 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 1.3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the slurry has a binder content of 0.8 wt% to 4 wt%.

title: Mixed-halide ceramic ion conductor of erbium and hafnium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a halide ceramic ion conductor in which hafnium is substituted for part of the erbium in a lithium erbium chloride framework. Ball milling of the raw materials for the LiF material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. In the monoclinic structure, erbium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites of the close-packed chloride sublattice, and the cation disorder is 10% or more. The disclosure is applicable to lithium fluoride (LiF). A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. In an embodiment the ceramic ion conductor layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. In an all-solid-state battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the moisture stability. The oxidation stability limit is 4.1 V or more and the conductivity is 0.84 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C. The hafnium substitution lowers the raw material cost of the rare earth halide and improves the moisture stability and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which erbium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0.02 <= z <= 0.25, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 300 degrees C, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.1 V or more.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a stainless steel current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a stainless steel current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The lithium battery is operated at 60 degrees C under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a iron sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyacrylic acid in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 3 mg/cm2. The iron sulfide is melt-diffused into graphene at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The initial capacity of 600 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%. The composite shows a capacity of 600 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising graphene; iron sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with alumina nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V.
