A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 85 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 100 degrees C to 280 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 300 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 0.9 mS/cm or more, and wherein the reaction temperature is 0 degrees C to 85 degrees C, and wherein the residual solvent content is 1.5 wt% or less.

title: Lithium tantalate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous LiTaO3 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 85%. A dendrite-suppressing additive such as magnesium or zinc may be placed at the lithium metal interface. The disclosure is applicable to Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and beta-Li3PS4. A coverage of 85% and a thickness of 3 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 60%. The coated particles are heat-treated at 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. The Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and Li3PS4 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved electrochemical window and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 80% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.2 nm to 6 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C.

title: semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator. The polymer matrix is polyacrylonitrile and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polyacrylonitrile based electrolyte of 20 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The membrane further contains a ceramic filler of Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet in an amount of 10 wt% to 30 wt% to form a composite electrolyte. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, succinonitrile, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 8:1.

title: Lithium tungstate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and lithium battery
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous Li2WO4 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 75 mol% or more of the transition metals. The Li2ZrO3, Li6PS5Cl, and Li3InCl6 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. A coverage of 90% and a thickness of 3 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 30%. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the high-voltage stability and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 75 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.2 nm to 6 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by roll pressing
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and polytetrafluoroethylene are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 500 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a aluminum current collector is also provided. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by roll pressing and the release film is peeled. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Lithium fluoride protective layer for lithium metal negative electrode and lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a bilayer protective layer that suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments into a ceramic ion conductor layer and stabilizes the interface with metallic lithium. A lithium metal anode can be used as the negative electrode because the reduction stability of the ceramic ion conductor is improved. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. The raw materials of the ceramic ion conductor are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. The LiF layer is amorphous and in direct contact with the metallic lithium, and the polymer layer faces the ceramic ion conductor. The all-solid-state lithium battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer. A dry process is preferred for forming the ceramic ion conductor sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. The inorganic layer has a thickness of 100 nm and the polymer layer has a thickness of 1 micrometers, giving an average Coulombic efficiency of 99.2% over 100 cycles. The inorganic layer is formed by sputtering to a thickness of 40 nm to 200 nm and has an ionic conductivity of 1 x 10^-5 S/cm or more at 25 degrees C. The suppression of filament penetration results in a longer cycle life and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 40 nm to 200 nm, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 98.5% or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.5 micrometers to 3 micrometers.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia with a thickness of 5 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. The cell can be operated at 700 to 850 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 700 to 850 degrees C.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The lithium battery is operated at 25 degrees C under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises nickel sulfide impregnated in porous carbon and a carbon coating on the composite. The initial capacity of 600 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The nickel sulfide is melt-diffused into porous carbon at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. A lithium-sulfur battery with the nickel sulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 600 mAh/g and retains 90% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. The nickel sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with porous carbon by ball milling.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing nickel sulfide with porous carbon; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the nickel sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate dissolved in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive in an amount of 3 wt%. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The 1.2 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 500 cycles is 92% with the electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 3 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Hafnium-substituted Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO ceramic ion conductor stable above 5 V and lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a high-voltage stable oxide ion conductor based on Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO and a method for forming its oxidation-resistant surface. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. A solid-state lithium battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved grain boundary resistance. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ceramic ion conductor layer of the solid-state lithium battery. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the hafnium substitution and the surface region. The oxide particles have a core of the Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase and a shell of 5 nm to 50 nm enriched in hafnium. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The anodic decomposition product layer after 100 cycles is 10 nm or less and the capacity retention is 88%. The suppression of anodic decomposition results in a stable interface and improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.35 mS/cm or more.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by cold isostatic pressing
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 8 cells and a case is also provided. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Potentiometric ammonia sensor having an auxiliary electrode of lithium carbonate
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting ammonia comprises a yttria-stabilized zirconia ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the lanthanum strontium manganite sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The sensor detects ammonia with high selectivity and a response time of 2 seconds. The sensor operating at 400 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for ammonia. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for nitrogen oxide with improved response time
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid state electrochemical sensor element with a built-in heater that keeps the ceramic at 300 degrees C. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 300 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the yttria-stabilized zirconia ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 300 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. The sensor shows a response time of 20 seconds to a step change of nitrogen oxide concentration at 300 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising sodium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects nitrogen oxide.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and production method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a sulfide ion-conductive solid obtained by controlled crystallization of an amorphous Li2S-P2S5-P2O5 glass. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 260 degrees C. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. The ion-conductive component may be beta-Li3PS4 and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 20 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 30% to 65% by X-ray diffraction. The Li3PS4 and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or thio-LISICON phase precipitates uniformly. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ion-conductive solid in the lithium secondary battery. Because the crystal phase is precipitated inside the glass, the grain boundary resistance is small and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours, and wherein the content of P2O5 is 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 16 cells and a case is also provided. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The solid electrolyte layer of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 10 micrometers and a relative density of 95%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 200 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Mixed-halide ion-conductive solid of scandium and titanium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: Described is a lithium scandium bromide ion-conductive solid prepared by a water-mediated route and dehydrated under vacuum. The Li3InCl6 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. The disclosure is applicable to Li3InCl6. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiBr, ScBr3, and TiBr4 followed by heat treatment at 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. The titanium substitution in an amount z of 0.3 to 0.55 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. After dehydration under vacuum at 300 degrees C, the water content is 0.5 wt% or less and the conductivity is 3 mS/cm. Compared with Li3YCl6, the substituted halide shows higher conductivity and better high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Sc(1-z)Ti(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which scandium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0.3 <= z <= 0.55, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.3 V or more.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 600 to 750 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 0.8 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The stack shows stable operation over 200 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 600 to 750 degrees C. The thin 3 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 0.8 W/cm2. The yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate dissolved in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive in an amount of 2 wt%. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The combination of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The cell retains 88% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 88% with the electrolyte. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 2 wt%.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the aluminum capacitor. The dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 100 microfarad rating. The anode body is a sintered pellet of aluminum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. A capacitance of 100 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The 100 microfarad capacitor smooths the output of a lithium battery converter.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of aluminum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) doped with naphthalenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 10 milliohms or less.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 600 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 600 MPa. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor in which a thio-LISICON type crystal is embedded in a glass is described, together with a lithium secondary battery using it. The precipitated Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 3.1 mS/cm. The disclosure is applicable to Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 70:30, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. The material is useful as a separator layer or as a conductive component of an electrode, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the content of P2O5 is 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.4 V is provided. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate at 1.5 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.4 V. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M and vinylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the niobium capacitor. The capacitor rated at 10 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The anode body is a sintered pellet of niobium powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. A capacitance of 470 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the niobium anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of niobium; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polypyrrole doped with p-toluenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 5 milliohms or less.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li3BO3 shell with high coverage and method for producing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor includes core particles of a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide and a coating layer of amorphous lithium borate (Li3BO3) disposed on the surface of the core particles. The material comprises lithium niobate (LiNbO3), Li3InCl6, lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li3YCl6, and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. Suitable compositions include lithium niobate (LiNbO3), Li3InCl6, lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li3YCl6. Nickel accounts for 90 mol% of the transition metals, and the heat treatment is performed at 450 degrees C. A halide conductor of the hexachloride type with cation disorder forms part of the composition, so that the material is both a coating and a halide conductor. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ceramic ion conductor powder. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved high-voltage stability and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium borate (Li3BO3), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.2 nm to 6 nm, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 80% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 50% or more.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyacrylonitrile and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a thermally crosslinked network of polyacrylonitrile and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 30 micrometers or less.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 700 to 850 degrees C. The gadolinium-doped ceria solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 50 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 700 to 850 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and gadolinium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The reversible cell with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 5 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a aluminum current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The warm isostatic pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The structure with the aluminum current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The lithium battery is operated at 120 degrees C under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite-type solid electrolyte and lithium battery and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A solid electrolyte comprising a crystal phase of the argyrodite-type type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and bromine. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The solid electrolyte exhibits an ionic conductivity of 11.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. Suitable compositions include Li7P3S11 and beta-Li3PS4. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the cycle life of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.045 or less, and wherein 1.4 <= a <= 1.8, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 430 degrees C to 530 degrees C.

title: Solid electrolyte oxygen sensor element with a heater and protective layer
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the gold sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The sensing electrode comprises gold and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The hydrogen sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 400 degrees C. The gold electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting hydrogen, comprising: a ceramic body comprising sodium beta-alumina; a sensing electrode comprising gold disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 400 degrees C.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide ceramic ion conductor using 1,2-dimethoxyethane and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: Disclosed is a liquid-phase synthesis in which lithium sulfide and phosphorus pentasulfide react in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to give a sulfide ceramic ion conductor precursor. An all-solid-state battery comprising the Li3PS4, Li6PS5Cl, and Li7P3S11 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. A germanium-free glass of the Li2S-P2S5 system may be used as a binder-like deformable phase. The suspension has a solid concentration of 5 wt% to 20 wt% and is reacted at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure. A residual solvent content of 0.2 wt% or less is achieved by vacuum drying, and the conductivity is 3 mS/cm. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. The liquid-phase route yields fine particles with a narrow size distribution and improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 5 wt% to 20 wt%, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.2 wt% or less.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a niobium solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The equivalent series resistance is 10 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The capacitor rated at 6.3 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 125 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The niobium capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of niobium; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polyaniline doped with p-toluenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 10 milliohms or less.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. With 0.5 wt% of vinylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The 1.5 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and vinylene carbonate in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 1.0 mS/cm. The polyacrylonitrile electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The membrane of 50 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyacrylonitrile and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polyacrylonitrile based electrolyte of 50 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite with a thickness of 3 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer of lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by cold isostatic pressing
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Solid electrolyte oxygen sensor element with a heater and protective layer
abstract: Disclosed is a mixed potential type sensor in which an oxide electrode and a gold electrode on a zirconia substrate generate a potential difference depending on the nitrogen oxide concentration. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 700 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode comprises lithium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The auxiliary electrode of lithium carbonate makes the sensor selective to nitrogen oxide against interfering gases. The limiting current is proportional to the nitrogen oxide concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The multilayer structure with the gadolinium-doped ceria ceramic allows mass production by co-firing.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising gold, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of nitrogen oxide.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 500 to 650 degrees C. A 5 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous niobium anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the niobium anode. The capacitor rated at 6.3 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. The capacitor has a capacitance of 330 microfarads, a rated voltage of 6.3 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 8 milliohms at 100 kHz. A solid electrolyte of polyaniline replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous niobium anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Argyrodite sulfide ion-conductive solid with mixed bromine-iodine substitution and production method thereof
abstract: A lithium phosphosulfide ion-conductive solid having a cubic argyrodite structure and a controlled halogen occupancy is described. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. The LGPS material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. In an embodiment the material is Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiBr relative to the argyrodite phase is 0.12 or less. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. When fired at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, the material shows a conductivity of 6.4 mS/cm or more and a lithium ion transference number close to unity. The suppression of the impurity phase results in a smaller interfacial resistance and better cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 6.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.3 <= x <= 0.75.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass solid electrolyte containing a beta-Li3PS4 phase
abstract: A glassy sulfide solid electrolyte with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 12 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 60% to 95% by X-ray diffraction. In a solid-state lithium battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the moisture stability. Specific examples are Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and beta-Li3PS4. The active material is preferably coated by an alkoxide route before mixing with the material. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. Crystallization is performed at 240 degrees C to 320 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 12 hours, which precipitates a beta-Li3PS4 phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. Precipitation of the metastable phase gives a conductivity higher than that of the glass, while the moisture stability is retained.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of GeS2 is 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 60% to 95%.

title: Aluminum-doped garnet ceramic ion conductor sintered body with high relative density
abstract: A sintered garnet pellet with a relative density of 92% and a method of hot pressing the same are described. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. Ball milling of the raw materials for the LiNbO3, Li2ZrO3, and Li3InCl6 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. The precursor may be precipitated from ethyl acetate and dried before use. A pellet of 500 micrometers thickness sintered at 1200 degrees C shows a conductivity of 0.6 mS/cm and a relative density of 92%. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. An all-solid-state battery comprising the LiNbO3, Li2ZrO3, and Li3InCl6 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The sintering aid lowers the sintering temperature by 100 degrees C or more while improving the interfacial resistance and high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a relative density of 89% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a lithium excess of 12 mol% to 20 mol%.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene matrix, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and succinonitrile as a plasticizer. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 12:1. The polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 20 micrometers or less.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more during cycling is described. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The uniaxial pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a stainless steel current collector is also provided. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 500 to 650 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria with a thickness of 10 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The cell operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a power density of 1.2 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The samarium-doped ceria solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising samarium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 10 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 60 degrees C. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 0.5 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite is also described. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. With 0.5 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, the capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. The combination of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite ceramic ion conductor having anion disorder and all-solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite phosphosulfide having the composition Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y) and to an all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the same. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm. Suitable compositions include Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). Atmospheric exposure at a dew point of -30 degrees C does not reduce the conductivity by more than 20%. In an all-solid-state lithium battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the cycle life of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 360 degrees C to 610 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M and a film-forming additive. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 2 wt% of vinylene carbonate is also described. The additive vinylene carbonate is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The cell retains 88% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 60 degrees C. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The 1.2 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and vinylene carbonate in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Composite cathode comprising sulfur and ketjen black and lithium secondary battery
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. A separator coated with ketjen black traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The sulfur particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 85%. The composite shows a capacity of 1400 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the sulfur cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising sulfur, ketjen black, and polyacrylic acid, wherein a loading of the sulfur is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polycarbonate matrix, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and an ionic liquid as a plasticizer. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 50 micrometers. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 25 degrees C. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polycarbonate. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polycarbonate and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 50 micrometers or less.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet ceramic ion conductor using a mother powder
abstract: A sintered garnet pellet with a relative density of 96% and a method of hot pressing the same are described. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The total ionic conductivity is 0.28 mS/cm or more and the grain boundary resistance is 20% or less of the total resistance. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. A lithium excess of 10 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. Suitable compositions include Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). The disclosure further provides a solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLZO, Li2ZrO3, and LLTO material. The dense garnet body suppresses lithium penetration along grain boundaries and improves the ionic conductivity and high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers, and wherein 0.35 <= v <= 0.7, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a lithium excess of 7 mol% to 15 mol%.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, carbon nanotubes, and carboxymethyl cellulose is described. The confinement of sulfur in the carbon nanotubes suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 200 cycles. With a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and carboxymethyl cellulose. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The carbon coating on the sulfur composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using carboxymethyl cellulose.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing sulfur with carbon nanotubes; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the sulfur into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor element with a poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer and a carbon cathode layer
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The tantalum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 5 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. A solid electrolyte of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor. The capacitor has a capacitance of 47 microfarads, a rated voltage of 6.3 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 5 milliohms at 100 kHz.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles doped with p-toluenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.4 V is provided. The 1.0 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V.
