A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.2 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

title: Iodine-substituted argyrodite-type ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery
abstract: Provided is a superionic sulfide of the argyrodite-type family in which halogen substitution exceeds the stoichiometric amount. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite-type phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. The material comprises Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), wherein the argyrodite-type crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, chlorine, and iodine. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiCl to the argyrodite-type phase is 0.03, and the room-temperature conductivity is 6 mS/cm. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ceramic ion conductor particles during pressing. The mixed halogen substitution improves the electrochemical window and cycle life of the solid-state battery.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.045 or less, and wherein 0.15 <= y/a <= 0.45, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 4.5 mS/cm or more.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for hydrogen with improved response time
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid state electrochemical sensor element with a built-in heater that keeps the ceramic at 500 degrees C. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The sensor shows a response time of 20 seconds to a step change of hydrogen concentration at 500 degrees C. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The sensor detects hydrogen with high selectivity and a response time of 20 seconds. The sensor operating at 500 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for hydrogen.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 4 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 4 cells and a case is also provided. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 30 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by nitrile butadiene rubber. The uniaxial pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. A lithium battery pack comprising 4 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and polytetrafluoroethylene are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 4 cells and a case is also provided. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a aluminum current collector is also provided. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium iron phosphate, and a conductive agent. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The capacitor rated at 16 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. The dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 470 microfarad rating. The capacitor has a capacitance of 470 microfarads, a rated voltage of 16 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 10 milliohms at 100 kHz. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by warm isostatic pressing
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 500 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 8 cells and a case is also provided. A solid electrolyte sheet of 20 micrometers is used as the separator.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 5 micrometers and a relative density of 98%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 600 to 750 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The reversible cell with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 98% or more.

title: Li2O-containing vitreous sulfide solid electrolyte and heat treatment method
abstract: Provided is a solid electrolyte comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 80%. The content of Li2O is 2 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 240 degrees C, and the conductivity is 0.8 mS/cm or more. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. The disclosure is applicable to Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. An all-solid-state battery comprising the LGPS material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. Because the crystal phase is precipitated inside the glass, the grain boundary resistance is small and the moisture stability is improved.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of Li2O is 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 500 to 650 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite with a thickness of 15 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 15 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C. The reversible cell with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The thin 15 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 0.8 W/cm2. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer of lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

title: tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. A capacitance of 220 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The capacitor rated at 10 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the tantalum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The polyaniline is doped with p-toluenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The dispersion of polyaniline gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 220 microfarad rating.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polyaniline particles doped with p-toluenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

assignee_raw: DRIOSTUS ADVANCED MATERIALS TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Lithium metal negative electrode having an artificial interphase formed by thermal evaporation for lithium battery
abstract: Described is an inorganic-polymer bilayer that protects the lithium metal negative electrode against the solid electrolyte. The protective layer thickness is 200 nm to 1000 nm and the Coulombic efficiency is 98.5% or more. The solid electrolyte is preferably beta-Li3PS4. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, and the protective layer forms an artificial interphase that is lithiophilic. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li3PS4 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The inorganic layer comprises lithium fluoride or lithium phosphorus oxynitride and has a thickness of 500 nm. The protective layer suppresses the growth of lithium dendrites and improves the dendrite suppression and interfacial resistance of the lithium metal battery.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium nitride (Li3N) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.5 micrometers to 3 micrometers, and wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 250 cycles or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 200 nm to 1000 nm.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 700 to 850 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 700 to 850 degrees C. A hybrid system in which the fuel cell charges a lithium ion battery is also described. The gadolinium-doped ceria solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C. The gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte of 98% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The stack shows stable operation over 200 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 98% or more.

assignee_raw: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
assignee_db_group: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Moisture-stable sulfide solid electrolyte and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: Provided is a sulfide solid electrolyte that retains 70% or more of its conductivity after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 2 hours. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. The solid electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an H2S generation of 5 cm3/g after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The powder is amorphized by mechanical milling in a dry room with a dew point of -50 degrees C or lower and then heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. The suppressed hydrolysis allows the sulfide to be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box, improving the grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an oxygen substitution amount of 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 25 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.4 mS/cm or more.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 300 kPa
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by roll pressing at 300 MPa and 25 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The lithium battery is operated at 25 degrees C under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 15 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 0.8 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The solid electrolyte of yttria-stabilized zirconia is a dense ceramic of 96% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The active material nickel sulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The initial capacity of 1200 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. The composite shows a capacity of 1200 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The confinement of nickel sulfide in the ketjen black suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 100 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising nickel sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing lithium difluorophosphate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The stable passivation film formed by lithium difluorophosphate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The additive lithium difluorophosphate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M and lithium difluorophosphate as an additive.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 16 stacked cells
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C
abstract: A solid electrolytic capacitor includes a porous tantalum anode body, a dielectric oxide film formed on the anode body, a conductive polymer layer comprising polyaniline doped with polystyrene sulfonate, a carbon layer, and a silver layer. The equivalent series resistance is 10 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The dispersion of polyaniline gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 220 microfarad rating. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polyaniline layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of tantalum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polyaniline doped with polystyrene sulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 10 milliohms or less.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 700 to 850 degrees C with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 5 micrometers. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 5 micrometers and a relative density of 95%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 700 to 850 degrees C. The reversible cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. A 5 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the scandia-stabilized zirconia cell.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 5 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNb(1-z)TazO3 shell with high coverage and method for producing the same
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous LiNb(1-z)TazO3 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. Suitable compositions include lithium niobate (LiNbO3). The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. Nickel accounts for 80 mol% of the transition metals, and the heat treatment is performed at 350 degrees C. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. The high coverage of the coating results in improved electrochemical window at a charging voltage of 4.3 V or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 40% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 75% or more.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor element with a polyaniline layer and a carbon cathode layer
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The polyaniline is doped with p-toluenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The equivalent series resistance is 10 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The capacitor rated at 16 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the niobium anode. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a niobium anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 16 V.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Oxide ion-conductive solid having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition and lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a high-voltage stable oxide ion conductor based on titanium-free NASICON-type oxide and a method for forming its oxidation-resistant surface. A lithium secondary battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. The substitution amount is 2 mol%, which gives an oxidation limit of 4.2 V or more and a conductivity of 0.49 mS/cm or more. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the decomposition current density at 5 V is 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. The mixture for the ion-conductive solid is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. The oxide ion-conductive solid enables the use of a 5 V class cathode and improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 75% or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.2 V or more.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate and a film-forming additive
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate dissolved in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate and vinylene carbonate as an additive in an amount of 3 wt%. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 3 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The stable passivation film formed by vinylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 300 cycles is 90% with the electrolyte. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising vinylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

assignee_raw: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
assignee_db_group: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Iodine-substituted argyrodite solid electrolyte and lithium battery and solid-state battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure provides an argyrodite solid electrolyte whose anion sublattice is partially disordered by mixed bromine-iodine substitution. Specific examples are Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The solid electrolyte exhibits an ionic conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. The argyrodite crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiBr and Li3PS4. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. Partial substitution of bromine with iodine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiBr impurity phase. A protected lithium metal negative electrode is one example of the counter electrode. The mixed halogen substitution improves the interfacial resistance and ionic conductivity of the solid-state battery.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Br(x)I(y), wherein 0.15 <= y/a <= 0.45, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein 1.3 <= a <= 1.7.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 300 kPa
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The cold isostatic pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The current collector of aluminum is used in a lithium battery with a 30 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The titania nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyacrylonitrile. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyacrylonitrile chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 20:1.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: Described is a liquid-phase route to a sulfide ceramic ion conductor that does not require long mechanical milling. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A lithium secondary battery using a lithium metal anode together with the ceramic ion conductor shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. The ion-conductive component may be Li7P3S11, argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4. An interlayer of a lithium-ion conductive polymer may be inserted to improve the contact at the interface. The dried precipitate is heat-treated at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C in an argon atmosphere to convert the complex into the crystalline sulfide. A precursor of the Li7P3S11, Li6PS5Cl, and Li3PS4 material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The dried precursor is heat-treated at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C for 1 hour to 6 hours and shows a conductivity of 1 mS/cm or more. A titanium-containing oxide whose reduction is suppressed may be combined with the material. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. Because the raw materials react in the liquid phase, the method is scalable and gives a powder with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C, and wherein the reaction temperature is 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 125 degrees C storage. The polypyrrole layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 8 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The polypyrrole is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. A solid electrolyte of polypyrrole replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor. A capacitance of 100 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a niobium anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 35 V.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide dissolved in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate and lithium difluorophosphate as an additive in an amount of 3 wt%. With 3 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing silica nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The membrane of 50 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyacrylonitrile and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Wet coating method for forming an ion-conductive solid layer on a release film and method for preparing the same
abstract: A wet film of an ion-conductive solid cast on a PET release film and dried in an oven is described. The binder content is 5 wt%, the drying temperature is 100 degrees C, and the decrease in conductivity after slurry processing is 20% or less. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. In an embodiment the material is beta-Li3PS4, Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The solvent has a donor number of 10 or less so that the ion-conductive solid does not react with the solvent during slurry processing. A dry process in which the ion-conductive solid powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the solid-state lithium battery. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ion-conductive solid powder. A solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Because the binder is dissolved in the solvent, the layer is uniform and shows improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming an ion-conductive solid layer, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; a styrene-butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the thickness of the dried layer is 5 micrometers to 150 micrometers, and wherein the solid content of the slurry is 25 wt% to 70 wt%.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass ion-conductive solid containing a beta-Li3PS4 phase and tin substitution for improved moisture stability
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid is a crystallized glass comprising a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix having a Li2S to P2S5 molar ratio of 75:25 in which 2 mol% to 6 mol% of the phosphorus is substituted by tin, and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated from the matrix. A glassy precursor prepared by melt quenching at 750 degrees C is reheated at 240 degrees C to 280 degrees C so that the beta-Li3PS4 phase precipitates uniformly with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 100 nm and a degree of crystallinity of 50% to 75%. The tin, a soft acid, binds the sulfur more strongly than phosphorus, and the cumulative hydrogen sulfide generation upon exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 60 minutes is 8 cm3/g or less. The crystallized glass has an ionic conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and retains 80% or more of the conductivity after the exposure. Unlike crystalline Li7P3S11 or Li6PS5Cl powders, the remaining vitreous phase gives good deformability, and an all-solid-state battery using the material shows improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid which is a crystallized glass comprising: a vitreous phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25, wherein 2 mol% to 6 mol% of phosphorus is substituted by tin; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated from the vitreous phase, wherein a degree of crystallinity determined by X-ray diffraction is 50% to 75%, and a cumulative hydrogen sulfide generation upon exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 60 minutes is 8 cm3/g or less.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa and 60 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium cobalt oxide, and a conductive agent. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 2 cells and a case is also provided. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a nickel-plated copper current collector is also provided. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Mixed potential type nitrogen oxide sensor and method of manufacturing the sensing electrode
abstract: Disclosed is a mixed potential type sensor in which an oxide electrode and a gold electrode on a zirconia substrate generate a potential difference depending on the nitrogen oxide concentration. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of nitrogen oxide concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The multilayer structure with the NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The sensor with a response time of 20 seconds can monitor a lithium battery manufacturing line for nitrogen oxide. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The sensor detects nitrogen oxide with high selectivity and a response time of 20 seconds. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 500 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Densified garnet oxide solid electrolyte and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A sintered garnet pellet with a relative density of 92% and a method of hot pressing the same are described. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. When v is 0.4, the cubic phase fraction is 97% or more and the conductivity is 0.4 mS/cm. A sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. The dopant niobium occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.25 to 0.6, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. A solid-state lithium battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved grain boundary resistance. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. The sintered garnet is useful as a dense separator against a lithium metal negative electrode, with improved grain boundary resistance and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an average grain size of 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 89% or more, and wherein 0.25 <= v <= 0.6.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: Disclosed is a thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a thermally crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 50 micrometers or less.

title: Wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte with low residual solvent
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte by stirring the raw materials in a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran at 60 degrees C and filtering the precipitate is described. Ball milling of the raw materials for the LLZO and Li6PS5Cl material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. The solvent is a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran, and LiCl or LiBr dissolved in the solvent is incorporated into the precipitate. The carbon content of the heat-treated powder is 0.3 wt% and the conductivity is 2.2 mS/cm. An interlayer of a lithium-ion conductive polymer may be inserted to improve the contact at the interface. Suitable compositions include Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The reaction is performed in a stirred reactor having a volume of 10 L or more, and the precipitate is washed with fresh solvent. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. Dissolution and precipitation give a homogeneous composition and improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide solid electrolyte and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: Described is an oxide solid electrolyte whose decomposition current at 5 V is 4 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). A capacity retention of 90% after 200 cycles at 4.6 V is obtained with the substituted oxide. An oxidation-resistant surface region comprising lithium phosphate is formed on the particles by an oxygen anneal after sintering. In an embodiment the solid electrolyte layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. A solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved sinterability. The oxide solid electrolyte enables the use of a 5 V class cathode and improves the sinterability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a NASICON-type LATP phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 4 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.21 mS/cm or more.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNbO3 shell with high coverage
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium niobate formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li2ZrO3 material. The coated particles are heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. The core particles have a median diameter D50 of 1 micrometers and nickel content of 50 mol% or more. Suitable compositions include lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 50% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite cell. A power density of 1.0 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 700 to 850 degrees C operating range. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The anode support contains nickel oxide and lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 5 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 500 kPa
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 2 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 2 stacked cells. The warm isostatic pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by warm isostatic pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 8 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The gadolinium-doped ceria solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide ceramic ion conductor using a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran
abstract: A solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor powder from a suspension in an organic solvent is provided. The solvent is a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran, and LiCl or LiBr dissolved in the solvent is incorporated into the precipitate. A solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved grain boundary resistance. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of an argyrodite-type component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. Heat treatment at 400 degrees C after drying at 180 degrees C gives a conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm or more. Suitable compositions include Li7P3S11 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. After drying, the residual solvent content is 0.5 wt% or less and the carbon content is 0.5 wt% or less. Because the raw materials react in the liquid phase, the method is scalable and gives a powder with improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 120 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 100 degrees C to 280 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 250 degrees C to 500 degrees C, wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 1 wt% to 20 wt%, and wherein the residual solvent content is 1.5 wt% or less, and wherein the reaction temperature is 0 degrees C to 120 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 0.5 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite is also described. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: This disclosure concerns a Li2S-P2S5 glass of 80:20 composition that is converted by quenching and reheating into a crystallized conductor. The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. The crystallized glass has an ionic conductivity of 3.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a degree of crystallinity of 50%. The LATP and Li2ZrO3 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 320 degrees C. An all-solid-state battery containing the crystallized glass shows improved high-voltage stability and rate performance.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 280 degrees C to 360 degrees C, and wherein the content of SiS2 is 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 30% to 65%.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The uniaxial pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. A lithium battery pack comprising 2 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The membrane of 20 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyacrylonitrile and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 20:1.

title: Aluminum oxide deposited by atomic layer deposition protective layer for lithium metal negative electrode and lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a bilayer protective layer that suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments into a solid electrolyte layer and stabilizes the interface with metallic lithium. The material comprises Li3YCl6 and beta-Li3PS4, and the protective layer forms an artificial interphase that is lithiophilic. Atmospheric exposure at a dew point of -30 degrees C does not reduce the conductivity by more than 20%. The bilayer with a total thickness of 1 micrometer gives 500 cycles of stable plating and stripping. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. Specific examples are Li3YCl6 and beta-Li3PS4. Because the inorganic layer blocks electron leakage, the decomposition of the solid electrolyte at the negative electrode is suppressed and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising aluminum oxide deposited by atomic layer deposition (Al2O3) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 10 nm to 600 nm, and wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 125 cycles or more.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass ion-conductive solid containing a thio-LISICON phase for lithium battery
abstract: Provided is an ion-conductive solid comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable thio-LISICON crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 80%. The material comprises Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 300 degrees C. The ion-conductive solid may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers and gives a pellet conductivity of 5.5 mS/cm after pressing at 360 MPa. A wet-chemical synthesis through a solvate complex precipitate gives a fine sulfide powder. The disclosure is applicable to Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. A lithium secondary battery comprising the LGPS and Li6PS5Cl material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The material is useful as a separator layer or as a conductive component of an electrode, with improved electrochemical window and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of P2O5 is 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 60% to 95%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 500 to 650 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. A power density of 0.8 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer of scandia-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 10 micrometers. The cell operates at 700 to 850 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles.
