The cell can be operated at 700 to 850 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. A 10 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 700 to 850 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite cell.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 700 to 850 degrees C.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous niobium anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: Disclosed is a method for forming a conductive polymer layer by impregnating a dielectric-coated anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles. The equivalent series resistance is 5 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The niobium anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. A solid electrolyte of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 5 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous niobium anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Hafnium-substituted phosphate-based NASICON solid electrolyte stable above 5 V and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid electrolyte whose anodic decomposition at high potential is suppressed by a surface region of 5 nm to 50 nm. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and shows an oxidation potential of 5 V. The material may be used together with a halogen-substituted Li6PS5X having an impurity-free X-ray pattern. The positive electrode active material is LiCoPO4, which is charged to 4.6 V or more against the oxide solid electrolyte. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. A lithium battery using the oxide shows improved ionic conductivity at a charging voltage of 4.6 V.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a phosphate-based NASICON phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.4 V or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 100 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 20 mol%.

title: Zirconium-substituted lithium indium chloride ceramic ion conductor with orthorhombic structure and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: A halide ion conductor having the composition Li(3-z)In(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6, wherein z is 0.02 to 0.25, and a method for producing the same are provided. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise lithium fluoride (LiF) and Li3YCl6. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.9 micrometers to 9 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A superionic argyrodite-type phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. The material comprises lithium fluoride (LiF) and Li3YCl6, and the hexachloride framework tolerates partial substitution by scandium or a rare earth element. The median particle diameter D50 is 3 micrometers and the pellet conductivity is 1.2 mS/cm after pressing at 300 MPa. An oxide stable up to 5 V versus Li/Li+ can be used on the positive electrode side. The water-mediated synthesis allows scalable production while retaining the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which indium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more, and wherein 0.02 <= z <= 0.25.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 85% with the electrolyte. The 1.5 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 1 wt%.

title: Densified garnet oxide solid electrolyte and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method for sintering a tantalum-doped Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet to a relative density of 89% or more while suppressing lithium volatilization. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. A solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A lithium excess of 10 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. The amount of the sintering aid is 2 wt%, the sintering temperature is 1150 degrees C, and the resulting density is 92%. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1070 degrees C to 1220 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. The sintered garnet is useful as a dense separator against a lithium metal negative electrode, with improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.05 <= v <= 0.4, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 7 mol% to 15 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The current collector of copper is used in a lithium battery with a 100 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The reversible cell with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The anode support contains nickel oxide and gadolinium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. A power density of 0.8 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 700 to 850 degrees C operating range. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of gadolinium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 96% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: An air-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid in which hydrolysis is suppressed by tin substitution is provided. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 4 cm3/g or less. The mixture for the ion-conductive solid is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The ion-conductive solid shows an ionic conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an H2S generation of 2 cm3/g after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C. The negative electrode may be metallic lithium with a fluorinated protective layer. A hexachloride of yttrium or indium may serve as the catholyte. The cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes of exposure to air with a dew point of -20 degrees C is 2 cm3/g. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4. The ion-conductive solid retains its conductivity after atmospheric exposure and shows improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 4 cm3/g or less, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 6 hours is 80% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a tin substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%.

assignee_raw: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
assignee_db_group: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li3YCl6 shell with high coverage for lithium battery
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous Li3YCl6 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. The Li3InCl6, Li2ZrO3, and LiF material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. The coating layer has an average thickness of 3 nm and a coverage of 95%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 50% relative to uncoated particles. The material comprises Li3InCl6, lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and lithium fluoride (LiF), and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. A halide conductor of the hexachloride type with cation disorder forms part of the composition, so that the material is both a coating and a halide conductor. Examples of the ion conductor include Li3InCl6, lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and lithium fluoride (LiF). Because the shell is amorphous and continuous, the growth of interfacial resistance is reduced and the cycle life is improved.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium yttrium chloride (Li3YCl6), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 40% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 75 mol% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 5 micrometers. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 5 micrometers and a relative density of 97%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C. The reversible cell with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyacrylonitrile and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyacrylonitrile matrix. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 100 micrometers. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 40 degrees C. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyacrylonitrile chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 12:1.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a lithium sulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 5 mg/cm2. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the lithium sulfide cathode. The lithium sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with carbon nanotubes by ball milling. With a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The lithium sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and carboxymethyl cellulose in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. In an embodiment the cathode is pressed against a sulfide solid electrolyte layer instead of a separator.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising carbon nanotubes; lithium sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: Described is a combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V. The additive vinylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The stable passivation film formed by vinylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M and vinylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor element with a polypyrrole layer and a carbon cathode layer
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. The aluminum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The capacitor rated at 6.3 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 125 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The capacitor has a capacitance of 470 microfarads, a rated voltage of 6.3 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 10 milliohms at 100 kHz.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a aluminum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 6.3 V.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and a film-forming additive
abstract: Described is a combination of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 300 cycles is 88% with the electrolyte. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 88% of its capacity after 300 cycles.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide dissolved in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive in an amount of 3 wt%. The stable passivation film formed by tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The cell retains 88% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The capacity retention of 88% after 1000 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 3 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet ion-conductive solid using a mother powder
abstract: A lanthanum zirconium garnet ion-conductive solid doped with tungsten and sintered with Li2CO3 is described. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The dopant tungsten occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.25 to 0.6, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. When v is 0.4, the cubic phase fraction is 97% or more and the conductivity is 1 mS/cm. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. A lithium excess of 15 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. The sintered garnet is useful as a dense separator against a lithium metal negative electrode, with improved electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)W(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 12 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 93% or more.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and polyvinylidene fluoride binder
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, graphene, and polyvinylidene fluoride is described. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The confinement of nickel sulfide in the graphene suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 200 cycles. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyvinylidene fluoride. The initial capacity of 600 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The composite shows a capacity of 600 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The active material nickel sulfide is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising graphene; nickel sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate and a film-forming additive
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, 1,3-propane sultone, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The additive 1,3-propane sultone forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 85% with the electrolyte. The cell charged to 4.4 V retains 85% of its capacity after 1000 cycles. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V. The additive 1,3-propane sultone reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate and a film-forming additive
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. The combination of lithium bis(oxalato)borate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate at 1.0 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.3 V. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V. The cell retains 90% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The capacity retention of 90% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium bis(oxalato)borate. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 1 wt%.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The cathode may also be used with a solid electrolyte to form a solid-state lithium-sulfur cell. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the molybdenum disulfide cathode. The carbon coating on the molybdenum disulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The capacity retention after 200 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid. The active material molybdenum disulfide is combined with carbon nanotubes and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising molybdenum disulfide, carbon nanotubes, and polyacrylic acid, wherein a loading of the molybdenum disulfide is 5 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The combination of 1,3-propane sultone and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. With 3 wt% of 1,3-propane sultone, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M and 1,3-propane sultone as an additive.

title: Wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte with low residual solvent
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte with a residual solvent content of 0.2 wt% or less. Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The dissolution of P2S5 in the solvent is followed by precipitation of a complex that contains one to three solvent molecules per formula unit. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The solid electrolyte obtained by the method has an ionic conductivity of 2.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a residual solvent content of 0.2 wt%. In an embodiment the material is beta-Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The method further comprises forming a free-standing sheet from the powder by calendering with a fibril binder network. Dissolution and precipitation give a homogeneous composition and improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the reaction temperature is 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C.

title: Exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell and a sensing cell on a zirconia substrate
abstract: Disclosed is a mixed potential type sensor in which an oxide electrode and a lanthanum strontium manganite electrode on a zirconia substrate generate a potential difference depending on the carbon dioxide concentration. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The auxiliary electrode of barium carbonate makes the sensor selective to carbon dioxide against interfering gases. The lanthanum strontium manganite electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of carbon dioxide.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar stainless steel current collectors. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The structure with the stainless steel current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The roll pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 ceramic ion conductor with reduced grain boundary resistance and lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a densified garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor and to a lithium battery including the same. The mother powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers, and the sintered body has a conductivity of 0.6 mS/cm. The disclosure further provides a solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLZO and Li2ZrO3 material. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. The dopant aluminum occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.15 to 0.5, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. The ceramic ion conductor may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. A lithium excess of 10 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. Because lithium volatilization is suppressed, the cubic phase is retained and the grain boundary resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.15 <= v <= 0.5, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a relative density of 94% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an average grain size of 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: Disclosed is a liquid-phase synthesis in which lithium sulfide and phosphorus pentasulfide react in ethyl acetate to give a sulfide ion-conductive solid precursor. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li7P3S11, argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The suspension concentration is 15 wt%, the reaction temperature is 60 degrees C, and the drying temperature is 180 degrees C. The cubic argyrodite-type structure tolerates chlorine and bromine on the 4a and 4d sites. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ion-conductive solid layer of the lithium secondary battery. The solvate route lowers the processing temperature and improves the ionic conductivity of the product.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 7.5 wt% to 30 wt%, and wherein the reaction temperature is 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a iron sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The carbon coating on the iron sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the iron sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the iron sulfide cathode. The composite shows a capacity of 1000 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The active material iron sulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The active material is coated with a thin lithium phosphosulfide ion conductor layer so that the cathode can be used in a solid-state cell. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of iron sulfide.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing iron sulfide with ketjen black; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the iron sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The membrane of 20 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The lithium salt is lithium perchlorate and the membrane has a thickness of 20 micrometers. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium perchlorate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 20 micrometers or less.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyethylene oxide matrix, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether as a plasticizer. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 40 degrees C. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The polyethylene oxide electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyethylene oxide. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyethylene oxide; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Oxide ceramic ion conductor having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition and method for preparing the same
abstract: A NASICON-type or perovskite-type oxide ceramic ion conductor with an oxidation limit of 4.7 V or more is described. An all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the LLZO material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the decomposition current density at 5 V is 40 microamperes per square centimeter or less. A capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 4.6 V is obtained with the substituted oxide. A lithium battery using the oxide shows improved sinterability at a charging voltage of 4.6 V.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 40 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.49 mS/cm or more.

title: Zirconium-substituted lithium yttrium chloride ion-conductive solid with trigonal structure and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a lithium metal halide of the Li3MX6 type with a close-packed chloride anion sublattice and to a battery using the same. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The material comprises Li3YCl6, and the hexachloride framework tolerates partial substitution by scandium or a rare earth element. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. Heat treatment at 350 degrees C for 2 hours to 12 hours gives a trigonal phase with a conductivity of 1.05 mS/cm or more. Suitable compositions include Li3YCl6. Compared with Li3YCl6, the substituted halide shows higher conductivity and better electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.05 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.3 <= z <= 0.55, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more.

title: Mixed-halide ceramic ion conductor of yttrium and titanium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a lithium metal halide of the Li3MX6 type with a close-packed bromide anion sublattice and to a battery using the same. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ceramic ion conductor powder. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiBr, YBr3, and TiBr4 followed by heat treatment at 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. The halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity of 3 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an oxidation stability limit of 4.3 V versus Li/Li+. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The disclosure further provides a solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3InCl6, Li3YCl6, and LiF material. The water-mediated synthesis allows scalable production while retaining the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Ti(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.1 V or more.

title: Air-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a soft-acid surface region
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a hygroscopicity of 1 wt% or less and an oxygen-rich surface region is described. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -30 degrees C and the exposure time is 24 hours. A superionic Li6PS5X phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. The oxygen content of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol% suppresses H2S generation to 40 cm3/g or less while the conductivity remains 3.1 mS/cm or more. In a lithium secondary battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The material is useful for electrode slurry processing in a dry room, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 24 hours is 75% or more.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyethylene oxide and lithium hexafluorophosphate and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 20 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The polymer matrix is polyethylene oxide and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The membrane further contains a ceramic filler of Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet in an amount of 10 wt% to 30 wt% to form a composite electrolyte. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.2 mS/cm.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a thermally crosslinked network of polyethylene oxide and lithium hexafluorophosphate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 20 micrometers or less.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M and a film-forming additive. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 0.5 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite is also described. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V. The capacity retention of 92% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.2 M and adding tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises lithium sulfide impregnated in graphene and a carbon coating on the composite. Polysulfide dissolution from the lithium sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The graphene framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of lithium sulfide. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyacrylic acid in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The composite shows a capacity of 1000 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 85%. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 2 mg/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising lithium sulfide, graphene, and polyacrylic acid, wherein a loading of the lithium sulfide is 2 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate and a film-forming additive
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M and a film-forming additive. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. The additive vinylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 60 degrees C. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The capacity retention of 90% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without vinylene carbonate.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising vinylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium tungstate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and method for preparing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a coated positive electrode active material whose Li2WO4 shell suppresses the interfacial reaction with a sulfide ion-conductive solid. In an all-solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. The cubic Li6PS5X structure tolerates chlorine and bromine on the 4a and 4d sites. The ion-conductive solid is preferably lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and Li3InCl6. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. The average thickness of the coating is 1.2 nm to 6 nm, the coverage is 75% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 50 mol% or more of the transition metals. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved cycle life and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 20% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 75% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C.

title: Solvent-free self-supporting sulfide ion-conductive solid sheet bound by a fibrillated fluoropolymer network and method of forming the same
abstract: A self-supporting sheet comprises particles of an argyrodite-type sulfide ion-conductive solid of the Li6PS5Cl type and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene binder in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 3 wt%, the binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network that binds the particles without any solvent. The sheet is formed by kneading the powder and the binder under a shear rate of 200 s^-1 to 800 s^-1 at 60 degrees C to 100 degrees C so that the binder is fibrillized, rolling the kneaded mass between a pair of rollers heated to 80 degrees C to 120 degrees C, and calendering the rolled film in at least three passes with a stepwise reduced roller gap to a thickness of 20 micrometers to 60 micrometers. The fibrils have an average diameter of 50 nm to 300 nm, and the sheet has a porosity of 8% or less, a tensile strength of 1.5 MPa or more, and an ionic conductivity of 2.0 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C. Because no polar solvent contacts the sulfide, the conductivity of the powder is retained, and the sheet can be wound on a roll and laminated onto an electrode without a drying step. An all-solid-state battery using the sheet shows improved sheet formability in production and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A self-supporting sheet comprising: particles of a sulfide ion-conductive solid having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene binder in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 3 wt% relative to the sheet, the binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles, wherein the fibrils have an average diameter of 50 nm to 300 nm, the sheet is free of a solvent, and the sheet has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 60 micrometers and a porosity of 8% or less.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet ceramic ion conductor using a mother powder
abstract: A garnet ceramic ion conductor sintered body having an average grain size of 10 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. Sintering is performed at 1250 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). A solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. When v is 0.5, the cubic phase fraction is 97% or more and the conductivity is 0.4 mS/cm. The densification improves the mechanical strength and the ionic conductivity of the garnet layer.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an average grain size of 4 micrometers to 30 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.28 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.35 <= v <= 0.7.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The structure with the aluminum current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a stainless steel current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 200 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The uniaxial pressing step at 200 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The structure with the stainless steel current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 200 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Method for producing a ceramic ion conductor sheet by slurry casting and peeling
abstract: A method for producing a ceramic ion conductor sheet by slurry casting, drying, and peeling from a support film is provided. The slurry has a solid content of 60 wt% and a viscosity of 3000 mPa s at 25 degrees C, and the dried layer has a thickness of 50 micrometers and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm. In an embodiment the material is beta-Li3PS4 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and the dispersant is an amine-based dispersant in an amount of 0.1 wt% to 1 wt%. In an all-solid-state lithium battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The binder is polyisobutylene in an amount of 1.2 wt% to 6 wt% and is dissolved in the nonpolar solvent anisole. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. An all-solid-state lithium battery using the layer shows improved ionic conductivity and a thin electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a polyisobutylene binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising anisole in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 1500 mPa s to 6000 mPa s, and wherein the solid content of the slurry is 50 wt% to 70 wt%, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 0.6 mS/cm or more.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. A 8 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. A power density of 1.5 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 500 to 650 degrees C. The thin 8 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.5 W/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The polymer matrix is poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 12:1. The poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The 100 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 12:1.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 600 to 750 degrees C. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. A 3 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 3 micrometers and a relative density of 95%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The anion is covalently bonded to the polycarbonate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The polymer electrolyte is laminated with a thin ceramic ion conductor layer to block dendrites. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polycarbonate. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The membrane of 30 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polycarbonate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polycarbonate and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 30 micrometers or less.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. A power density of 1.5 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 600 to 750 degrees C operating range. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C. The samarium-doped ceria solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The samarium-doped ceria electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin samarium-doped ceria electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 10 micrometers. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The cell operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 50 cycles. The samarium-doped ceria electrolyte of 98% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The anode support contains nickel oxide and samarium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. With 3 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 45 degrees C. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V. The stable passivation film formed by lithium difluorophosphate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. The additive lithium difluorophosphate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising lithium difluorophosphate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a iron sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The iron sulfide is melt-diffused into carbon nanotubes at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 80% of its capacity after 500 cycles is also described. The composite shows a capacity of 800 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The initial capacity of 800 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The confinement of iron sulfide in the carbon nanotubes suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The active material iron sulfide is combined with carbon nanotubes and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising iron sulfide, carbon nanotubes, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the iron sulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 650 to 800 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite cell. A power density of 0.8 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 98% or more.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The capacity retention of 90% after 1000 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without fluoroethylene carbonate. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 60 degrees C. The cell retains 90% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The 1.2 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.2 M and fluoroethylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 125 degrees C
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the niobium capacitor. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polypyrrole layer to serve as the cathode lead-out.
