first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C, and wherein the content of LiI is 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium perchlorate and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The 100 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. A composite electrolyte in which an inorganic ion conductor such as LLZO or LATP is dispersed in the polymer is also provided. The anion is covalently bonded to the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 12:1.

assignee_db_group: DALANE UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Ceramic ion conductor slurry with controlled viscosity and solid content for doctor blade casting
abstract: Disclosed is a wet coating method in which a slurry of a ceramic ion conductor is cast on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. The binder is polyisobutylene in an amount of 0.4 wt% to 2 wt% and is dissolved in the nonpolar solvent xylene. The slurry is applied onto a release film at a coating speed of 1 m/min to 10 m/min and dried at 40 degrees C to 80 degrees C in an oven. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. The solid content is 50 wt% to 70 wt%, the viscosity is 250 mPa s to 1000 mPa s, and the layer thickness is 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ceramic ion conductor layer of the all-solid-state battery. The ion-conductive component may be beta-Li3PS4. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The controlled viscosity gives a uniform thickness and improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a polyisobutylene binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising xylene in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the thickness of the dried layer is 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers, and wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 40 degrees C to 80 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 1.3 mS/cm or more.

title: lithium sulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a lithium sulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the lithium sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 80% at 25 degrees C. Polysulfide dissolution from the lithium sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and carboxymethyl cellulose in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The porous carbon framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of lithium sulfide.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The scandia-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the scandia-stabilized zirconia cell. The cell operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 50 cycles. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 10 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 2 wt%.

title: Amperometric oxygen sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: Described is a thick film gas sensor whose sensing electrode is printed on a ceramic ion conductor. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The oxygen sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 700 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite makes the sensor selective to oxygen against interfering gases. The ceramic is sodium beta-alumina and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 700 degrees C. The limiting current is proportional to the oxygen concentration from 0.1% to 20%.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting oxygen, comprising: a ceramic body comprising sodium beta-alumina; a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 700 degrees C.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 600 to 750 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 600 to 750 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 15 micrometers. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 600 to 750 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 15 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Multilayer ceramic gas sensor element and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid state electrochemical sensor element with a built-in heater that keeps the ceramic at 400 degrees C. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 400 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium manganite electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting hydrogen, comprising: a ceramic body comprising lanthanum fluoride; a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 400 degrees C.

title: Densified garnet oxide solid electrolyte and lithium battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a densified garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte and to a lithium battery including the same. The grain size is 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers and the relative density is 89% or more after sintering at 1020 degrees C to 1170 degrees C. A solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. A titanium-containing oxide whose reduction is suppressed may be combined with the material. An interlayer of a lithium-ion conductive polymer may be inserted to improve the contact at the interface. A wet-chemical synthesis through a solvate complex precipitate gives a fine sulfide powder. The method gives reproducible densification and improved sinterability at a lower cost.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)W(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a sintering temperature of 900 degrees C to 1250 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.24 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.01 <= v <= 0.7.

title: sulfur positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises sulfur impregnated in graphene and a carbon coating on the composite. A separator coated with graphene traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 600 mAh/g and retains 90% of the capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5 C. The sulfur particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with graphene by ball milling. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the sulfur cathode. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising graphene; sulfur impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The solid electrolyte layer of lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte of 95% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 50 cycles. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium perchlorate for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyacrylonitrile chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and polyacrylic acid binder
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The porous carbon framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of nickel sulfide. The cathode with a loading of 4 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The active material nickel sulfide is combined with porous carbon and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. In an embodiment the cathode is pressed against a sulfide solid electrolyte layer instead of a separator. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid. The composite shows a capacity of 1400 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising porous carbon; nickel sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite with a thickness of 3 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The thin 3 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 0.8 W/cm2. The anode support contains nickel oxide and lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 3 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1. The polymer electrolyte is laminated with a thin ceramic ion conductor layer to block dendrites. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium perchlorate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 40 degrees C. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 12:1.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Amperometric sulfur dioxide sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. The ceramic is yttria-stabilized zirconia and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 500 degrees C. The sensor operating at 500 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for sulfur dioxide. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 500 degrees C. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The sensor shows a response time of 2 seconds to a step change of sulfur dioxide concentration at 500 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising sodium nitrite in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects sulfur dioxide.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The membrane of 30 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyacrylonitrile and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The polyacrylonitrile electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. A composite electrolyte in which an inorganic ion conductor such as LLZO or LATP is dispersed in the polymer is also provided. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 30 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a thermally crosslinked network of polyacrylonitrile and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 30 micrometers or less.

title: Solid electrolyte sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: Disclosed is a solvent-free method of forming a solid electrolyte sheet by kneading the powder with PTFE under shear and rolling the mixture between heated rollers. The sheet is calendered to a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and laminated onto an electrode by roll-pressing without a drying step. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The roll temperature is 90 degrees C to 150 degrees C and the sheet has a thickness of 50 micrometers after calendering. The binder is polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) in an amount of 0.2 wt% to 1 wt%, and the fibrils have an average diameter of 50 nm to 500 nm. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. A lithium secondary battery using the sheet shows improved sheet formability and a thinner electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 0.2 wt% to 1 wt%, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 1.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 1.8 MPa or more.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and carboxymethyl cellulose binder
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a titanium disulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. A separator coated with graphene traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The active material titanium disulfide is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The graphene framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of titanium disulfide. The titanium disulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 5 mg/cm2. The composite shows a capacity of 1200 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising titanium disulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyacrylonitrile chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The membrane further contains a ceramic filler of Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet in an amount of 10 wt% to 30 wt% to form a composite electrolyte. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The polyacrylonitrile electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm are obtained. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyacrylonitrile; a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor element with a polyaniline layer and a carbon cathode layer
abstract: Disclosed is a method for forming a conductive polymer layer by impregnating a dielectric-coated anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the tantalum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. A capacitance of 47 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The tantalum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the tantalum capacitor. The dispersion of polyaniline gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 47 microfarad rating.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 35 V.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 700 to 850 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 700 to 850 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 700 to 850 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 3 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The stack shows stable operation over 50 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 700 to 850 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 3 micrometers. The anode support contains nickel oxide and scandia-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Densified garnet oxide ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sintering method for a garnet ceramic ion conductor using a mother powder cover and a lithium excess of 10 mol%. Suitable compositions include Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). In an embodiment the ceramic ion conductor layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. A solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. When v is 0.4, the cubic phase fraction is 97% or more and the conductivity is 0.8 mS/cm. An argyrodite phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. Sintering is performed at 1150 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. The sintered garnet is useful as a dense separator against a lithium metal negative electrode, with improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)W(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a lithium excess of 7 mol% to 15 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.56 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.25 <= v <= 0.6.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a aluminum solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. A solid electrolyte of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor. The capacitor rated at 16 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the aluminum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The capacitor has a capacitance of 330 microfarads, a rated voltage of 16 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 5 milliohms at 100 kHz. The aluminum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Solid electrolyte oxygen sensor element with a heater and protective layer
abstract: Disclosed is a mixed potential type sensor in which an oxide electrode and a gold electrode on a zirconia substrate generate a potential difference depending on the nitrogen oxide concentration. The ceramic is yttria-stabilized zirconia and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 300 degrees C. The protective layer improves the durability of the yttria-stabilized zirconia sensor in an exhaust gas. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The sensor shows a response time of 5 seconds to a step change of nitrogen oxide concentration at 300 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode of sodium carbonate makes the sensor selective to nitrogen oxide against interfering gases.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. With 0.5 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Lithium nitride protective layer for lithium metal negative electrode and lithium battery
abstract: A lithium metal negative electrode having a protective layer with a thickness of 200 nm to 1000 nm and a lithium metal battery including the same are provided. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The protective layer is deposited on a lithium foil of 20 micrometers thickness under an argon atmosphere. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. The inorganic layer suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments, while the polymer layer absorbs the cracks caused by volume change of the negative electrode. The protective layer thickness is 200 nm to 1000 nm and the Coulombic efficiency is 98.5% or more. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The lithiophilic interphase gives uniform lithium deposition and improved ionic conductivity and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium nitride (Li3N) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97.2% or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.05 micrometers to 5 micrometers, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 50 nm to 3000 nm.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the tantalum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The capacitor rated at 35 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The capacitor withstands 125 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The tantalum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the tantalum anode.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polyaniline particles doped with polystyrene sulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia with a thickness of 3 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. A 3 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C. The thin 3 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. The stack shows stable operation over 50 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 650 to 800 degrees C. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 1.2 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 50 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polycarbonate and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The polymer matrix is polycarbonate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polycarbonate. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 20:1.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 3 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

assignee_db_group: BRIEXUS UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous niobium anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a niobium solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The p-toluenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 125 degrees C storage. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polyaniline layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The capacitor has a capacitance of 220 microfarads, a rated voltage of 25 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 20 milliohms at 100 kHz. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the niobium anode. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polyaniline particles doped with p-toluenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Wet coating method for forming a solid electrolyte layer on a release film and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: Provided is a slurry in which solid electrolyte particles are dispersed in heptane with a rubber binder and a dispersant. The synthesis comprises reacting the raw materials in a suspension with stirring and removing the residual solvent before the sheet is formed. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The release film is a PET film having a silicone release layer, and the dried layer is peeled from the release film and pressed onto an electrode. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and beta-Li3PS4. The binder content of 0.4 wt% to 2 wt% gives a peel strength of 0.1 N/cm or more and a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm. A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. In an embodiment the solid electrolyte layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The dispersant prevents agglomeration and improves the cycle life of the layer.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a solid electrolyte layer, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 0.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 1500 mPa s to 6000 mPa s, and wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 40 degrees C to 80 degrees C.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The confinement of molybdenum disulfide in the carbon nanotubes suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 85% of its capacity after 500 cycles is also described. The molybdenum disulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The molybdenum disulfide is melt-diffused into carbon nanotubes at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The carbon coating on the molybdenum disulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing molybdenum disulfide with carbon nanotubes; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the molybdenum disulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The active material nickel sulfide is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. With a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. Polysulfide dissolution from the nickel sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. A lithium-sulfur battery with the nickel sulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The graphene framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of nickel sulfide.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing nickel sulfide with graphene; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the nickel sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes and solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Described is an oxide ion-conductive solid whose decomposition current at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. The anodic decomposition product layer after 100 cycles is 10 nm or less and the capacity retention is 92%. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. The oxide particles have a core of the perovskite-type LLTO phase and a shell of 5 nm to 50 nm enriched in hafnium. Specific examples are Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the hafnium substitution and the surface region. A superionic Li6PS5X phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. Also described is a solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The widened electrochemical window improves the grain boundary resistance of a high-voltage lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.9 V or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.21 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 650 to 800 degrees C. The cell can be operated at 650 to 800 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Aluminum-doped garnet solid electrolyte sintered body with high relative density and method for producing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sintering method for a garnet solid electrolyte using a mother powder cover and a lithium excess of 5 mol%. When v is 0.4, the cubic phase fraction is 97% or more and the conductivity is 0.6 mS/cm. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between solid electrolyte particles during pressing. A lithium excess of 5 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. An argyrodite-type phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The densification improves the mechanical strength and the sinterability of the garnet layer.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.25 <= v <= 0.6, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 2 mol% to 10 mol%.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. The cell can be operated at 600 to 750 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 50 cycles. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Mixed-halide solid electrolyte of yttrium and hafnium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: A halide solid electrolyte comprises an orthorhombic crystal phase of a lithium metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Br6. The halide phase is free of a LiBr secondary phase and has a crystallite size of 30 nm to 300 nm. Suitable compositions include Li3InCl6. The hafnium substitution in an amount z of 0.2 to 0.45 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The halide shows an activation energy of 0.35 eV or less and a conductivity of 2.1 mS/cm. A glass prepared by quenching and partially crystallized to a thio-LISICON phase can be used in the electrode mixture. Compared with Li3YCl6, the substituted halide shows higher conductivity and better electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.47 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 300 degrees C, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.3 V or more.

title: tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the tantalum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the tantalum capacitor. The polypyrrole is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The equivalent series resistance is 5 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polypyrrole particles doped with polystyrene sulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: This disclosure concerns the synthesis of a sulfide ion conductor through dissolution and precipitation in a nonaqueous solvent. Suitable compositions include Li7P3S11, beta-Li3PS4, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The dried precipitate is heat-treated at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C in an argon atmosphere to convert the complex into the crystalline sulfide. A crystallized glass with a tetragonal phase may be added to improve the conductivity of the mixture. A halogen-rich argyrodite with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The dried precursor is heat-treated at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C for 1 hour to 6 hours and shows a conductivity of 2.1 mS/cm or more. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. The liquid-phase route yields fine particles with a narrow size distribution and improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 2.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 50 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by cold isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The cold isostatic pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The laminate of 8 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with Li3YCl6 and method for producing the same
abstract: Described is a cathode particle coated with a nanometer-thick Li3YCl6 shell that lowers the interfacial resistance. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. The electrode mixture of the all-solid-state battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. The ion-conductive component may be lithium niobate (LiNbO3). An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The core particles have a median diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and nickel content of 50 mol% or more. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium yttrium chloride (Li3YCl6) and has an average thickness of 4 nm to 20 nm and a coverage of 90% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The material comprises lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. The lithium yttrium chloride shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium yttrium chloride (Li3YCl6), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 30 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1 nm to 50 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 500 degrees C.
