The dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 47 microfarad rating. A capacitance of 47 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the aluminum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 600 MPa. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyethylene oxide matrix, lithium perchlorate as the lithium salt, and succinonitrile as a plasticizer. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C. The polyethylene oxide electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The membrane further contains a ceramic filler of Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet in an amount of 10 wt% to 30 wt% to form a composite electrolyte. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyethylene oxide chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. A power density of 1.5 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 700 to 850 degrees C operating range. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 700 to 850 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 700 to 850 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising samarium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by roll pressing
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more during cycling is described. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 2 cells and a case is also provided. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a aluminum current collector is also provided. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 600 to 750 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin samarium-doped ceria electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The cell can be operated at 600 to 750 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers. The solid electrolyte of samarium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 96% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 600 to 750 degrees C. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

assignee_db_group: BRIEXUS UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 30 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The membrane of 30 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 200 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 200 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a stainless steel current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a stainless steel current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia with a thickness of 3 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The reversible cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 0.8 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNb(1-z)TazO3 shell with high coverage and method for preparing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor includes core particles of a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide and a coating layer of amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3) disposed on the surface of the core particles. Suitable compositions include Li3InCl6 and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The material comprises Li3InCl6 and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 10 nm. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 95%. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. The lithium niobium tantalum oxide shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the high-voltage stability and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 4 nm to 20 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 1 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 45 degrees C. The 1.5 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 45 degrees C. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising fluoroethylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a stainless steel current collector and a primer layer
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by roll pressing and the release film is peeled. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The lithium battery is operated at 60 degrees C under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 300 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 100 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyacrylonitrile matrix. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The polyacrylonitrile electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 60 degrees C. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The membrane of 100 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyacrylonitrile and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Composite cathode comprising titanium disulfide and ketjen black and lithium secondary battery
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a titanium disulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided. The cathode with a loading of 5 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. Polysulfide dissolution from the titanium disulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the titanium disulfide cathode. With a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising titanium disulfide, ketjen black, and polyacrylic acid, wherein a loading of the titanium disulfide is 5 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The polyaniline is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polyaniline layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The dispersion of polyaniline gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 220 microfarad rating. The equivalent series resistance is 15 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The polyaniline layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 15 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of niobium; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polyaniline doped with polystyrene sulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 15 milliohms or less.

title: Amperometric carbon dioxide sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: An amperometric sensor in which carbon dioxide is pumped through a diffusion barrier by an oxide ion conducting ceramic is provided. The sensor with a response time of 20 seconds can monitor a lithium battery manufacturing line for carbon dioxide. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 400 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The carbon dioxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 400 degrees C. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising platinum, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of carbon dioxide.

title: Amperometric ammonia sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: Disclosed is a mixed potential type sensor in which an oxide electrode and a gold electrode on a zirconia substrate generate a potential difference depending on the ammonia concentration. The sensing electrode comprises gold and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite makes the sensor selective to ammonia against interfering gases. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of ammonia concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The sensor detects ammonia with high selectivity and a response time of 5 seconds.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising sodium nitrite in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects ammonia.

title: SiS2-containing vitreous sulfide solid electrolyte and heat treatment method
abstract: This disclosure concerns a Li2S-P2S5 glass of 72:28 composition that is converted by quenching and reheating into a crystallized conductor. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is thio-LISICON, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A Li6PS5X sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or thio-LISICON phase precipitates uniformly. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). After heat treatment at 240 degrees C for 1 hours, the conductivity rises from 0.2 mS/cm for the glass to 1.2 mS/cm. Precipitation of the metastable phase gives a conductivity higher than that of the glass, while the ionic conductivity is retained.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 4 hours, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 280 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyacrylonitrile and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polyacrylonitrile holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyacrylonitrile. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm are obtained. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyacrylonitrile matrix.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polyacrylonitrile and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 20 micrometers or less.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises titanium disulfide impregnated in porous carbon and a carbon coating on the composite. A lithium-sulfur battery with the titanium disulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The carbon coating on the titanium disulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The confinement of titanium disulfide in the porous carbon suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 100 cycles. The titanium disulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with porous carbon by ball milling. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the titanium disulfide cathode. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 600 mAh/g and retains 80% of the capacity after 100 cycles at 0.5 C.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising titanium disulfide, porous carbon, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the titanium disulfide is 4 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid comprises a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12 and Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. A crystallized Li2S-P2S5 glass containing a Li7P3S11 phase may be blended as a second conductor. A lithium excess of 15 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. When v is 0.5, the cubic phase fraction is 97% or more and the conductivity is 0.8 mS/cm. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The LLTO, Li2ZrO3, and LATP composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). A lithium battery using the garnet sintered body as a separator shows improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.35 <= v <= 0.7, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 12 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 1150 degrees C to 1300 degrees C.

title: Composite cathode comprising lithium sulfide and carbon nanotubes and lithium secondary battery
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a lithium sulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyacrylic acid in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The carbon nanotubes framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of lithium sulfide. The composite shows a capacity of 1200 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The cathode delivering 1200 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. In an embodiment the cathode is pressed against a sulfide solid electrolyte layer instead of a separator. The initial capacity of 1200 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia with a thickness of 5 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the scandia-stabilized zirconia cell. The solid electrolyte of scandia-stabilized zirconia is a dense ceramic of 98% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 98% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 98% or more.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for carbon dioxide with improved response time
abstract: Described is a thick film gas sensor whose sensing electrode is printed on a ceramic ion conductor. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 700 degrees C. The ceramic is lanthanum fluoride and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 700 degrees C. A lithium ion conducting glass may be used as the ceramic for a carbon dioxide sensor with a lithium carbonate auxiliary electrode. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 700 degrees C. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The multilayer structure with the lanthanum fluoride ceramic allows mass production by co-firing.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising lithium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects carbon dioxide.

title: Mixed potential type oxygen sensor and method of manufacturing the sensing electrode
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting oxygen comprises a lanthanum fluoride ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising platinum, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 400 degrees C. The protective layer improves the durability of the lanthanum fluoride sensor in an exhaust gas. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C. The sensing electrode comprises platinum and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting oxygen, comprising: a ceramic body comprising lanthanum fluoride; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 400 degrees C.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 10 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 10 micrometers. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 10 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The active material sulfur is combined with carbon nanotubes and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The positive electrode mixture comprises the sulfide active material, a sulfide solid electrolyte of Li6PS5Cl in an amount of 20 wt% to 40 wt%, and carbon, for use in an all-solid-state lithium-sulfur battery. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the sulfur cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 600 mAh/g and retains 80% of the capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5 C. The carbon nanotubes framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of sulfur. A separator coated with carbon nanotubes traps the polysulfides on the cathode side.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising sulfur and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 8 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 600 to 750 degrees C is described. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and samarium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The cell can be operated at 600 to 750 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: Described is a moisture-resistant sulfide in which the soft acid tin binds the sulfur and reduces reaction with water vapor. Specific examples are beta-Li3PS4 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. A solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The active material having a halide coating is mixed with the material in a weight ratio of 70:30 to 85:15. The synthesized powder is made into a self-supporting film by solvent-free rolling, and the film has a porosity of 10% or less. An H2S generation of 40 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 70% or more are obtained. The suppressed hydrolysis allows the sulfide to be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box, improving the moisture stability and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a tin substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.6 mS/cm or more.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte in which a thio-LISICON type crystal is embedded in a glass is described, together with a solid-state battery using it. The disclosure is applicable to Li7P3S11, argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The glass phase contains SiS2 in an amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the Li7P3S11 phase. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. The content of SiS2 is 3 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 280 degrees C, and the conductivity is 1.8 mS/cm or more. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 280 degrees C. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li7P3S11, Li6PS5Cl, and LGPS material. The solid electrolyte shows improved electrochemical window and cycle life compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 240 degrees C to 320 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The nickel sulfide is melt-diffused into ketjen black at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of nickel sulfide. With a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyacrylic acid. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the nickel sulfide cathode. The carbon coating on the nickel sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising nickel sulfide, ketjen black, and polyacrylic acid, wherein a loading of the nickel sulfide is 4 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Solvent-free free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet with fibrillated PTFE binder and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Provided is a sheet in which ion-conductive solid particles are held by PTFE fibrils formed by fibrillization during kneading. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. With a binder content of 2 wt% and a roll temperature of 80 degrees C, the sheet has a porosity of 30% or less. The powder is mixed with the PTFE binder at a roll temperature of 80 degrees C to form a continuous film. The sheet is calendered to a thickness of 32 micrometers to 160 micrometers and laminated onto an electrode by roll-pressing without a drying step. A superionic argyrodite phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The solvent-free sheet avoids the conductivity loss caused by polar solvents and improves the ionic conductivity and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the thickness of the sheet is 32 micrometers to 160 micrometers, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.3 MPa or more, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 0.7 mS/cm or more.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous aluminum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. A capacitance of 220 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the aluminum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The capacitor rated at 6.3 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Lithium metal negative electrode having an artificial interphase formed by thermal evaporation and production method thereof
abstract: A lithium metal negative electrode having a protective layer with a thickness of 80 nm to 400 nm and a lithium metal battery including the same are provided. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The inorganic layer has a thickness of 200 nm and the polymer layer has a thickness of 1 micrometers, giving an average Coulombic efficiency of 98.5% over 100 cycles. Specific examples are argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The inorganic layer suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments, while the polymer layer absorbs the cracks caused by volume change of the negative electrode. A silver or lithium nitride seed in the inorganic layer improves the wettability of molten lithium with a contact angle of 30 degrees or less. The protective layer suppresses the growth of lithium dendrites and improves the ionic conductivity of the lithium metal battery.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising silver-carbon composite (Ag-C) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.1 micrometers to 10 micrometers, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 20 nm to 1200 nm, and wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 125 cycles or more.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene. The polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a thermally crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium hexafluorophosphate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 20 micrometers or less.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method for forming a conductive polymer layer by impregnating a dielectric-coated anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the niobium anode. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. A capacitance of 220 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The niobium anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles doped with polystyrene sulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and method for producing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a sulfide solid electrolyte obtained by controlled crystallization of an amorphous Li2S-P2S5-SiS2 glass. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. An activation energy of 0.25 eV or less and a conductivity of 1.3 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C are obtained. The glass phase contains SiS2 in an amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The solid electrolyte is preferably beta-Li3PS4. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 70:30, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in a solid-state battery. Precipitation of the metastable phase gives a conductivity higher than that of the glass, while the electrochemical window is retained.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 24 hours, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 150 degrees C to 340 degrees C, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 10% to 100%.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 200 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. A lithium battery pack comprising 16 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 5 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 5 micrometers. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 5 micrometers and a relative density of 95%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 700 to 850 degrees C. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The cell can be operated at 700 to 850 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 5 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 3 micrometers. A 3 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 700 to 850 degrees C.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the tantalum capacitor. The anode body is a sintered pellet of tantalum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The polyaniline is doped with p-toluenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the tantalum anode. The equivalent series resistance is 15 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of tantalum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polyaniline doped with p-toluenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 15 milliohms or less.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet solid electrolyte using a mother powder
abstract: A sintered garnet pellet with a relative density of 92% and a method of hot pressing the same are described. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. The dopant gallium occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.25 to 0.6, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. The amount of the sintering aid is 2 wt%, the sintering temperature is 1250 degrees C, and the resulting density is 92%. The Li2ZrO3 material is used in a solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The material comprises lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. The dense garnet body suppresses lithium penetration along grain boundaries and improves the sinterability and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 5 mol% to 25 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an average grain size of 0.8 micrometers to 48 micrometers.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide solid electrolyte and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid electrolyte whose anodic decomposition at high potential is suppressed by a surface region of 5 nm to 50 nm. The electrochemical window measured by cyclic voltammetry on a blocking electrode extends to 5.5 V versus Li/Li+. A solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Suitable compositions include Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the tin substitution and the surface region. A capacity retention of 92% after 200 cycles at 4.6 V is obtained with the substituted oxide. The Li6PS5X phase may be combined with a halogen-rich sulfide to raise the superionic conductivity. The material is useful as a catholyte in a high-voltage positive electrode mixture, with improved high-voltage stability and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a phosphate-based NASICON phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 77% or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.4 mS/cm or more.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 20 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate based electrolyte of 20 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a thermally crosslinked network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 20 micrometers or less.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing alumina nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The lithium perchlorate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene matrix. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 1.2 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. The cell can be operated at 650 to 800 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The solid electrolyte layer of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C. The reversible cell with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 5 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet solid electrolyte using a mother powder
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant gallium stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. The total ionic conductivity is 0.7 mS/cm or more and the grain boundary resistance is 20% or less of the total resistance. The solid electrolyte may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. Devitrification of the amorphous phase is controlled by the heat treatment temperature. The garnet grains are bonded through a thin lithium borate or lithium fluoride phase at the grain boundaries. Also described is a solid-state lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The mixture for the solid electrolyte is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. The ion-conductive component may be Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO) and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). A lithium battery using the garnet sintered body as a separator shows improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.35 <= v <= 0.7, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 7 mol% to 15 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an average grain size of 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers.

title: semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 100 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm are obtained. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyethylene oxide chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The solid electrolyte membrane is a polymer that replaces the separator and the liquid electrolyte. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 8:1.

title: Solvent-free free-standing solid electrolyte sheet with fibrillated PTFE binder and production method thereof
abstract: A solid electrolyte sheet formed by fibrillating a polytetrafluoroethylene binder and a lithium secondary battery including the sheet are described. The powder is mixed with the PTFE binder at a roll temperature of 60 degrees C to form a continuous film. The kneading is performed at a shear rate of 100 s^-1 to 1000 s^-1 so that the PTFE is fibrillized into a network. A lithium metal anode can be used as the negative electrode because the reduction stability of the solid electrolyte is improved. A crystallized glass with a tetragonal phase may be added to improve the conductivity of the mixture. Suitable compositions include Li7P3S11 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. With a binder content of 1 wt% and a roll temperature of 60 degrees C, the sheet has a porosity of 10% or less. The obtained powder is cast as a slurry in a nonpolar solvent with a rubber binder on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. The sheet can be laminated onto an electrode without a drying step and improves the moisture stability and ionic conductivity of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 0.9 MPa or more, and wherein the porosity of the sheet is 20% or less, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 5 micrometers to 150 micrometers.

title: Lithium indium chloride-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material having a coating layer with a coverage of 85% or more and an average thickness of 2 nm to 10 nm is provided. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 5 nm. In an all-solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the interfacial resistance. The coated particles are heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 70 mol% or more of the transition metals. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. A glass prepared by quenching and partially crystallized to a thio-LISICON phase can be used in the electrode mixture. The lithium indium chloride shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 70 mol% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 2 nm to 10 nm.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.4 V is provided. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. With 0.5 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The capacity retention of 92% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Wet coating method for forming an ion-conductive solid layer on a release film
abstract: Provided is a slurry in which ion-conductive solid particles are dispersed in heptane with a rubber binder and a dispersant. The slurry is applied onto a release film at a coating speed of 1 m/min to 10 m/min and dried at 60 degrees C to 100 degrees C in an oven. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ion-conductive solid in the solid-state lithium battery. A hexachloride of yttrium or indium may serve as the catholyte. The ion-conductive solid powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 1 micrometers. The coating speed is 5 m/min and the layer dried at 60 degrees C to 100 degrees C has a thickness of 20 micrometers. The slurry has a solid content of 60 wt% to 80 wt% and a viscosity of 250 mPa s to 1000 mPa s at 25 degrees C, which is suitable for doctor blade casting. The Li3PS4 and LLZO material is used in a solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. The wet process is useful for forming a layer on a large area, with improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming an ion-conductive solid layer, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the solid content of the slurry is 60 wt% to 80 wt%, and wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 60 degrees C to 100 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 1.3 mS/cm or more.

title: Densified garnet oxide solid electrolyte and lithium battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sintering method for a garnet solid electrolyte using a mother powder cover and a lithium excess of 5 mol%. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. A solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. The mixture for the solid electrolyte is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The sintered body has a relative density of 92%, an average grain size of 10 micrometers, and a total conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. A lithium metal anode can be used as the negative electrode because the reduction stability of the solid electrolyte is improved. H2S generation upon exposure to humid air is reduced when a soft-acid element is present at the surface. Sintering is performed at 1250 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. The LLZO, LLTO, and LATP composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. The sintered garnet is useful as a dense separator against a lithium metal negative electrode, with improved ionic conductivity and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein 0.25 <= v <= 0.6, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 2 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a sintering temperature of 1170 degrees C to 1320 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Oxygen-substituted sulfide solid electrolyte powder with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and method of handling the same in a dry room
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte powder has a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which 1 mol% to 5 mol% of the sulfur is substituted by oxygen, the oxygen being enriched in a surface region having a thickness of 2 nm to 20 nm. The powder is prepared by mechanically milling Li2S, P2S5, and Li2O in a dry room having a dew point of -50 degrees C or lower, heat-treating the milled mixture at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C in argon, and exposing the heat-treated powder to an atmosphere having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 1 hour to 3 hours so that the surface region is formed by controlled hydrolysis. The P-O bonds in the surface region are stable against water vapor, so that the cumulative hydrogen sulfide generation measured in a sealed 1 L chamber after 60 minutes of exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C is 5 cm3/g or less, and the ionic conductivity retention after the exposure is 85% or more. Because the surface region is thin and lithium-ion conductive, the grain boundary resistance of a pressed pellet remains 20% or less of the total resistance. The powder can be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box and is applicable to Li6PS5Cl, Li3PS4, and LLZO-containing composite electrolytes.
first_claim: 1.
