The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive vinylene carbonate is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The 1.2 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 60 degrees C. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at 1.2 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.4 V. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M and vinylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using polytetrafluoroethylene and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more during cycling is described. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a stainless steel current collector is also provided. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The structure with the stainless steel current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 1.0 mS/cm. The anion is covalently bonded to the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The polymer matrix is poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. A solid electrolyte based on the polymer host is used without any ceramic component. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 100 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium perchlorate; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Described is a combination of fluoroethylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate at 1.0 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.3 V. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 3 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 3 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. With a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 90% of its capacity after 500 cycles is also described. The carbon coating on the iron sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using carboxymethyl cellulose. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 90%. A separator coated with graphene traps the polysulfides on the cathode side.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising graphene; iron sulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes and production method thereof
abstract: Described is an oxide ion-conductive solid whose decomposition current at 5 V is 4 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. The decomposition current density at 5 V is 4 microamperes per square centimeter or less and the capacity retention after 200 cycles is 80% or more. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. The ion-conductive solid may comprise beta-Li3PS4 and lithium fluoride (LiF). A halide coating layer may be used together with the ion-conductive solid to improve the cycle life of the solid-state battery. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. The suppression of anodic decomposition results in a stable interface and improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 80% or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.5 V or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.49 mS/cm or more.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide solid electrolyte and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: Disclosed is a sulfide solid electrolyte whose hydrogen sulfide generation upon exposure to humid air is 4 cm3/g or less. An H2S generation of 4 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 80% or more are obtained. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. In a lithium secondary battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The solid electrolyte powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 1 micrometers. Specific examples are beta-Li3PS4. The cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes of exposure to air with a dew point of -20 degrees C is 2 cm3/g. The material is useful for electrode slurry processing in a dry room, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 2 hours is 80% or more.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with LiNb(1-z)TazO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium niobium tantalum oxide formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. The Li3InCl6 material is used in a solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3) and has an average thickness of 1.2 nm to 6 nm and a coverage of 75% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. A coverage of 80% and a thickness of 3 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 50%. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. The Li3InCl6 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.2 nm to 6 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 75 mol% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 75% or more.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. A solid electrolyte of polypyrrole replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor. The capacitor rated at 16 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The polypyrrole layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 10 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the aluminum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The capacitor withstands 105 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polypyrrole particles doped with p-toluenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 30 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm are obtained. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 30 micrometers. The polymer electrolyte is laminated with a thin ceramic ion conductor layer to block dendrites.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, succinonitrile, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 8:1.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.4 V is provided. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 1 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive lithium difluorophosphate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate at 1.2 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.4 V. The combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising lithium difluorophosphate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 300 kPa
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a aluminum current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 300 kPa. A solid electrolyte sheet of 100 micrometers is used as the separator. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. A lithium battery pack comprising 2 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The cell operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. The thin 3 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.5 W/cm2. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 98%. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The stack of 100 cells can be paired with a lithium battery for load leveling. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 98% or more.

title: Potentiometric ammonia sensor having an auxiliary electrode of barium carbonate
abstract: Described is a thick film gas sensor whose sensing electrode is printed on a ceramic ion conductor. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 700 degrees C. The sensor detects ammonia with high selectivity and a response time of 5 seconds. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The solid electrolyte of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. The ceramic is gadolinium-doped ceria and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 700 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the gadolinium-doped ceria ceramic allows mass production by co-firing.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising gold, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of ammonia.

title: Gallium-doped garnet ceramic ion conductor sintered body with high relative density and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A sintered garnet pellet with a relative density of 92% and a method of hot pressing the same are described. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. A lithium excess of 8 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. The disclosure is applicable to lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The amount of the sintering aid is 2 wt%, the sintering temperature is 1230 degrees C, and the resulting density is 92%. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. The resulting Li2ZrO3 material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The sintered garnet is useful as a dense separator against a lithium metal negative electrode, with improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an average grain size of 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers, and wherein 0.1 <= v <= 0.45, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.28 mS/cm or more.

title: iron sulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a iron sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid. The confinement of iron sulfide in the porous carbon suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 100 cycles. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyacrylic acid. The cathode with a loading of 5 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The iron sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with porous carbon by ball milling. The composite shows a capacity of 1000 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising iron sulfide, porous carbon, and polyacrylic acid, wherein a loading of the iron sulfide is 5 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Composite cathode comprising sulfur and porous carbon and lithium secondary battery
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises sulfur impregnated in porous carbon and a carbon coating on the composite. The composite shows a capacity of 1400 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The sulfur particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with porous carbon by ball milling. A lithium-sulfur battery with the sulfur cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using carboxymethyl cellulose. The sulfur is melt-diffused into porous carbon at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The confinement of sulfur in the porous carbon suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising sulfur, porous carbon, and carboxymethyl cellulose, wherein a loading of the sulfur is 4 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyethylene oxide and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing titania nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm are obtained. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyethylene oxide chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 12:1.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate and a film-forming additive
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, lithium bis(oxalato)borate, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. With 2 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The stable passivation film formed by lithium bis(oxalato)borate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising lithium bis(oxalato)borate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.5 V is provided. The additive 1,3-propane sultone reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The additive 1,3-propane sultone is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. With 2 wt% of 1,3-propane sultone, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M and 1,3-propane sultone as an additive.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass ion-conductive solid containing a thio-LISICON phase and method for preparing the same
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid in which a thio-LISICON type crystal is embedded in a glass is described, together with an all-solid-state lithium battery using it. A precursor of the Li6PS5Cl, Li3PS4, and LGPS material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The Li6PS5Cl, Li3PS4, and LGPS composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. In an all-solid-state lithium battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the electrochemical window. Suitable compositions include argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, beta-Li3PS4, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. The ion-conductive solid powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and gives a pellet conductivity of 5.5 mS/cm after pressing at 360 MPa. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. Because the crystal phase is precipitated inside the glass, the grain boundary resistance is small and the electrochemical window is improved.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the content of P2O5 is 1 mol% to 4 mol%.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 30 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.5 mS/cm. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 100 micrometers. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 50 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The warm isostatic pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The current collector of stainless steel is used in a lithium battery with a 50 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 60 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A glassy sulfide ceramic ion conductor with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. Suitable compositions include Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), beta-Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 300 degrees C. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of an argyrodite component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. The LGPS, Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 75:25, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 12 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 50% to 85% by X-ray diffraction. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ceramic ion conductor powder. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. The P2O5 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the moisture stability and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of P2O5 is 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises molybdenum disulfide impregnated in ketjen black and a carbon coating on the composite. The carbon coating on the molybdenum disulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g and retains 85% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of molybdenum disulfide. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and carboxymethyl cellulose. The sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising molybdenum disulfide, ketjen black, and carboxymethyl cellulose, wherein a loading of the molybdenum disulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Crystallized sulfide crystallized glass ion conductor containing a beta-Li3PS4 phase and method for preparing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a sulfide ceramic ion conductor obtained by controlled crystallization of an amorphous Li2S-P2S5-GeS2 glass. The glass phase contains GeS2 in an amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the beta-Li3PS4 phase. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 4 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 50% to 85% by X-ray diffraction. A wet-chemical synthesis through a solvate complex precipitate gives a fine sulfide powder. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4 and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. The raw materials of the ceramic ion conductor are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. In an embodiment the material is beta-Li3PS4 and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. The glassy matrix absorbs volume change of the electrode and improves the moisture stability of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 4 hours, and wherein the content of GeS2 is 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous tantalum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 330 microfarad rating. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the tantalum capacitor. The equivalent series resistance is 10 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the tantalum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous tantalum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide solid electrolyte using ethyl propionate
abstract: Provided is a method in which a solvate complex of Li3PS4 is precipitated from ethyl propionate, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated. The dried precipitate is heat-treated at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C in an argon atmosphere to convert the complex into the crystalline sulfide. An all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the Li3PS4 and Li7P3S11 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. A precursor of the Li3PS4 and Li7P3S11 material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The dried precursor is heat-treated at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C for 1 hour to 6 hours and shows a conductivity of 2.1 mS/cm or more. The dissolution of P2S5 in the solvent is followed by precipitation of a complex that contains one to three solvent molecules per formula unit. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. The solid electrolyte is preferably beta-Li3PS4 and Li7P3S11. A halide coating layer may be used together with the solid electrolyte to improve the cycle life of the all-solid-state lithium battery. The solvate route lowers the processing temperature and improves the ionic conductivity of the product.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl propionate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 2.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 2.5 wt% to 10 wt%.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The cold isostatic pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 100 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by nitrile butadiene rubber. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The current collector of nickel-plated copper is used in a lithium battery with a 100 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C.

assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Positive electrode active material with lithium tungstate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and method for producing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium tungstate and to a method for producing the same. The Li2ZrO3, Li3InCl6, and LiNbO3 material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 60 mol% or more of the transition metals. The core particles have a median diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and nickel content of 60 mol% or more. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4) and has an average thickness of 2 nm to 10 nm and a coverage of 90% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. Because no solvent is used, a dry process is applicable to the formation of the layer from the obtained powder. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. Because the shell is amorphous and continuous, the growth of interfacial resistance is reduced and the cycle life is improved.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 60 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 2 nm to 10 nm, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 50% or more.

title: Solid electrolyte oxygen sensor element with a heater and protective layer
abstract: Described is a thick film gas sensor whose sensing electrode is printed on a ceramic ion conductor. The limiting current is proportional to the ammonia concentration from 0.1% to 20%. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 700 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the yttria-stabilized zirconia ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The ammonia sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 700 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium nitrite and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising sodium nitrite in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects ammonia.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. The solid electrolyte layer of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 3 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. The reversible cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. The capacitor withstands 105 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The polystyrene sulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 105 degrees C storage. The capacitor rated at 35 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the aluminum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. The aluminum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles doped with polystyrene sulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Halide solid electrolyte having a close-packed chloride sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: A halide ion conductor having the composition Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6, wherein z is 0.3 to 0.55, and a method for producing the same are provided. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiCl, YCl3, and HfCl4 followed by heat treatment at 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. The Li3YCl6 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state lithium battery. The solid electrolyte powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers. Suitable compositions include Li3YCl6. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. After dehydration under vacuum at 300 degrees C, the water content is 0.5 wt% or less and the conductivity is 0.8 mS/cm. The close-packed anion sublattice gives a low activation energy and improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.1 V or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.56 mS/cm or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 200 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The uniaxial pressing step at 200 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 20 micrometers. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Lithium metal negative electrode having an artificial interphase formed by sputtering and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an artificial interphase formed on a lithium metal negative electrode by sputtering. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li3YCl6. A silver or lithium nitride seed in the inorganic layer improves the wettability of molten lithium with a contact angle of 30 degrees or less. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. The ceramic ion conductor may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. In an all-solid-state battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. The inorganic layer comprises lithium fluoride or lithium phosphorus oxynitride and has a thickness of 50 nm. The inorganic layer has a conductivity of 5 x 10^-6 S/cm, and the cell shows a Coulombic efficiency of 99.5% after 100 cycles. The polymer layer keeps the contact during volume change and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising aluminum oxide deposited by atomic layer deposition (Al2O3) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97.5% or more, and wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 125 cycles or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.05 micrometers to 5 micrometers.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate and a film-forming additive
abstract: Described is a combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V. The additive lithium difluorophosphate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 85% of its capacity after 500 cycles. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Ceramic ion conductor slurry with controlled viscosity and solid content for doctor blade casting
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a slurry composition with controlled viscosity and solid content for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer. The wet film is dried at 80 degrees C and the dried layer has a thickness of 6 micrometers to 30 micrometers. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. In an embodiment the material is beta-Li3PS4. The release film is a PET film having a silicone release layer, and the dried layer is peeled from the release film and pressed onto an electrode. The dried layer shows an ionic conductivity of 0.6 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a thickness of 15 micrometers. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. The wet process is useful for forming a layer on a large area, with improved sheet formability and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a polyisobutylene binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 60 degrees C to 100 degrees C, and wherein the thickness of the dried layer is 6 micrometers to 30 micrometers, and wherein the slurry has a binder content of 0.8 wt% to 4 wt%.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 2 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar aluminum current collectors. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 20 micrometer separator layer. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by roll pressing. The electrode laminate pressed at 200 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 2 stacked cells.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C. The reversible cell with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The solid electrolyte layer of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The stack shows stable operation over 50 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 600 to 750 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%. A power density of 1.0 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 600 to 750 degrees C operating range.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and carboxymethyl cellulose binder
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which titanium disulfide is confined in the pores of carbon nanotubes to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 90%. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 90% of its capacity after 500 cycles is also described. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 600 mAh/g and retains 90% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. The initial capacity of 600 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. Polysulfide dissolution from the titanium disulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The carbon coating on the titanium disulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising carbon nanotubes; titanium disulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: An amorphous sulfide containing germanium or silicon sulfide is crystallized to form a solid electrolyte of high conductivity. The cell may include a lithium nucleation additive to prevent short circuit. Specific examples are argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The glass transition temperature is 200 degrees C, the crystallization onset is 260 degrees C, and the conductivity reaches 2.5 mS/cm. The material comprises argyrodite Li6PS5Cl in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li6PS5Cl material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The solid electrolyte powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The solid electrolyte shows improved electrochemical window compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 16 hours, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 170 degrees C to 360 degrees C.

title: Argyrodite sulfide solid electrolyte with mixed chlorine-bromine substitution
abstract: This disclosure provides an argyrodite solid electrolyte whose anion sublattice is partially disordered by mixed chlorine-bromine substitution. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. The bromine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. Examples of the ion conductor include argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The argyrodite phase has a cubic lattice and a conductivity of 8.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C measured by AC impedance on a pressed pellet. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.24 or less, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C.

title: Surface mount solid electrolytic capacitor and method of reducing leakage current
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor. The capacitor has a capacitance of 220 microfarads, a rated voltage of 25 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 10 milliohms at 100 kHz. The dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 220 microfarad rating. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The aluminum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a iron sulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 80% of its capacity after 100 cycles is also described. The sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1000 mAh/g and retains 80% of the capacity after 100 cycles at 0.5 C. The carbon coating on the iron sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The iron sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. A separator coated with ketjen black traps the polysulfides on the cathode side.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising iron sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the aluminum anode. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. A capacitance of 470 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

assignee_db_group: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Halide solid electrolyte having a close-packed chloride sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: A rare earth metal halide solid electrolyte with cation disorder and a hexachloride framework is described. In the monoclinic structure, yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites of the close-packed chloride sublattice, and the cation disorder is 10% or more. A crystallized glass with a tetragonal phase may be added to improve the conductivity of the mixture. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. The oxidation stability limit is 4.1 V or more and the conductivity is 1.05 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C. A battery using the halide in the positive electrode mixture shows improved ionic conductivity and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.1 V or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.05 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 150 degrees C to 250 degrees C.

assignee_raw: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Hafnium-substituted lithium yttrium bromide solid electrolyte with monoclinic structure and production method thereof
abstract: This disclosure concerns a mixed-halide solid electrolyte of yttrium and hafnium that is stable against oxidation up to 4.2 V. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.15 micrometers to 1.5 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. An interlayer of a lithium-ion conductive polymer may be inserted to improve the contact at the interface. A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. Specific examples are Li3InCl6. The halide phase is free of a LiBr secondary phase and has a crystallite size of 30 nm to 300 nm. The Li3InCl6 material is used in a solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. After dehydration under vacuum at 300 degrees C, the water content is 0.5 wt% or less and the conductivity is 1.2 mS/cm. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. A battery using the halide in the positive electrode mixture shows improved moisture stability and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0.2 <= z <= 0.45, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more.

title: iron sulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which iron sulfide is confined in the pores of graphene to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid. The confinement of iron sulfide in the graphene suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. A separator coated with graphene traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g and retains 90% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. The iron sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with graphene by ball milling. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyacrylic acid.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing iron sulfide with graphene; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the iron sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for hydrogen with improved response time
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting hydrogen comprises a sodium beta-alumina ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 500 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of sodium beta-alumina conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 500 degrees C. The sensor detects hydrogen with high selectivity and a response time of 2 seconds. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The sensing electrode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising barium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects hydrogen.

title: Method for forming an ion-conductive solid film by powder-to-film rolling without solvent
abstract: A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet having a thickness of 12 micrometers to 60 micrometers and a porosity of 10% or less is provided. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. The binder content is 1.2 wt% to 6 wt%, which gives a tensile strength of 3 MPa and a conductivity of 1 mS/cm. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ion-conductive solid powder. In a lithium secondary battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the interfacial resistance. The material comprises Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and the sheet is self-supporting and can be wound on a core having a diameter of 50 mm. The dry sheet is useful as a separator layer for roll-to-roll production, with improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 1.8 MPa or more, and wherein the porosity of the sheet is 10% or less, and wherein the free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet has a roll temperature of 50 degrees C to 110 degrees C.

title: Crystallized sulfide crystallized glass ion conductor containing a beta-Li3PS4 phase for lithium battery
abstract: A glassy sulfide ceramic ion conductor with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The glass phase contains LiI in an amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the beta-Li3PS4 phase. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4 and Li7P3S11 in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. A halogen-rich Li6PS5X with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The crystallized glass has an ionic conductivity of 2.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a degree of crystallinity of 50%. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in a solid-state battery. A solid-state battery containing the crystallized glass shows improved cycle life and rate performance.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 190 degrees C to 380 degrees C.

title: Lithium niobate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and method for producing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a coated positive electrode active material whose LiNbO3 shell suppresses the interfacial reaction with a sulfide ceramic ion conductor. A precursor of the Li3InCl6 and Li6PS5Cl material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 80%. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 15 nm. The cell may include a lithium nucleation additive to prevent short circuit. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and has an average thickness of 6 nm to 30 nm and a coverage of 75% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li3InCl6 and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The Li3InCl6 and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. A lithium secondary battery using the coated active material shows improved electrochemical window and interfacial resistance and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 75% or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 16 stacked cells
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more during cycling is described. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The laminate of 16 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified.
first_claim: 1.
