The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the niobium anode. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The niobium capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The capacitor has a capacitance of 330 microfarads, a rated voltage of 35 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 10 milliohms at 100 kHz.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a niobium anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 35 V.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor element with a polypyrrole layer and a carbon cathode layer
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor. The tantalum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The anode body is a sintered pellet of tantalum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The polypyrrole layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 5 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The equivalent series resistance is 5 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The tantalum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of tantalum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polypyrrole doped with polystyrene sulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 5 milliohms or less.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass ion-conductive solid containing a Li7P3S11 phase and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a Li7P3S11 phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing SiS2. An activation energy of 0.25 eV or less and a conductivity of 2.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C are obtained. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 320 degrees C. The glass phase contains SiS2 in an amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the Li7P3S11 phase. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The Li3PS4 and LGPS material is used in a solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. The ion-conductive solid shows improved moisture stability compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of SiS2 is 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 8 hours, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polycarbonate matrix, lithium perchlorate as the lithium salt, and succinonitrile as a plasticizer. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The polycarbonate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polycarbonate.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using polytetrafluoroethylene and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 2 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte with low residual solvent and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte with a residual solvent content of 0.3 wt% or less. The material comprises Li7P3S11, which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. The cubic Li6PS5X structure tolerates chlorine and bromine on the 4a and 4d sites. The Li7P3S11 material is used in a solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The reaction at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C for 24 hours gives a precipitate yield of 95% or more. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure. The ion-conductive component may be Li7P3S11. The solvate route lowers the processing temperature and improves the moisture stability of the product.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in acetonitrile to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 7.5 wt% to 30 wt%, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less.

title: Method for producing an ion-conductive solid sheet by slurry casting and peeling
abstract: This disclosure concerns a slurry for forming an ion-conductive solid layer that has a solid content of 30 wt% to 50 wt% and a viscosity of 1500 mPa s to 6000 mPa s. A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. The binder content of 1.2 wt% to 6 wt% gives a peel strength of 0.1 N/cm or more and a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm. An all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the LLZO and Li6PS5Cl material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The wet film is dried at 60 degrees C and the dried layer has a thickness of 12 micrometers to 60 micrometers. The slurry allows roll-to-roll production of the layer and improves the cycle life and interfacial resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming an ion-conductive solid layer, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the slurry has a binder content of 1.2 wt% to 6 wt%, and wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 40 degrees C to 80 degrees C, and wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 1500 mPa s to 6000 mPa s.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass solid electrolyte containing a Li7P3S11 phase and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Provided is a solid electrolyte comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable Li7P3S11 crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 60%. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or Li7P3S11 phase precipitates uniformly. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 8 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 40% to 75% by X-ray diffraction. In an embodiment the material is Li7P3S11. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between solid electrolyte particles during pressing. Because the crystal phase is precipitated inside the glass, the grain boundary resistance is small and the cycle life is improved.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 40% to 75%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 8 hours, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.8 mS/cm or more.

assignee_raw: Hwaseol National Research Institute Of Energy Materials
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS
title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li2ZrO3 shell with high coverage and production method thereof
abstract: Disclosed is a coated positive electrode active material whose Li2ZrO3 shell suppresses the interfacial reaction with a sulfide ion-conductive solid. Examples of the ion conductor include argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and lithium niobate (LiNbO3). The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. The reduction of the interfacial resistance is 30% or more, and the interfacial resistance after 50 cycles at 4.3 V is 30 ohm cm2 or less. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ion-conductive solid in the all-solid-state battery. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. Because the shell is amorphous and continuous, the growth of interfacial resistance is reduced and the high-voltage stability is improved.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 40 mol% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 65% or more.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: Described is a moisture-resistant sulfide in which the soft acid tin binds the sulfur and reduces reaction with water vapor. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. The LLZO, Li6PS5Cl, and Li7P3S11 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state lithium battery. The disclosure is applicable to Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and Li7P3S11. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers and a conductivity of 4.5 mS/cm. Ball milling of the raw materials for the LLZO, Li6PS5Cl, and Li7P3S11 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. The soft-acid surface region improves the air stability and the ionic conductivity and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a tin substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 20 cm3/g or less.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a beta-Li3PS4 phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing GeS2. The precipitated beta-Li3PS4 phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of an argyrodite-type component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. A dendrite-suppressing additive such as magnesium or zinc may be placed at the lithium metal interface. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ion-conductive solid layer of the all-solid-state battery. The glass phase contains GeS2 in an amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the beta-Li3PS4 phase. An all-solid-state battery comprising the Li3PS4 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The material is useful as a separator layer or as a conductive component of an electrode, with improved ionic conductivity and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of GeS2 is 0.4 mol% to 8 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 8 hours.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 98% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. A 3 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. A power density of 0.8 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 200 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The laminate of 8 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The structure with the stainless steel current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with LiNbO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous LiNbO3 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. The Li2ZrO3 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. The solid electrolyte may comprise lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The core particles have a median diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and nickel content of 50 mol% or more. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 50 mol% or more of the transition metals. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. A lithium secondary battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved cycle life. The lithium niobate shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobate (LiNbO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 40% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 85% or more.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide solid electrolyte powder
abstract: Disclosed is a liquid-phase synthesis in which lithium sulfide and phosphorus pentasulfide react in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to give a sulfide solid electrolyte precursor. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material. The material comprises Li7P3S11, beta-Li3PS4, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. The suspension concentration is 10 wt%, the reaction temperature is 40 degrees C, and the drying temperature is 150 degrees C. The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. The suspension has a solid concentration of 5 wt% to 20 wt% and is reacted at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. The synthesized powder is made into a self-supporting film by solvent-free rolling, and the film has a porosity of 10% or less. The ion-conductive component may be Li7P3S11, beta-Li3PS4, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). Dissolution and precipitation give a homogeneous composition and improved ionic conductivity and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.5 wt% or less, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 5 wt% to 20 wt%.

title: Electrochemical gas sensor with a yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte for detecting oxygen
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting oxygen comprises a yttria-stabilized zirconia ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising gold, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The protective layer improves the durability of the yttria-stabilized zirconia sensor in an exhaust gas. The sensing electrode comprises gold and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The sensor detects oxygen with high selectivity and a response time of 10 seconds. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature. The sensor shows a response time of 10 seconds to a step change of oxygen concentration at 300 degrees C. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising gold, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of oxygen.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by cold isostatic pressing
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a nickel-plated copper current collector is also provided. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The cold isostatic pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium iron phosphate, and a conductive agent. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Negative electrode structure with uniform lithium nucleation and high critical current density
abstract: A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising an ion-conductive solid comprises a lithium metal layer, an ion-conductive solid layer, and an additive comprising silver dispersed at the interface to form uniform nucleation sites. A germanium-free glass of the Li2S-P2S5 system may be used as a binder-like deformable phase. The sulfide component may be prepared by a liquid-phase route in tetrahydrofuran or acetonitrile. The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLZO material. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. The additive content is 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, the stack pressure is 1 MPa to 4 MPa, and the critical current density is 2 mA/cm2. The additive forms an alloy with lithium during plating, which provides uniform nucleation sites and suppresses filament formation. The ion-conductive component may be Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A stack pressure of 1 MPa to 4 MPa is applied so that void formation at the interface during stripping is suppressed. A solid-state lithium cell using the structure shows improved interfacial resistance and operates at a lower stack pressure.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising an ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium metal layer; an ion-conductive solid layer; and an additive comprising silver dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ion-conductive solid layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the content of the silver additive is 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 1.4 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 1 MPa to 4 MPa.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate dissolved in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive in an amount of 0.5 wt%. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V. The capacity retention of 90% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 60 degrees C. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate at 1.0 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.5 V. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia with a thickness of 10 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The thin 10 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. The yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 10 micrometers and a relative density of 95%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of titanium disulfide. A separator coated with ketjen black traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the titanium disulfide cathode. The titanium disulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. The composite shows a capacity of 600 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 90% of its capacity after 200 cycles is also described.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing titanium disulfide with ketjen black; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the titanium disulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and solid-state battery including the same
abstract: Provided is an ion-conductive solid comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable Li7P3S11 crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 80%. The content of SiS2 is 2 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 300 degrees C, and the conductivity is 0.8 mS/cm or more. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is Li7P3S11, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. Also described is a solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. The ion-conductive component may be beta-Li3PS4 and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The ion-conductive solid is a lithium ion conducting material for a solid-state battery. Because the crystal phase is precipitated inside the glass, the grain boundary resistance is small and the cycle life is improved.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 8 hours.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The lithium salt is lithium perchlorate and the membrane has a thickness of 30 micrometers. The polyethylene oxide electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by roll pressing
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by roll pressing at 100 MPa and 25 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The structure with the nickel-plated copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 2 stacked cells. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The stable passivation film formed by 1,3-propane sultone suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 45 degrees C. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 45 degrees C. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and carboxymethyl cellulose binder
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using carboxymethyl cellulose. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the sulfur cathode. The active material sulfur is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 600 mAh/g and retains 80% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the sulfur cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The sulfur particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with graphene by ball milling.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising sulfur, graphene, and carboxymethyl cellulose, wherein a loading of the sulfur is 4 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Described is a combination of fluoroethylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 300 cycles is 92% with the electrolyte. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 2 wt%.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 90% of its capacity after 300 cycles. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with alumina nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyacrylonitrile matrix, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and an ionic liquid as a plasticizer. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 1.0 mS/cm. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyacrylonitrile.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyacrylonitrile; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: Disclosed is a liquid-phase synthesis in which lithium sulfide and phosphorus pentasulfide react in ethyl propionate to give a sulfide ceramic ion conductor precursor. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C under reduced pressure. The material comprises Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 3 micrometers and a conductivity of 2.2 mS/cm. A lithium secondary battery comprising the LGPS material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The liquid-phase route yields fine particles with a narrow size distribution and improved ionic conductivity and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl propionate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 4 wt% to 16 wt%, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate is added in an amount of 3 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The capacity retention of 85% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium bis(oxalato)borate. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V. With 3 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising lithium bis(oxalato)borate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 15 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 500 to 650 degrees C is described. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 500 to 650 degrees C. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite-type solid electrolyte and lithium battery and all-solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure provides an argyrodite-type solid electrolyte whose anion sublattice is partially disordered by mixed chlorine-bromine substitution. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm. The solid electrolyte may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. The material comprises Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and Li7P3S11, wherein the argyrodite-type crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, chlorine, and bromine. The LGPS and Li7P3S11 material is used in an all-solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The solid electrolyte may comprise Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and Li7P3S11. A germanium-free glass of the Li2S-P2S5 system may be used as a binder-like deformable phase. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the moisture stability of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The membrane of 100 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyethylene oxide and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 100 micrometers. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained. The 100 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 8:1.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyethylene oxide matrix, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and succinonitrile as a plasticizer. The lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyethylene oxide matrix. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 100 micrometers. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyethylene oxide; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: Lithium metal halide ceramic ion conductor represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Ti(z)Cl6 and method for preparing the same
abstract: A halide ceramic ion conductor comprises a monoclinic crystal phase of a lithium metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Ti(z)Cl6. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LiF, Li3InCl6, and Li3YCl6 material. The sulfide may be substituted with tin or oxygen to improve the moisture stability and suppress hydrogen sulfide generation. After dehydration under vacuum at 300 degrees C, the water content is 0.5 wt% or less and the conductivity is 0.8 mS/cm. After ball milling, the ceramic ion conductor precursor is pressed and sintered. In the monoclinic structure, erbium and titanium occupy octahedral sites of the close-packed chloride sublattice, and the cation disorder is 10% or more. The halide is useful as a catholyte and as a separator facing the positive electrode, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Er(1-z)Ti(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which erbium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 3.7 V or more, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.32 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 180 degrees C to 420 degrees C.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition and lithium battery
abstract: An oxide ion-conductive solid that remains stable up to 4.8 V and a lithium battery with a high-voltage cathode are provided. The oxidation potential is 4.8 V versus Li/Li+, the decomposition current at 5 V is 2 microamperes per square centimeter, and the conductivity is 1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The Li3PS4 and LLZO material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. Examples of the ion conductor include beta-Li3PS4 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The oxide particles have a core of the phosphate-based NASICON phase and a shell of 5 nm to 50 nm enriched in hafnium. The mixture for the ion-conductive solid is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The surface region acts as an oxidation barrier and improves the cycle life and interfacial resistance of the electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a phosphate-based NASICON phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: P2O5-containing vitreous sulfide ceramic ion conductor and heat treatment method
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor in which a thio-LISICON type crystal is embedded in a glass is described, together with a lithium secondary battery using it. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. The heat treatment time is 0.5 hours to 20 hours, which gives a crystallinity of 60% to 95% by X-ray diffraction. The disclosure is applicable to beta-Li3PS4 and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The glass phase contains P2O5 in an amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Crystallization is performed at 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 20 hours, which precipitates a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The P2O5 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours, and wherein the content of P2O5 is 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M and a film-forming additive. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 60 degrees C. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The additive lithium difluorophosphate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.2 M and adding lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 300 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a stainless steel current collector is also provided. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The uniaxial pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 300 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 300 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a moisture-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor and to a method of handling it in a dry room. The substitution amount is 2 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 550 degrees C, and the conductivity is 2.2 mS/cm or more. An all-solid-state battery comprising the LLZO, Li3PS4, and Li6PS5Cl material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), beta-Li3PS4, and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 10 cm3/g or less. The disclosure is applicable to Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), beta-Li3PS4, and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. The soft-acid surface region improves the air stability and the sinterability and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an arsenic-free antimony substitution amount of 0.4 mol% to 8 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 650 degrees C, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous Li2ZrO3 shell with high coverage and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium zirconate formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and lithium fluoride (LiF). A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. The coating layer has an average thickness of 8 nm and a coverage of 85%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 50% relative to uncoated particles. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium zirconate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 75 mol% or more of the transition metals. The coated cathode is useful in a sulfide-based positive electrode mixture, with improved interfacial resistance and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 75 mol% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 40% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 20 micrometers. The polyacrylonitrile electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The titania nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyacrylonitrile. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 8:1.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 20 micrometers. The lithium salt is lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 20 micrometers. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.5 mS/cm.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polycarbonate; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The polyethylene oxide electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The polymer matrix is polyethylene oxide and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 12:1. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Solid electrolyte oxygen sensor element with a heater and protective layer
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting hydrogen comprises a gadolinium-doped ceria ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising platinum, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the platinum sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The auxiliary electrode of barium carbonate makes the sensor selective to hydrogen against interfering gases. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 700 degrees C. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The protective layer improves the durability of the gadolinium-doped ceria sensor in an exhaust gas. The sensing electrode comprises platinum and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting hydrogen, comprising: a ceramic body comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 700 degrees C.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the gadolinium-doped ceria cell. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C. A power density of 1.5 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 600 to 750 degrees C operating range. The solid electrolyte of gadolinium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 95% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The laminate of 4 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The cold isostatic pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module. A solid electrolyte sheet of 30 micrometers is used as the separator.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa and 60 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Bilayer protection of metallic lithium with an inorganic LiF layer and a fluorinated polymer
abstract: A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode comprises an inorganic layer of lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer. A precursor of the Li3PS4 and LiF material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. The bilayer with a total thickness of 1 micrometer gives 500 cycles of stable plating and stripping. The protective layer is deposited on a lithium foil of 20 micrometers thickness under an argon atmosphere. A titanium-containing oxide whose reduction is suppressed may be combined with the material. In an embodiment the material is beta-Li3PS4 and lithium fluoride (LiF). The disclosure further provides a solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3PS4 and LiF material. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. The inorganic layer is formed by sputtering to a thickness of 40 nm to 200 nm and has an ionic conductivity of 5 x 10^-6 S/cm or more at 25 degrees C. The bilayer structure improves the ionic conductivity and interfacial resistance compared with a single inorganic layer.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 1 micrometers to 6 micrometers, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 98.8% or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 40 nm to 200 nm.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 90% with the electrolyte. With 2 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate, the capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change. The capacity retention of 90% after 1000 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium bis(oxalato)borate. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by roll pressing and the release film is peeled. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by roll pressing. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The thin 10 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 0.8 W/cm2. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 10 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 10 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 30 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm are obtained. The membrane of 30 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium perchlorate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 60 degrees C. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The 1.0 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V. The additive vinylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. With 1 wt% of vinylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%.
