The limiting current is proportional to the carbon dioxide concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The multilayer structure with the NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The lanthanum strontium manganite electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 700 degrees C. The ceramic is NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 700 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising lithium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects carbon dioxide.

title: Densified garnet oxide ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant niobium stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The dopant niobium occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.25 to 0.6, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. Specific examples are Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). The material comprises Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. A core-shell cathode particle with a nanometer-thick LiNbO3 coating of high coverage is used on the positive electrode side. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ceramic ion conductor particles during pressing. Sintering at 1250 degrees C with a lithium excess of 15 mol% gives a relative density of 94% and a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The dense garnet body suppresses lithium penetration along grain boundaries and improves the grain boundary resistance and high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a lithium excess of 12 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a relative density of 91% or more, and wherein 0.25 <= v <= 0.6.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 8 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 700 to 850 degrees C is described. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 700 to 850 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers. The samarium-doped ceria electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising samarium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by uniaxial pressing and the release film is peeled. A lithium battery pack comprising 8 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and polyvinylidene fluoride binder
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, porous carbon, and polyvinylidene fluoride is described. The sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 3 mg/cm2. A solid electrolyte interphase is formed on the lithium metal negative electrode during the first cycles. With a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The initial capacity of 800 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing molybdenum disulfide with porous carbon; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the molybdenum disulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and method for producing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a Li2S-P2S5 glass of 80:20 composition that is converted by quenching and reheating into a crystallized conductor. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. After heat treatment at 280 degrees C for 2 hours, the conductivity rises from 0.2 mS/cm for the glass to 1.2 mS/cm. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. The ion-conductive solid is a lithium ion conducting material for a solid-state battery. The SiS2 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 8 hours, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 60% to 95%.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 600 kPa
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and polytetrafluoroethylene are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The warm isostatic pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The current collector of aluminum is used in a lithium battery with a 100 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. With 0.5 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate, the capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The stable passivation film formed by lithium bis(oxalato)borate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia with a thickness of 10 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The cell operates at 700 to 850 degrees C with a power density of 0.8 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 10 micrometers. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The thin 10 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 0.8 W/cm2. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 97%.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Wet coating method for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer on a release film and method for preparing the same
abstract: A wet film of a ceramic ion conductor cast on a PET release film and dried in an oven is described. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The binder is polyisobutylene in an amount of 1.2 wt% to 6 wt% and is dissolved in the nonpolar solvent heptane. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. The powder is formed into a sheet by kneading with a fibrillated PTFE binder and roll-pressing without a solvent to a thickness of 30 micrometers to 80 micrometers. The coating speed is 5 m/min and the layer dried at 100 degrees C to 140 degrees C has a thickness of 30 micrometers. The controlled viscosity gives a uniform thickness and improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a polyisobutylene binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the thickness of the dried layer is 12 micrometers to 60 micrometers, and wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 100 degrees C to 140 degrees C, and wherein the slurry has a binder content of 1.2 wt% to 6 wt%.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polycarbonate matrix, lithium hexafluorophosphate as the lithium salt, and an ionic liquid as a plasticizer. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The anion is covalently bonded to the polycarbonate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The polycarbonate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The lithium hexafluorophosphate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polycarbonate matrix.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 3 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 500 to 650 degrees C is described. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the gadolinium-doped ceria cell. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 3 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene matrix, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and an ionic liquid as a plasticizer. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The solid electrolyte membrane is a polymer that replaces the separator and the liquid electrolyte. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 12:1.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. A lithium battery pack comprising 4 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 50 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by nitrile butadiene rubber. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 100 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The current collector of stainless steel is used in a lithium battery with a 20 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The uniaxial pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Zirconium-substituted lithium scandium bromide ion-conductive solid with monoclinic structure and method for preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a mixed-halide ion-conductive solid of scandium and zirconium that is stable against oxidation up to 4.5 V. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. The oxidation stability limit is 4.3 V or more and the conductivity is 0.56 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C. The zirconium substitution in an amount z of 0.02 to 0.25 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of an argyrodite component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. Also described is a solid-state lithium battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. The ion-conductive solid is preferably lithium fluoride (LiF). The water-mediated synthesis allows scalable production while retaining the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Sc(1-z)Zr(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which scandium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.56 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C, and wherein 0.02 <= z <= 0.25.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 30 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The polycarbonate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The membrane of 30 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polycarbonate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polycarbonate based electrolyte of 30 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polycarbonate.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa through an elastic sheet. The lithium battery is operated at 25 degrees C under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The uniaxial pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Hafnium-substituted lithium yttrium chloride ceramic ion conductor with monoclinic structure for lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a mixed-halide ceramic ion conductor of yttrium and hafnium that is stable against oxidation up to 4.3 V. In an all-solid-state battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the electrochemical window. A cation disorder of 15% and a conductivity of 3 mS/cm are obtained at z of 0.3 to 0.55. The hafnium substitution in an amount z of 0.3 to 0.55 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. After ball milling, the ceramic ion conductor precursor is pressed and sintered. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. The halide is useful as a catholyte and as a separator facing the positive electrode, with improved electrochemical window and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.1 V or more, and wherein 0.3 <= z <= 0.55.

title: Lithium zirconate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor includes core particles of a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide and a coating layer of amorphous lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) disposed on the surface of the core particles. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The Li6PS5X phase may be combined with a halogen-rich sulfide to raise the superionic conductivity. The reduction of the interfacial resistance is 40% or more, and the interfacial resistance after 50 cycles at 4.3 V is 30 ohm cm2 or less. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. Because the shell is amorphous and continuous, the growth of interfacial resistance is reduced and the interfacial resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 4 nm to 20 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The 1.5 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 300 cycles is 88% with the electrolyte. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V. The cell retains 88% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor with improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. The polyaniline layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 5 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polyaniline layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the aluminum anode. The equivalent series resistance is 5 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a aluminum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 16 V.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers and a relative density of 97%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 700 to 850 degrees C. The yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The reversible cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Densified garnet oxide ceramic ion conductor and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A garnet ceramic ion conductor sintered body having an average grain size of 8 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. Examples of the ion conductor include argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. Sintering at 1100 degrees C with a lithium excess of 15 mol% gives a relative density of 96% and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm. An all-solid-state lithium battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved high-voltage stability. Sintering is performed at 1100 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. Because lithium volatilization is suppressed, the cubic phase is retained and the high-voltage stability is improved.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a lithium excess of 10 mol% to 30 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has a sintering temperature of 900 degrees C to 1250 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.32 mS/cm or more.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing vinylene carbonate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 45 degrees C. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at 1.2 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.5 V. The combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 1 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The additive vinylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M and vinylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Amperometric oxygen sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: Described is a thick film gas sensor whose sensing electrode is printed on a ceramic ion conductor. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the platinum sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The platinum electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The protective layer improves the durability of the sodium beta-alumina sensor in an exhaust gas. The sensor shows a response time of 20 seconds to a step change of oxygen concentration at 400 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising platinum, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of oxygen.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. A 15 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 600 to 750 degrees C. The reversible cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 98% or more.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by warm isostatic pressing
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. A lithium battery pack comprising 8 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Mixed potential type carbon dioxide sensor and method of manufacturing the sensing electrode
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. The sensor detects carbon dioxide with high selectivity and a response time of 5 seconds. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The platinum electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of lanthanum fluoride conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. The sensor shows a response time of 5 seconds to a step change of carbon dioxide concentration at 300 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising sodium nitrite in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects carbon dioxide.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 700 to 850 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. A power density of 0.8 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 700 to 850 degrees C operating range. The gadolinium-doped ceria solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The thin 5 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 0.8 W/cm2. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 700 to 850 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 200 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for hydrogen with improved response time
abstract: Disclosed is a mixed potential type sensor in which an oxide electrode and a platinum electrode on a zirconia substrate generate a potential difference depending on the hydrogen concentration. The ceramic is gadolinium-doped ceria and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 400 degrees C. The platinum electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The multilayer structure with the gadolinium-doped ceria ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature. The limiting current is proportional to the hydrogen concentration from 0.1% to 20%.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a stainless steel current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a stainless steel current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The current collector of stainless steel is used in a lithium battery with a 100 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 100 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The membrane of 100 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 8:1.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 100 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. A lithium battery pack comprising 8 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: lithium sulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The graphene framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of lithium sulfide. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the lithium sulfide cathode. A solid-state lithium-sulfur battery comprising the cathode mixture, a sulfide solid electrolyte layer, and a lithium indium negative electrode is also provided. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The lithium sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with graphene by ball milling. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1200 mAh/g and retains 90% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the lithium sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising lithium sulfide, graphene, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the lithium sulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide dissolved in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive in an amount of 2 wt%. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The stable passivation film formed by lithium bis(oxalato)borate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The cell retains 88% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.2 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 2 wt%.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 ion-conductive solid with reduced grain boundary resistance for lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a densified garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid and to a lithium battery including the same. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. When v is 0.4, the cubic phase fraction is 97% or more and the conductivity is 1.2 mS/cm. A lithium excess of 10 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A titanium-containing oxide whose reduction is suppressed may be combined with the material. A lithium battery using the garnet sintered body as a separator shows improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 91% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 7 mol% to 15 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with alumina nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyacrylonitrile; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Composite cathode comprising nickel sulfide and ketjen black and lithium secondary battery
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which nickel sulfide is confined in the pores of ketjen black to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 3 mg/cm2. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of nickel sulfide. The sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The composite shows a capacity of 1400 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The active material nickel sulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. Polysulfide dissolution from the nickel sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising nickel sulfide, ketjen black, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the nickel sulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The lithium hexafluorophosphate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene matrix. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium hexafluorophosphate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 20 micrometers or less.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 500 kPa
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The roll pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The current collector of copper is used in a lithium battery with a 100 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate and a film-forming additive
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The capacity retention of 92% after 1000 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium bis(oxalato)borate. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The stable passivation film formed by lithium bis(oxalato)borate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. With 1 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate, the capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 92% with the electrolyte.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide solid electrolyte powder
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte by stirring the raw materials in ethyl propionate at 60 degrees C and filtering the precipitate is described. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between solid electrolyte particles during pressing. The LLZO and Li6PS5Cl material is used in a solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The raw materials of the solid electrolyte are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C under reduced pressure. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. A residual solvent content of 0.3 wt% or less is achieved by vacuum drying, and the conductivity is 4.1 mS/cm. The wet-chemical process is suitable for coating an active material and improves the sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl propionate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less, and wherein the reaction temperature is 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 7.5 wt% to 30 wt%.

assignee_db_group: DALANE UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Solvent-free free-standing solid electrolyte sheet with fibrillated PTFE binder for lithium battery
abstract: Described is a solvent-free film of a solid electrolyte with a fibril network that gives a tensile strength of 1.8 MPa or more. The kneading is performed at a shear rate of 100 s^-1 to 1000 s^-1 so that the PTFE is fibrillized into a network. The tensile strength is 1.8 MPa or more and the elongation at break is 5% or more. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. Specific examples are Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The LLZO and LATP material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. The solid electrolyte powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. A lithium secondary battery using the sheet shows improved cycle life and a thinner electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the porosity of the sheet is 10% or less, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 1.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 0.2 wt% to 1 wt%.

title: Air-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a soft-acid surface region and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a hygroscopicity of 1 wt% or less and an arsenic-free antimony-rich surface region is described. The obtained powder is cast as a slurry in a nonpolar solvent with a rubber binder on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and beta-Li3PS4, and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 10 cm3/g or less. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. An H2S generation of 10 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 80% or more are obtained. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. The suppressed H2S generation results in improved grain boundary resistance and ionic conductivity and simpler handling.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an arsenic-free antimony substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1 mS/cm or more.

title: Ceramic ion conductor sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: A ceramic ion conductor sheet formed by fibrillating a polytetrafluoroethylene binder and a solid-state battery including the sheet are described. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. With a binder content of 1 wt% and a roll temperature of 80 degrees C, the sheet has a porosity of 16% or less. The sheet is calendered to a thickness of 32 micrometers to 160 micrometers and laminated onto an electrode by roll-pressing without a drying step. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and the sheet is self-supporting and can be wound on a core having a diameter of 50 mm. A solid-state battery comprising the LLZO and LATP material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. Specific examples are Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). A dry process in which the ceramic ion conductor powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the solid-state battery. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. Because the fibril network holds the particles, the sheet is self-supporting and shows improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the porosity of the sheet is 16% or less, and wherein the free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet has a roll temperature of 50 degrees C to 110 degrees C, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 32 micrometers to 160 micrometers.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 500 to 650 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with alumina nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The polyethylene oxide electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The polymer matrix is polyethylene oxide and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Oxide ceramic ion conductor having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition and method for producing the same
abstract: An oxide ceramic ion conductor stable against oxidation above 4.8 V versus Li/Li+ comprises a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and the decomposition current density at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less. The substitution amount is 8 mol%, which gives an oxidation limit of 4.5 V or more and a conductivity of 0.35 mS/cm or more. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The disclosure is applicable to Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The material may be used together with a halogen-substituted argyrodite having an impurity-free X-ray pattern. A lithium secondary battery comprising the LLZO, Li2ZrO3, and LATP material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The suppression of anodic decomposition results in a stable interface and improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a substitution amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 80% or more.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 3 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 650 to 800 degrees C is described. The thin 3 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 3 micrometers and a relative density of 97%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite cell.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The thin 8 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.5 W/cm2. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 600 to 750 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, 1,3-propane sultone, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The additive 1,3-propane sultone decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. With 1 wt% of 1,3-propane sultone, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 1 wt% of 1,3-propane sultone is also described. The additive 1,3-propane sultone forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. The 1.5 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M and 1,3-propane sultone as an additive.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 650 to 800 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The solid electrolyte layer of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 1.0 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The stack shows stable operation over 200 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 650 to 800 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 10 micrometers. The gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 10 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by cold isostatic pressing
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and polytetrafluoroethylene are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. A lithium battery pack comprising 4 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by cold isostatic pressing. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 4 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by roll pressing at 100 MPa and 60 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a stainless steel current collector is also provided. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The structure with the stainless steel current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V. The cell charged to 4.4 V retains 88% of its capacity after 300 cycles. The 1.0 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and vinylene carbonate in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor with a residual solvent content of 1 wt% or less. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. The synthesized powder is made into a self-supporting film by solvent-free rolling, and the film has a porosity of 10% or less. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. In an embodiment the material is beta-Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The solvent is ethyl acetate, and LiCl or LiBr dissolved in the solvent is incorporated into the precipitate. Heat treatment at 400 degrees C after drying at 180 degrees C gives a conductivity of 1 mS/cm or more. The solvate route lowers the processing temperature and improves the moisture stability of the product.
first_claim: 1.
