The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 3 mg/cm2. The carbon coating on the lithium sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising lithium sulfide, carbon nanotubes, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the lithium sulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia with a thickness of 10 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 98% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: Provided is a solid electrolyte comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable Li7P3S11 crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 60%. In an all-solid-state battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the moisture stability. Specific examples are Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. A superionic Li6PS5X phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. The content of Li2O is 8 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 320 degrees C, and the conductivity is 1.3 mS/cm or more. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or Li7P3S11 phase precipitates uniformly. The solid electrolyte is a lithium ion conducting material for an all-solid-state battery. The Li2O addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the moisture stability and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 420 degrees C.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 60 degrees C. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The 50 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with silica nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The polymer matrix is polyethylene oxide and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 12:1. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 20 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, succinonitrile, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 12:1.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium yttrium chloride coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium yttrium chloride and to a method for producing the same. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 60 mol% or more of the transition metals. A superionic argyrodite-type phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 8 nm. In an all-solid-state battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. The positive electrode active material is preferably provided with a halide coating having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm. The ion-conductive component may be argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and lithium niobate (LiNbO3). The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium yttrium chloride (Li3YCl6), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 60 mol% or more, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 85% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 3.2 nm to 16 nm.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 50 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The 50 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers. The membrane of 50 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polycarbonate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 8:1.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 200 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 600 to 750 degrees C. The thin 8 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 0.8 W/cm2. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of scandia-stabilized zirconia is a dense ceramic of 96% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The anode support contains nickel oxide and scandia-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass ion-conductive solid containing a beta-Li3PS4 phase and method for preparing the same
abstract: A glassy sulfide ion-conductive solid with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. The glass transition temperature is 200 degrees C, the crystallization onset is 300 degrees C, and the conductivity reaches 1.8 mS/cm. A dry process is preferred for forming the ion-conductive solid sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. The glass phase contains Li2O in an amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the beta-Li3PS4 phase. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7P3S11, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4. Precipitation of the metastable phase gives a conductivity higher than that of the glass, while the ionic conductivity is retained.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of Li2O is 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid resistant to hydrolysis under humid air and lithium battery
abstract: An air-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid in which hydrolysis is suppressed by arsenic-free antimony substitution is provided. Also described is an all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and a conductivity of 2.3 mS/cm. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. The reduced water vapor reaction lowers the interfacial resistance and improves the sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an arsenic-free antimony substitution amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 40 cm3/g or less.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a lithium sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The lithium sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with graphene by ball milling. The initial capacity of 600 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. A separator coated with graphene traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 4 mg/cm2. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%. With a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid comprises dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to form a suspension, reacting the suspension to form a solvate complex precipitate, and removing the solvent. The suspension concentration is 5 wt%, the reaction temperature is 25 degrees C, and the drying temperature is 120 degrees C. The solvent is 1,2-dimethoxyethane, and LiCl or LiBr dissolved in the solvent is incorporated into the precipitate. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li6PS5Cl material. The ion-conductive solid is preferably argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. A superionic argyrodite-type phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. The method further comprises forming a free-standing sheet from the powder by calendering with a fibril binder network. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. Dissolution and precipitation give a homogeneous composition and improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the residual solvent content is 0.5 wt% or less, and wherein the reaction temperature is 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 2.5 wt% to 10 wt%.

title: Solid electrolyte slurry with controlled viscosity and solid content for doctor blade casting
abstract: Disclosed is a wet coating method in which a slurry of a solid electrolyte is cast on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. The release film is a PET film having a silicone release layer, and the dried layer is peeled from the release film and pressed onto an electrode. The solid electrolyte may comprise beta-Li3PS4, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. A glass prepared by quenching and partially crystallized to a thio-LISICON phase can be used in the electrode mixture. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. The binder content of 2 wt% to 10 wt% gives a peel strength of 0.1 N/cm or more and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A lithium secondary battery using the layer shows improved cycle life and a thin electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a solid electrolyte layer, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; a styrene-butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising butyl butyrate in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 0.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 1500 mPa s to 6000 mPa s, and wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 80 degrees C to 120 degrees C.

title: Lithium niobium tantalum oxide-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and production method thereof
abstract: A positive electrode active material having a coating layer with a coverage of 80% or more and an average thickness of 2 nm to 10 nm is provided. The material comprises lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 80 mol% or more of the transition metals. An argyrodite phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li2ZrO3 and Li6PS5Cl material. The solid electrolyte may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. The core particles have a median diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and nickel content of 80 mol% or more. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. A lithium secondary battery using the coated active material shows improved cycle life and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 35% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 60 mol% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 180 degrees C to 450 degrees C.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyethylene oxide and lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing alumina nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 1.0 mS/cm. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The polymer matrix is polyethylene oxide and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Lithium metal negative electrode having an artificial interphase formed by atomic layer deposition and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: A method for forming a protective layer on lithium metal by atomic layer deposition followed by solution coating of a polymer is described. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li3YCl6. The bilayer with a total thickness of 1 micrometer gives 300 cycles of stable plating and stripping. A solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved interfacial resistance. A silver or lithium nitride seed in the inorganic layer improves the wettability of molten lithium with a contact angle of 30 degrees or less. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The protective layer suppresses the growth of lithium dendrites and improves the interfacial resistance of the lithium metal battery.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising silver-carbon composite (Ag-C) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 75 cycles or more, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 96.5% or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.05 micrometers to 5 micrometers.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate and a film-forming additive
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 3 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The 1.0 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 85% of its capacity after 300 cycles. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 3 wt% of vinylene carbonate is also described. The additive vinylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The stable passivation film formed by vinylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding vinylene carbonate in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by warm isostatic pressing. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium cobalt oxide, and a conductive agent.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 300 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having Li6PS5X structure with controlled halogen occupancy and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: A lithium phosphosulfide ion-conductive solid having a cubic Li6PS5X structure and a controlled halogen occupancy is described. A solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 5.1 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. The iodine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. The solid-state lithium battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the ion-conductive solid layer. The ion-conductive component may be Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). After ball milling, the ion-conductive solid precursor is pressed and sintered. Partial substitution of chlorine with iodine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. Compared with Li6PS5Cl, the iodine-substituted Li6PS5X shows a higher conductivity and better electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y), wherein 1.1 <= a <= 1.9, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.3 or less, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.5 mS/cm or more.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using carboxymethyl cellulose. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the lithium sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. A separator coated with graphene traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The composite shows a capacity of 1400 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.4 V is provided. The combination of 1,3-propane sultone and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at 1.2 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.4 V. The cell charged to 4.4 V retains 88% of its capacity after 500 cycles. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The additive 1,3-propane sultone decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising 1,3-propane sultone, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNb(1-z)TazO3 shell with high coverage for lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium niobium tantalum oxide and to a method for producing the same. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. The reduction of the interfacial resistance is 40% or more, and the interfacial resistance after 50 cycles at 4.3 V is 30 ohm cm2 or less. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li2ZrO3 and Li6PS5Cl material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. The coated particles are heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 75 mol% or more of the transition metals. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. In a solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. A solid-state battery using the coated active material shows improved cycle life and interfacial resistance and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 2 nm to 10 nm, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 40% or more.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor with a residual solvent content of 0.3 wt% or less. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. Heat treatment at 400 degrees C after drying at 120 degrees C gives a conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm or more. A superionic argyrodite phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. After drying, the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less and the carbon content is 0.5 wt% or less. Examples of the ion conductor include argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and beta-Li3PS4. In an embodiment an interlayer comprising LiF and carbon is disposed on the surface facing the negative electrode. The material comprises argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and beta-Li3PS4, which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. The obtained powder is cast as a slurry in a nonpolar solvent with a rubber binder on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. Dissolution and precipitation give a homogeneous composition and improved ionic conductivity and grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 2.5 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the reaction temperature is 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: Disclosed is a sulfide ceramic ion conductor whose hydrogen sulfide generation upon exposure to humid air is 40 cm3/g or less. After exposure to air with a dew point of -20 degrees C for 2 hours, the conductivity retention is 85%. The silicon substitution amount is 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. In an all-solid-state battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the grain boundary resistance. The cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes of exposure to air with a dew point of -20 degrees C is 20 cm3/g. The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. Because H2S generation is reduced, the safety of the manufacturing process and the grain boundary resistance are improved.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a silicon substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 2 hours is 75% or more.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by roll pressing. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a aluminum current collector is also provided. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid-state lithium cell with improved plating and stripping stability under stack pressure
abstract: A negative electrode structure with a critical current density of 2.8 mA/cm2 or more and a method for suppressing void formation during stripping are provided. The plating overpotential is 30 mV or less and the Coulombic efficiency is 99.7% after 100 cycles. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. The additive comprises silver in an amount of 0.8 wt% to 4 wt% and has an average particle size of 50 nm to 500 nm. The mixture for the solid electrolyte is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The ion-conductive component may be Li7P3S11, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and beta-Li3PS4. The additive suppresses lithium dendrites and improves the ionic conductivity and cycle life of the solid-state cell.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a solid electrolyte layer; and an additive comprising silver dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 2.8 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 10 MPa to 40 MPa, and wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 500 cycles or more.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The cell can be operated at 600 to 750 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a aluminum current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by cold isostatic pressing. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with alumina nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.2 mS/cm. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, succinonitrile, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 20:1.

title: thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm are obtained. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Bromine-substituted Li6PS5X solid electrolyte and lithium battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte for an all-solid-state battery has a Li6PS5X crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x). The Li7P3S11 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. An all-solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. A dry process is preferred for forming the solid electrolyte sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiCl relative to the Li6PS5X phase is 0.15 or less. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiCl to the Li6PS5X phase is 0.1, and the room-temperature conductivity is 11.2 mS/cm. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in an all-solid-state battery. The solid electrolyte provides improved ionic conductivity and moisture stability compared with a single-halogen Li6PS5X of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.3 <= x <= 0.75, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite ceramic ion conductor having anion disorder and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor for an all-solid-state lithium battery has an argyrodite crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y). The argyrodite crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. Specific examples are Li7P3S11. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiCl to the argyrodite phase is 0.08, and the room-temperature conductivity is 9.6 mS/cm. Compared with Li6PS5Cl, the bromine-substituted argyrodite shows a higher conductivity and better ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.24 or less, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 4.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.1 <= y/a <= 0.6.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the scandia-stabilized zirconia cell. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Wet coating method for forming a solid electrolyte layer on a release film
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a slurry composition with controlled viscosity and solid content for forming a solid electrolyte layer. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The coating speed is 5 m/min and the layer dried at 60 degrees C to 100 degrees C has a thickness of 20 micrometers. The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and the dispersant is an amine-based dispersant in an amount of 0.1 wt% to 1 wt%. The solvent has a donor number of 10 or less so that the solid electrolyte does not react with the solvent during slurry processing. Specific examples are argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li6PS5Cl material. The Li6PS5Cl composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. The dispersant prevents agglomeration and improves the cycle life and ionic conductivity of the layer.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a solid electrolyte layer, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising a mixed solvent of toluene and heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 0.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the thickness of the dried layer is 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers, and wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 1500 mPa s to 6000 mPa s.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. A capacitance of 330 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 5 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The anode body is a sintered pellet of niobium powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a niobium anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 16 V.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and polyvinylidene fluoride binder
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyvinylidene fluoride. Polysulfide dissolution from the molybdenum disulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the molybdenum disulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The capacity retention after 200 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C. The positive electrode mixture may contain a solid electrolyte such as Li3PS4 as an ion-conducting additive. The molybdenum disulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The cathode with a loading of 4 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising molybdenum disulfide, graphene, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the molybdenum disulfide is 4 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Lithium metal negative electrode having an artificial interphase formed by sputtering for lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a bilayer protective layer that suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments into an ion-conductive solid layer and stabilizes the interface with metallic lithium. The inorganic layer suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments, while the polymer layer absorbs the cracks caused by volume change of the negative electrode. The raw materials of the ion-conductive solid are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. Examples of the ion conductor include Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. After 300 cycles at 0.5 mA/cm2 the cell retains a Coulombic efficiency of 99.5% and no dendrite penetration is observed. The protective layer suppresses the growth of lithium dendrites and improves the ionic conductivity of the lithium metal battery.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising silver-carbon composite (Ag-C) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 100 cycles or more, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 98.8% or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 80 nm to 400 nm.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous aluminum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the aluminum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The capacitor withstands 125 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the aluminum capacitor. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 125 degrees C storage. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polyaniline layer to serve as the cathode lead-out.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of aluminum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polyaniline doped with naphthalenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 15 milliohms or less.

title: Germanium-substituted Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO ceramic ion conductor stable above 4.5 V and method for preparing the same
abstract: Described is an oxide ceramic ion conductor whose decomposition current at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. The cell may include a lithium nucleation additive to prevent short circuit. In a lithium secondary battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The ceramic ion conductor can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the lithium secondary battery. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. A capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 4.6 V is obtained with the substituted oxide. Examples of the ion conductor include Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). The material comprises Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and the decomposition current density at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less. The germanium substitution suppresses titanium reduction and improves the ionic conductivity in contact with lithium.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a substitution amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.2 V or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 80% or more.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. A solid electrolyte sheet of 30 micrometers is used as the separator. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. A lithium battery pack comprising 16 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a lithium sulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The carbon coating on the lithium sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The cathode delivering 800 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. The lithium sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with porous carbon by ball milling. The lithium sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The capacity retention after 100 cycles is 80% at 25 degrees C. The sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A glassy sulfide solid electrolyte with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. The glass phase contains GeS2 in an amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the beta-Li3PS4 phase. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is beta-Li3PS4, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. The precipitated beta-Li3PS4 phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 4 mS/cm. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in an all-solid-state lithium battery. The solid electrolyte shows improved ionic conductivity and moisture stability compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 4 hours, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C, and wherein the content of GeS2 is 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor element with a poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer and a carbon cathode layer
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the aluminum capacitor. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The aluminum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The anode body is a sintered pellet of aluminum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The capacitor withstands 150 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles doped with p-toluenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, lithium bis(oxalato)borate, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 0.5 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate is also described. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 60 degrees C. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. With 0.5 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate, the capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The combination of lithium bis(oxalato)borate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite solid electrolyte and lithium battery and all-solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite solid electrolyte in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by bromine. An ionic conductivity of 7.2 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 0.1 to 0.55. A precursor of the Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li6PS5Cl material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. The solid electrolyte is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. The Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state lithium battery. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. Compared with Li6PS5Cl, the bromine-substituted argyrodite shows a higher conductivity and better ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.24 or less, and wherein -0.05 <= x <= 0.75, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 4.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more during cycling is described. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. A lithium battery pack comprising 8 modules of the stacked cells is also described.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 15 micrometers and a relative density of 97%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 700 to 850 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 15 micrometers. The solid electrolyte layer of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 15 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 98% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 0.8 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 98%.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte resistant to hydrolysis under humid air
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a moisture-stable sulfide solid electrolyte and to a method of handling it in a dry room. Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. An all-solid-state battery comprising the LLZO and Li7P3S11 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes of exposure to air with a dew point of -40 degrees C is 5 cm3/g. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and a conductivity of 2.3 mS/cm. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. The solid electrolyte may comprise Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li7P3S11. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. The reduced water vapor reaction lowers the interfacial resistance and improves the grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an oxygen substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less.

title: Li6PS5X sulfide solid electrolyte with mixed chlorine-bromine substitution and method for preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure provides a Li6PS5X solid electrolyte whose anion sublattice is partially disordered by mixed chlorine-bromine substitution. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The halogen-rich composition keeps the Li6PS5X phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. A mixed-halogen Li6PS5X phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 500 degrees C. The solid electrolyte exhibits an ionic conductivity of 4.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline solid electrolyte powder. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the cycle life of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 0.15 <= y/a <= 0.45, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.2 mS/cm or more.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The 1.2 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 0.5 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate is also described. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The capacity retention of 92% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium bis(oxalato)borate.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Mixed potential type carbon dioxide sensor and method of manufacturing the sensing electrode
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting carbon dioxide comprises a gadolinium-doped ceria ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The sensing electrode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The carbon dioxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 400 degrees C. The sensor detects carbon dioxide with high selectivity and a response time of 2 seconds. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of carbon dioxide concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The dispersion of polypyrrole gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 100 microfarad rating. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The capacitor has a capacitance of 100 microfarads, a rated voltage of 10 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 8 milliohms at 100 kHz. The polypyrrole layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 8 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polypyrrole layer to serve as the cathode lead-out.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polypyrrole particles doped with p-toluenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

assignee_db_group: DALANE UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more during cycling is described. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The structure with the aluminum current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 4 stacked cells. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 25 degrees C.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a nickel-plated copper current collector is also provided. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. A solid electrolyte sheet of 30 micrometers is used as the separator. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer.
