The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The anode body is a sintered pellet of tantalum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. A solid electrolyte of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor powder
abstract: A solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor powder from a suspension in an organic solvent is provided. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li7P3S11 and Li6PS5Cl material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The disclosure is applicable to Li7P3S11 and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The ceramic ion conductor obtained by the method has an ionic conductivity of 3 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a residual solvent content of 0.2 wt%. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. The dried precipitate is heat-treated at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C in an argon atmosphere to convert the complex into the crystalline sulfide. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. The solvate route lowers the processing temperature and improves the ionic conductivity of the product.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the residual solvent content is 0.2 wt% or less, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The active material sulfur is combined with carbon nanotubes and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and carboxymethyl cellulose in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 90% of its capacity after 100 cycles is also described. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 90%. The capacity retention after 100 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C. The confinement of sulfur in the carbon nanotubes suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 100 cycles. A solid electrolyte interphase is formed on the lithium metal negative electrode during the first cycles.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising sulfur and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Composite cathode comprising molybdenum disulfide and graphene and lithium secondary battery
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. The sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The confinement of molybdenum disulfide in the graphene suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. A lithium-sulfur battery with the molybdenum disulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The carbon coating on the molybdenum disulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The molybdenum disulfide is melt-diffused into graphene at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1000 mAh/g and retains 90% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising molybdenum disulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

assignee_raw: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS (HNRIEM)
assignee_db_group: HWASEOL NATIONAL RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF ENERGY MATERIALS HNRIEM
title: Method for suppressing lithium filament growth using a zinc-containing additive layer
abstract: Disclosed is a dendrite-suppressing structure in which a zinc-containing additive at the lithium interface raises the critical current density. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. The additive comprises zinc in an amount of 0.4 wt% to 2 wt% and has an average particle size of 50 nm to 500 nm. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. A solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. During stripping, the alloy phase of the additive keeps the contact and suppresses void growth. The additive particles have a size of 200 nm and the critical current density rises from 0.6 mA/cm2 to 4 mA/cm2. The additive is useful for an anode-free configuration, with improved dendrite suppression and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising zinc dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the number of plating and stripping cycles without short circuit is 100 cycles or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 2.8 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 99% or more.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 2 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar copper current collectors. The lithium battery is operated at 120 degrees C under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by uniaxial pressing. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 100 micrometer separator layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia with a thickness of 3 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The cell operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a power density of 1.0 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The solid electrolyte of scandia-stabilized zirconia is a dense ceramic of 98% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the scandia-stabilized zirconia cell.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers and a relative density of 95%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 500 to 650 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar aluminum current collectors. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The electrode laminate pressed at 300 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Described is a combination of fluoroethylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 300 cycles is 85% with the electrolyte. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. With 0.5 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more during cycling is described. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 2 cells and a case is also provided. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 500 MPa. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Potentiometric hydrogen sensor having an auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite
abstract: This disclosure concerns a multilayer ceramic sensor element produced by co-firing green sheets of zirconia and alumina. The sensor detects hydrogen with high selectivity and a response time of 2 seconds. The sensing electrode comprises gold and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The gold electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 400 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium nitrite and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of hydrogen concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising gold, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of hydrogen.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method for forming a conductive polymer layer by impregnating a dielectric-coated anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles. The anode body is a sintered pellet of tantalum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. A capacitance of 470 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the tantalum capacitor. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 125 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous tantalum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide solid electrolyte and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: Described is a moisture-resistant sulfide in which the soft acid silicon binds the sulfur and reduces reaction with water vapor. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. In an embodiment the material is Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li7P3S11. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. The substitution amount is 3 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 400 degrees C, and the conductivity is 3.1 mS/cm or more. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. The cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes of exposure to air with a dew point of -20 degrees C is 20 cm3/g. The solid electrolyte may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. The LLZO and Li7P3S11 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The powder is formed into a sheet by kneading with a fibrillated PTFE binder and roll-pressing without a solvent to a thickness of 30 micrometers to 80 micrometers. The material is useful for electrode slurry processing in a dry room, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 24 hours is 75% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a silicon substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 40 cm3/g or less.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing fluoroethylene carbonate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The cell retains 90% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V. The combination of fluoroethylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 16 cells and a case is also provided. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa through an elastic sheet. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 30 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by styrene-butadiene rubber.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid comprises a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element. After exposure to air with a dew point of -30 degrees C for 1 hours, the conductivity retention is 90%. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The powder is amorphized by mechanical milling in a dry room with a dew point of -50 degrees C or lower and then heat-treated at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C. The glassy matrix of a vitreous sulfide improves the contact between particles during pressing. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The ion-conductive solid retains its conductivity after atmospheric exposure and shows improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 1 hours is 80% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a silicon substitution amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ion-conductive solid and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid comprises a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. The Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11 material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. A crystallized glass with a tetragonal phase may be added to improve the conductivity of the mixture. The ion-conductive solid shows an ionic conductivity of 2.3 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an H2S generation of 10 cm3/g after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C. The ion-conductive solid may comprise argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11. The cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes of exposure to air with a dew point of -40 degrees C is 10 cm3/g. The suppressed hydrolysis allows the sulfide to be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box, improving the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.9 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a tin substitution amount of 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 50 cm3/g or less.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate dissolved in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive in an amount of 1 wt%. The cell retains 90% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 1 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. The combination of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 1 wt%.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. A power density of 1.0 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The solid electrolyte layer of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The thin 3 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.0 W/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and nitrile butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The warm isostatic pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by warm isostatic pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass for lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a Li7P3S11 phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing Li2O. Suitable compositions include Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and beta-Li3PS4. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 75:25, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. The LGPS and Li3PS4 composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. The precipitated Li7P3S11 phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 5.5 mS/cm. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The solid electrolyte is a lithium ion conducting material for an all-solid-state battery. The glassy matrix absorbs volume change of the electrode and improves the electrochemical window of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 16 hours, and wherein the content of Li2O is 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 40% to 100%.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. A 15 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium hexafluorophosphate and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene based electrolyte of 30 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 30 micrometers. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene; a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm or more at 60 degrees C.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the aluminum capacitor. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The capacitor withstands 105 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The aluminum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. The capacitor rated at 6.3 V may be used in a charging circuit for a lithium ion battery. The polyaniline layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 5 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a aluminum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 6.3 V.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ion-conductive solid powder
abstract: This disclosure concerns the synthesis of a sulfide ion conductor through dissolution and precipitation in a nonaqueous solvent. A titanium-containing oxide whose reduction is suppressed may be combined with the material. The dried precipitate is heat-treated at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C in an argon atmosphere to convert the complex into the crystalline sulfide. A residual solvent content of 0.3 wt% or less is achieved by vacuum drying, and the conductivity is 5 mS/cm. The ion-conductive component may be Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The disclosure further provides a solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLZO material. Devitrification of the amorphous phase is controlled by the heat treatment temperature. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the solid-state battery. The liquid-phase route yields fine particles with a narrow size distribution and improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in acetonitrile to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 2.5 wt% to 10 wt%.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 30 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate. The anion is covalently bonded to the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium perchlorate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium perchlorate; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Surface mount solid electrolytic capacitor and method of reducing leakage current
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the aluminum anode. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The equivalent series resistance is 8 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The polystyrene sulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 150 degrees C storage. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. A solid electrolyte of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of aluminum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) doped with polystyrene sulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 8 milliohms or less.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 700 to 850 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The reversible cell with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer of samarium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising samarium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and a film-forming additive
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The additive 1,3-propane sultone is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Argyrodite sulfide solid electrolyte with mixed chlorine-bromine substitution and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte for an all-solid-state battery has an argyrodite crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x). The Li7P3S11 and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. In a X-ray diffraction pattern measured using CuK-alpha radiation, the peak intensity ratio attributed to LiCl relative to the argyrodite phase is 0.075 or less. Specific examples are Li7P3S11 and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The active material having a halide coating is mixed with the material in a weight ratio of 70:30 to 85:15. The argyrodite phase has a cubic lattice and a conductivity of 11.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C measured by AC impedance on a pressed pellet. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. The solid electrolyte provides improved cycle life compared with a single-halogen argyrodite of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.075 or less, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 8.4 mS/cm or more.

title: Lithium metal halide ceramic ion conductor represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Hf(z)Br6 and method for producing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a mixed-halide ceramic ion conductor of indium and hafnium that is stable against oxidation up to 4.5 V. A titanium-containing oxide whose reduction is suppressed may be combined with the material. A solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A halide coating layer may be used together with the ceramic ion conductor to improve the cycle life of the solid-state battery. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The halide shows an activation energy of 0.35 eV or less and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm. After ball milling, the ceramic ion conductor precursor is pressed and sintered. The orthorhombic phase is obtained by heat treatment at 350 degrees C, and the monoclinic polymorph is 5% or less. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiBr, InBr3, and HfBr4 followed by heat treatment at 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C. The water-mediated synthesis allows scalable production while retaining the ionic conductivity and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Hf(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which indium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.56 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C, and wherein 0.1 <= z <= 0.35.

title: Tantalum-doped garnet ion-conductive solid sintered body with high relative density and production method thereof
abstract: A garnet ion-conductive solid sintered body having an average grain size of 10 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. The rare earth halide component is stable against oxidation and tolerates cation disorder. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. The sintered body has a relative density of 94%, an average grain size of 10 micrometers, and a total conductivity of 0.6 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. A lithium excess of 15 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A dry process in which the ion-conductive solid powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the lithium secondary battery. The ion-conductive solid is preferably lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The sintering aid lowers the sintering temperature by 100 degrees C or more while improving the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 1170 degrees C to 1320 degrees C, and wherein 0.35 <= v <= 0.7, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 91% or more.

title: Solvent-free free-standing solid electrolyte sheet with fibrillated PTFE binder
abstract: Provided is a sheet in which solid electrolyte particles are held by PTFE fibrils formed by fibrillization during kneading. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The binder is polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) in an amount of 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, and the fibrils have an average diameter of 50 nm to 500 nm. The cubic Li6PS5X structure tolerates chlorine and bromine on the 4a and 4d sites. The synthesis comprises reacting the raw materials in a suspension with stirring and removing the residual solvent before the sheet is formed. Atmospheric exposure at a dew point of -30 degrees C does not reduce the conductivity by more than 20%. A lithium secondary battery using a lithium metal anode together with the solid electrolyte shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. The solid electrolyte is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and Li7P3S11. A sheet of 20 micrometers has an areal resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less at 25 degrees C. The sheet can be laminated onto an electrode without a drying step and improves the cycle life of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 1.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 600 to 750 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. The reversible cell with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The cell can be operated at 600 to 750 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The solid electrolyte layer of samarium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 15 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 15 micrometers. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising samarium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 15 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite-type solid electrolyte having anion disorder and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: A solid electrolyte comprising a crystal phase of the argyrodite-type type is provided, wherein the halogen site is occupied by both chlorine and bromine. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. A mixed-halogen argyrodite-type phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 500 degrees C. The peak intensity ratio IA/IB of LiCl to the argyrodite-type phase is 0.03, and the room-temperature conductivity is 6 mS/cm. An all-solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the moisture stability of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.045 or less, and wherein 0.25 <= y/a <= 0.55, and wherein 1.2 <= a <= 1.6.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, ketjen black, and carboxymethyl cellulose is described. The sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1200 mAh/g and retains 80% of the capacity after 100 cycles at 0.5 C. A lithium-sulfur battery with the titanium disulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and carboxymethyl cellulose in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The titanium disulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. The titanium disulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising titanium disulfide, ketjen black, and carboxymethyl cellulose, wherein a loading of the titanium disulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a molybdenum disulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The active material molybdenum disulfide is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The molybdenum disulfide is melt-diffused into graphene at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The confinement of molybdenum disulfide in the graphene suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 100 cycles. The sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. With a sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing molybdenum disulfide with graphene; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the molybdenum disulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a titanium disulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The cathode may also be used with a solid electrolyte to form a solid-state lithium-sulfur cell. The titanium disulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with porous carbon by ball milling. The capacity retention after 200 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the titanium disulfide cathode. Polysulfide dissolution from the titanium disulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyacrylic acid.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising titanium disulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ion-conductive solid powder
abstract: Provided is a method in which a solvate complex of Li3PS4 is precipitated from 1,2-dimethoxyethane, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated. A halogen-rich Li6PS5X with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The dissolution of P2S5 in the solvent is followed by precipitation of a complex that contains one to three solvent molecules per formula unit. The suspension has a solid concentration of 7.5 wt% to 30 wt% and is reacted at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. The reaction at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C for 24 hours gives a precipitate yield of 95% or more. Cyclic voltammetry confirms that the oxide component is stable up to 5 V. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. The liquid-phase route yields fine particles with a narrow size distribution and improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in 1,2-dimethoxyethane to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 2.9 mS/cm or more, and wherein the reaction temperature is 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a lithium sulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The graphene framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of lithium sulfide. The lithium sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. A separator coated with graphene traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 80% of its capacity after 500 cycles is also described. With a sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. Polysulfide dissolution from the lithium sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide solid electrolyte and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: Provided is a sulfide solid electrolyte that retains 70% or more of its conductivity after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 6 hours. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 5 micrometers and a conductivity of 3.2 mS/cm. Examples of the ion conductor include Li7P3S11, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. A protected lithium metal negative electrode is one example of the counter electrode. The synthesized powder is made into a self-supporting film by solvent-free rolling, and the film has a porosity of 10% or less. The material comprises Li7P3S11, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 40 cm3/g or less. A wet slurry process with a doctor blade on a release film may be used to form the layer. Also described is an all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The suppressed H2S generation results in improved ionic conductivity and grain boundary resistance and simpler handling.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has an arsenic-free antimony substitution amount of 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 6 hours is 55% or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 100 cm3/g or less.

title: Ion-conductive solid slurry with controlled viscosity and solid content for doctor blade casting
abstract: This disclosure concerns a slurry for forming an ion-conductive solid layer that has a solid content of 40 wt% to 60 wt% and a viscosity of 500 mPa s to 2000 mPa s. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the ion-conductive solid in the lithium secondary battery. The binder is a rubber that keeps the layer flexible after drying and does not block the ion conduction between particles. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. The binder content is 1 wt%, the drying temperature is 80 degrees C, and the decrease in conductivity after slurry processing is 20% or less. The wet process is useful for forming a layer on a large area, with improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming an ion-conductive solid layer, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; a styrene-butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising xylene in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the thickness of the dried layer is 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 1.3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the slurry has a binder content of 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%.

title: Potentiometric nitrogen oxide sensor having an auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite
abstract: An amperometric sensor in which nitrogen oxide is pumped through a diffusion barrier by an oxide ion conducting ceramic is provided. The auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite makes the sensor selective to nitrogen oxide against interfering gases. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the gold sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 500 degrees C. The sensor operating at 500 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for nitrogen oxide. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. The sensing electrode comprises gold and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising sodium nitrite in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects nitrogen oxide.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 98%. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 0.8 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The thin 15 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 0.8 W/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C. The cell can be operated at 600 to 750 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The thin 15 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.0 W/cm2. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 15 micrometers and a relative density of 95%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of yttria-stabilized zirconia is a dense ceramic of 95% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 500 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide solid electrolyte using ethyl acetate and sulfide ion conductor produced thereby
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte comprises dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension, reacting the suspension to form a solvate complex precipitate, and removing the solvent. After drying, the residual solvent content is 0.2 wt% or less and the carbon content is 0.5 wt% or less. The mixture for the solid electrolyte is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. The reaction at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C for 24 hours gives a precipitate yield of 95% or more. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. The material comprises Li7P3S11 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. In an embodiment the solid electrolyte layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The Li7P3S11 and LLZO material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. An all-solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte obtained by the method shows improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 80 degrees C to 160 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 2.5 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 2.9 mS/cm or more, and wherein the reaction temperature is 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 3 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 88% with the electrolyte. The combination of fluoroethylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M and fluoroethylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Described is a combination of lithium bis(oxalato)borate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V. The cell retains 90% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Multilayer ceramic gas sensor element and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: An exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell, a sensing cell, and a diffusion controlling portion is described. The solid electrolyte of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. The nitrogen oxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 300 degrees C. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the gold sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The sensor shows a response time of 20 seconds to a step change of nitrogen oxide concentration at 300 degrees C. The gold electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The 1.5 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The 50 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The lithium salt is lithium perchlorate and the membrane has a thickness of 50 micrometers. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The membrane of 50 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polycarbonate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The UV-crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.2 mS/cm. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 8:1.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 300 kPa
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by roll pressing and the release film is peeled. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The roll pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 300 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the titanium disulfide cathode. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 600 mAh/g and retains 90% of the capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5 C. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 5 mg/cm2. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of titanium disulfide. The titanium disulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. Polysulfide dissolution from the titanium disulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising ketjen black; titanium disulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: Disclosed is a thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V.
