A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 30 micrometers. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 12:1.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing titania nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm are obtained. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix. The titania nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The iron sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. Polysulfide dissolution from the iron sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The carbon coating on the iron sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g and retains 80% of the capacity after 200 cycles at 0.5 C. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided. The confinement of iron sulfide in the porous carbon suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 200 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising iron sulfide, porous carbon, and carboxymethyl cellulose, wherein a loading of the iron sulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Described is a combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. The 1.0 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Method for forming an ion-conductive solid film by powder-to-film rolling without solvent
abstract: A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet having a thickness of 32 micrometers to 160 micrometers and a porosity of 20% or less is provided. An all-solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved sheet formability. The kneading is performed at a shear rate of 100 s^-1 to 1000 s^-1 so that the PTFE is fibrillized into a network. The tensile strength is 1.8 MPa or more and the elongation at break is 5% or more. A titanium-containing oxide whose reduction is suppressed may be combined with the material. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The fibril network occupies 1 vol% to 5 vol% of the sheet, and the remainder is the ion-conductive particles. Because the fibril network holds the particles, the sheet is self-supporting and shows improved sheet formability.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 1.8 MPa or more, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the sheet at 25 degrees C is 1.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein the porosity of the sheet is 20% or less.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia with a thickness of 8 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 500 to 650 degrees C. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers and a relative density of 97%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of yttria-stabilized zirconia is a dense ceramic of 97% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 8 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 60 degrees C. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate at 1.5 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.4 V. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 1 wt%.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide ion-conductive solid using acetonitrile
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid by stirring the raw materials in acetonitrile at 25 degrees C and filtering the precipitate is described. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li7P3S11, beta-Li3PS4, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The Li6PS5X phase may be combined with a halogen-rich sulfide to raise the superionic conductivity. The solvent is acetonitrile, and LiCl or LiBr dissolved in the solvent is incorporated into the precipitate. After drying, the residual solvent content is 0.2 wt% or less and the carbon content is 0.5 wt% or less. The ion-conductive solid powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 3 micrometers. The carbon content of the heat-treated powder is 0.3 wt% and the conductivity is 1.5 mS/cm. A lithium cell comprising the material in at least one layer is also described. Because the raw materials react in the liquid phase, the method is scalable and gives a powder with improved ionic conductivity and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in acetonitrile to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 85 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 100 degrees C to 280 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 600 degrees C, wherein the residual solvent content is 0.6 wt% or less, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 600 degrees C.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 15 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 500 to 650 degrees C is described. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 500 to 650 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 15 micrometers. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Method for producing a ceramic ion conductor sheet by slurry casting and peeling
abstract: A method for producing a ceramic ion conductor sheet by slurry casting, drying, and peeling from a support film is provided. The particles have a median diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and the layer has a conductivity of 2.5 mS/cm. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. In an embodiment the material is Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The solvent has a donor number of 10 or less so that the ceramic ion conductor does not react with the solvent during slurry processing. A solid-state lithium battery comprising the LATP, LLZO, and Li6PS5Cl material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The powder is synthesized by a liquid-phase route in which the raw materials are dissolved in a solvent, precipitated, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated at 400 degrees C to 550 degrees C. The binder is styrene-butadiene rubber in an amount of 2 wt% to 10 wt% and is dissolved in the nonpolar solvent anisole. The ceramic ion conductor may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. The nonpolar solvent does not degrade the ceramic ion conductor, and the layer shows improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a styrene-butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising anisole in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 1500 mPa s to 6000 mPa s, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 1.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the solid content of the slurry is 30 wt% to 50 wt%.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: Disclosed is a thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ion-conductive solid powder
abstract: This disclosure concerns the synthesis of a sulfide ion conductor through dissolution and precipitation in a nonaqueous solvent. The suspension has a solid concentration of 4 wt% to 16 wt% and is reacted at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. In an embodiment the material is Li7P3S11. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. The ion-conductive solid powder can be formed into a free-standing film by a dry process without any solvent. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li7P3S11 material. The reaction at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C for 24 hours gives a precipitate yield of 95% or more. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. The ion-conductive solid is a lithium ion conducting material for an all-solid-state battery. The liquid-phase route yields fine particles with a narrow size distribution and improved sinterability and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in a mixed solvent of ethanol and tetrahydrofuran to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the reaction temperature is 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C, and wherein the residual solvent content is 1 wt% or less.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, lithium bis(oxalato)borate, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 90% of its capacity after 300 cycles. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 45 degrees C. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.2 M and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive.

title: Oxide solid electrolyte with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid electrolyte whose anodic decomposition at high potential is suppressed by a surface region of 5 nm to 50 nm. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. The decomposition current density at 5 V is 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less and the capacity retention after 200 cycles is 85% or more. Part of the titanium in the Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase is substituted by zirconium in an amount of 5 mol% to 20 mol%, which raises the anodic stability. In a lithium secondary battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the high-voltage stability. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline solid electrolyte powder. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. The suppression of anodic decomposition results in a stable interface and improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.35 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a substitution amount of 5 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.7 V or more.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite-type ion-conductive solid and lithium battery and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite-type phosphosulfide having the composition Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x) and to an all-solid-state battery comprising the same. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 4.2 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. The mixture for the ion-conductive solid is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. A hexachloride of yttrium or indium may serve as the catholyte. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. The Li3InCl6 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the cycle life of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.1 <= x <= 0.55, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 45 degrees C. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive.

title: Potentiometric oxygen sensor having an auxiliary electrode of lithium carbonate
abstract: Provided is a potentiometric sensor having an auxiliary electrode phase of lithium carbonate that converts the oxygen concentration into an ionic activity. The gold electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The ceramic is yttria-stabilized zirconia and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 300 degrees C. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of oxygen concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The protective layer improves the durability of the yttria-stabilized zirconia sensor in an exhaust gas. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising lithium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects oxygen.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 5 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 98% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 500 to 650 degrees C. The reversible cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 5 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 500 to 650 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate and a film-forming additive
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate dissolved in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate and 1,3-propane sultone as an additive in an amount of 2 wt%. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. With 2 wt% of 1,3-propane sultone, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 45 degrees C. The additive 1,3-propane sultone forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. The additive 1,3-propane sultone is added in an amount of 2 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The additive 1,3-propane sultone reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.2 M and adding 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 2 wt%.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyacrylonitrile and lithium hexafluorophosphate and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The polyacrylonitrile electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The membrane of 20 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyacrylonitrile and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 20:1.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 700 to 850 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the gadolinium-doped ceria cell. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 700 to 850 degrees C. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The solid electrolyte layer of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate at 1.5 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.5 V. With 2 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The capacity retention of 90% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 2 wt%.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: Described is a combination of lithium bis(oxalato)borate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The stable passivation film formed by lithium bis(oxalato)borate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. The capacity retention of 92% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without lithium bis(oxalato)borate. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate at 1.5 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.4 V. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 2 wt%.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 solid electrolyte with reduced grain boundary resistance
abstract: A sintered garnet pellet with a relative density of 95% and a method of hot pressing the same are described. The raw materials of the solid electrolyte are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. Examples of the ion conductor include Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. An all-solid-state battery comprising the LATP, LLTO, and Li2ZrO3 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. A sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. The sintered body has a relative density of 95%, an average grain size of 5 micrometers, and a total conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The densification improves the mechanical strength and the grain boundary resistance of the garnet layer.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a sintering temperature of 1150 degrees C to 1300 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 12 mol% to 20 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more.

title: Argyrodite-type sulfide solid electrolyte with mixed chlorine-bromine substitution and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite-type phosphosulfide having the composition Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y) and to a lithium secondary battery comprising the same. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. A lithium metal anode can be used as the negative electrode because the reduction stability of the solid electrolyte is improved. When fired at 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C, the material shows a conductivity of 6.4 mS/cm or more and a lithium ion transference number close to unity. In an embodiment the solid electrolyte layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. The mixed halogen substitution improves the electrochemical window of the lithium secondary battery.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.045 or less, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 6.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which titanium disulfide is confined in the pores of ketjen black to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. The initial capacity of 600 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the titanium disulfide cathode. Polysulfide dissolution from the titanium disulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. With a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. A lithium secondary battery comprising the positive electrode, a lithium-containing negative electrode, and an electrolyte is also provided. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyacrylic acid in a weight ratio of 80:10:10.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising titanium disulfide, ketjen black, and polyacrylic acid, wherein a loading of the titanium disulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor element with a poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer and a carbon cathode layer
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The aluminum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 5 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The anode body is a sintered pellet of aluminum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The equivalent series resistance is 5 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of aluminum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) doped with p-toluenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 5 milliohms or less.

title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 100 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 100 micrometers. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The membrane of 100 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 90%. The carbon coating on the nickel sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The cathode delivering 1400 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the nickel sulfide cathode. The cathode with a loading of 5 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. With a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing nickel sulfide with carbon nanotubes; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the nickel sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 30 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The titania nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyethylene oxide. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers. The cell can be operated at 500 to 650 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers and a relative density of 98%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 8 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 500 kPa
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 4 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar copper current collectors. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for ammonia with improved response time
abstract: Described is a thick film gas sensor whose sensing electrode is printed on a ceramic ion conductor. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 500 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the lanthanum fluoride ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The ceramic is lanthanum fluoride and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 500 degrees C. The limiting current is proportional to the ammonia concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The sensor operating at 500 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for ammonia.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting ammonia, comprising: a ceramic body comprising lanthanum fluoride; a sensing electrode comprising gold disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 500 degrees C.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and polyvinylidene fluoride binder
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a iron sulfide cathode material for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of synthesizing it. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g and retains 90% of the capacity after 100 cycles at 0.5 C. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of iron sulfide. A separator coated with ketjen black traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The iron sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the iron sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising iron sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Aluminum-doped garnet ion-conductive solid sintered body with high relative density and production method thereof
abstract: A sintered garnet pellet with a relative density of 92% and a method of hot pressing the same are described. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. The garnet grains are bonded through a thin lithium borate or lithium fluoride phase at the grain boundaries. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. Sintering at 1100 degrees C with a lithium excess of 5 mol% gives a relative density of 92% and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm. The sintering aid lowers the sintering temperature by 100 degrees C or more while improving the sinterability and high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li3BO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an average grain size of 0.8 micrometers to 48 micrometers, and wherein 0.06 <= v <= 0.75, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 900 degrees C to 1250 degrees C.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 3 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 650 to 800 degrees C is described. A power density of 1.5 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. The cell can be operated at 650 to 800 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The stack shows stable operation over 50 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 650 to 800 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 98%. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with titania nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polyacrylonitrile holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polyacrylonitrile based electrolyte of 30 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The membrane of 30 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyacrylonitrile and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: sulfur positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which sulfur is confined in the pores of graphene to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. The sulfur cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The active material sulfur is combined with graphene and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 80% of its capacity after 100 cycles is also described. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%. The composite shows a capacity of 1000 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising sulfur, graphene, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the sulfur is 5 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Dendrite-suppressing magnesium additive at the lithium metal interface of a solid-state cell and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the suppression of lithium filament growth in a solid-state cell by an additive that promotes uniform plating and stripping. During stripping, the alloy phase of the additive keeps the contact and suppresses void growth. The critical current density at 25 degrees C is 2 mA/cm2 and the cell survives 500 cycles of plating and stripping without short circuit. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. A lithium secondary battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. An interlayer having a thickness of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers may be disposed between the layer and the negative electrode. In an embodiment the material is Li3YCl6, lithium fluoride (LiF), and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. The additive is useful for an anode-free configuration, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising magnesium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 1.4 mA/cm2 or more, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 1 MPa to 4 MPa, and wherein the content of the magnesium additive is 0.2 wt% to 1 wt%.

title: Wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor with low residual solvent for lithium battery
abstract: Described is a liquid-phase route to a sulfide ceramic ion conductor that does not require long mechanical milling. Also described is a solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure. The suspension has a solid concentration of 4 wt% to 16 wt% and is reacted at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. In an embodiment the material is Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The reaction at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C for 24 hours gives a precipitate yield of 95% or more. The ceramic ion conductor powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the solid-state battery. A solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor obtained by the method shows improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, wherein the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 4 wt% to 16 wt%, and wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 3.5 mS/cm or more.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyethylene oxide matrix, lithium perchlorate as the lithium salt, and an ionic liquid as a plasticizer. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The UV-crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 12:1.

assignee_db_group: BRIEXUS UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte and lithium metal battery using the same
abstract: Disclosed is a semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of polycarbonate holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polycarbonate based electrolyte of 30 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The membrane of 30 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polycarbonate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polycarbonate.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polycarbonate and lithium perchlorate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 30 micrometers or less.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous tantalum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. A solid electrolyte of polypyrrole replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the tantalum anode. The polypyrrole is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polypyrrole layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 125 degrees C storage. The equivalent series resistance is 15 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 10 V.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 5 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 500 to 650 degrees C is described. The thin 5 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 50 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 500 to 650 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. A 5 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 5 micrometers and a relative density of 97%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 5 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The anode support contains nickel oxide and lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 8 micrometers and a relative density of 97%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, carbon nanotubes, and carboxymethyl cellulose is described. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles is also described. A separator coated with carbon nanotubes traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The composite shows a capacity of 1200 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The carbon nanotubes framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of sulfur. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the sulfur cathode. The positive electrode mixture may contain a solid electrolyte such as Li3PS4 as an ion-conducting additive.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising sulfur and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Ceramic ion conductor sheet formed by kneading and roll-pressing and solid-state battery
abstract: Provided is a sheet in which ceramic ion conductor particles are held by PTFE fibrils formed by fibrillization during kneading. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. The sheet thickness is 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers, the porosity is 30% or less, and the conductivity is 1.4 mS/cm or more. Also described is a solid-state lithium battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The kneading is performed at a shear rate of 100 s^-1 to 1000 s^-1 so that the PTFE is fibrillized into a network. The powder is mixed with the PTFE binder at a roll temperature of 80 degrees C to form a continuous film. Examples of the ion conductor include beta-Li3PS4, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A solid-state lithium battery using the sheet shows improved cycle life and a thinner electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ceramic ion conductor sheet, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 1.2 MPa or more, and wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 0.8 wt% to 4 wt%, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 8 micrometers to 40 micrometers.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.5 V is provided. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 60 degrees C. The capacity retention of 88% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without 1,3-propane sultone. The additive 1,3-propane sultone forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. The additive 1,3-propane sultone decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 88% of its capacity after 500 cycles. The stable passivation film formed by 1,3-propane sultone suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising 1,3-propane sultone, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The 1.0 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. The cell retains 88% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding vinylene carbonate in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Coated cathode particles having an amorphous LiNb(1-z)TazO3 shell with high coverage and lithium battery
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor includes core particles of a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide and a coating layer of amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3) disposed on the surface of the core particles. Nickel accounts for 90 mol% of the transition metals, and the heat treatment is performed at 400 degrees C. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. The layer may be a self-supporting film with a fibril network of polytetrafluoroethylene. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3) and has an average thickness of 6 nm to 30 nm and a coverage of 90% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li2ZrO3 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The lithium niobium tantalum oxide shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 50% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 80 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 6 nm to 30 nm.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium perchlorate and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium perchlorate for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The solid electrolyte membrane is a polymer that replaces the separator and the liquid electrolyte. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The lithium salt is lithium perchlorate and the membrane has a thickness of 100 micrometers. The poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 100 micrometers. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium perchlorate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 100 micrometers or less.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with alumina nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The UV-crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.1 mS/cm. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The membrane of 50 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyacrylonitrile and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 12:1.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: Described is a combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The additive vinylene carbonate is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. The cell retains 90% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The stable passivation film formed by vinylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The additive vinylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and vinylene carbonate in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises lithium sulfide impregnated in ketjen black and a carbon coating on the composite. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyvinylidene fluoride. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%. The disclosure further provides a lithium battery in which the lithium sulfide cathode faces a lithium-containing negative electrode. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and polyvinylidene fluoride in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The capacity retention after 100 cycles is 80% at 25 degrees C. The carbon coating on the lithium sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The cathode may also be used with a solid electrolyte to form a solid-state lithium-sulfur cell.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 50 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The solid electrolyte membrane is a polymer that replaces the separator and the liquid electrolyte. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The membrane of 50 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The anion is covalently bonded to the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 50 micrometers or less.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 60 degrees C. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The combination of lithium difluorophosphate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.2 M and adding lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Argyrodite-type sulfide solid electrolyte with mixed bromine-iodine substitution and method for producing the same
abstract: This disclosure provides an argyrodite-type solid electrolyte whose anion sublattice is partially disordered by mixed bromine-iodine substitution. Partial substitution of bromine with iodine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiBr impurity phase. A metastable crystal phase precipitated in a glass gives a conductivity above that of the glass itself. The Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and LGPS material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. The solid electrolyte may comprise beta-Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The argyrodite-type phase has a cubic lattice and a conductivity of 6 mS/cm at 25 degrees C measured by AC impedance on a pressed pellet. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. A lithium secondary battery using the solid electrolyte in the positive electrode layer shows improved rate capability and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite-type crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Br(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.045 or less, and wherein 0.4 <= x <= 0.85, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a aluminum current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The current collector of aluminum is used in a lithium battery with a 50 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer.
