The equivalent series resistance is 10 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The anode body is a sintered pellet of tantalum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. The dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 220 microfarad rating.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles doped with polystyrene sulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing alumina nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 1.0 mS/cm. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The anion is covalently bonded to the polycarbonate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 12:1.

title: Halogen-rich Li6PS5X ceramic ion conductor having anion disorder and method for preparing the same
abstract: A lithium phosphosulfide ceramic ion conductor having a cubic Li6PS5X structure and a controlled halogen occupancy is described. The material comprises Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and beta-Li3PS4, wherein the Li6PS5X crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, chlorine, and iodine. Devitrification of the amorphous phase is controlled by the heat treatment temperature. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 7.3 mS/cm. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The air stability of the sulfide component is improved by oxygen substitution. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and beta-Li3PS4. The ceramic ion conductor provides improved electrochemical window and cycle life compared with a single-halogen Li6PS5X of the same halogen content.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.3 or less, and wherein -0.05 <= x <= 0.75, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.6 mS/cm or more.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium niobium tantalum oxide coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction
abstract: Provided is a coated active material in which an amorphous LiNb(1-z)TazO3 layer prevents the formation of a space-charge layer at the interface with the sulfide. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. The average thickness of the coating is 3.2 nm to 16 nm, the coverage is 90% or more, and the heat treatment temperature is 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor. Because the shell is amorphous and continuous, the growth of interfacial resistance is reduced and the interfacial resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium niobium tantalum oxide (LiNb(1-z)TazO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 90% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 3.2 nm to 16 nm.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous tantalum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the tantalum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The anode body is a sintered pellet of tantalum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The tantalum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the tantalum capacitor. The equivalent series resistance is 15 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polypyrrole particles doped with polystyrene sulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Mixed-halide solid electrolyte of indium and hafnium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a mixed-halide solid electrolyte of indium and hafnium that is stable against oxidation up to 4.2 V. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline solid electrolyte powder. The median particle diameter D50 is 1 micrometers and the pellet conductivity is 1.5 mS/cm after pressing at 300 MPa. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The LiF and Li3YCl6 material is used in a solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The ion-conductive component may be lithium fluoride (LiF) and Li3YCl6. The hafnium substitution in an amount z of 0.02 to 0.25 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. In one embodiment the layer is produced by a dry process in which the mixture is rolled between heated rollers. Because the chloride framework is oxidation-resistant, the moisture stability at 4.3 V is improved.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: a monoclinic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)In(1-z)Hf(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which indium and hafnium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 3.7 V or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 470 degrees C, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.6 mS/cm or more.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 12:1. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The polyacrylonitrile electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The polymer electrolyte is laminated with a thin ceramic ion conductor layer to block dendrites. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 100 micrometers. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.2 mS/cm.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Oxide solid electrolyte having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: Provided is a perovskite-type LLTO solid electrolyte in which zirconium substitution raises the oxidation potential and suppresses titanium reduction. An all-solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved grain boundary resistance. In an embodiment a halide coating containing indium chloride is applied to the active material before mixing. The oxide has an ionic conductivity of 1 mS/cm and an electrochemical window of 1.8 V to 4.5 V. Part of the titanium in the perovskite-type LLTO phase is substituted by zirconium in an amount of 5 mol% to 20 mol%, which raises the anodic stability. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the solid electrolyte layer of the all-solid-state battery. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. An interlayer of a lithium-ion conductive polymer may be inserted to improve the contact at the interface. Devitrification of the amorphous phase is controlled by the heat treatment temperature. Because oxidative decomposition is suppressed, the interfacial resistance growth is small and the grain boundary resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.4 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 3.9 V or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a substitution amount of 2 mol% to 40 mol%.

title: Bilayer protection of metallic lithium with an inorganic LiF layer and a fluorinated polymer
abstract: Disclosed is a bilayer protective layer that suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments into a solid electrolyte layer and stabilizes the interface with metallic lithium. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the protective layer forms an artificial interphase that is lithiophilic. Densification of the garnet by hot pressing improves the contact with the material. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. The LiF layer is amorphous and in direct contact with the metallic lithium, and the polymer layer faces the solid electrolyte. The solid electrolyte may comprise beta-Li3PS4 and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The Li3PS4 and LLZO material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state lithium battery. The inorganic layer has a conductivity of 1 x 10^-6 S/cm, and the cell shows a Coulombic efficiency of 98.5% after 100 cycles. The protective layer is useful for an anode-free cell, with improved cycle life and dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97.8% or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 120 nm to 600 nm, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.5 micrometers to 3 micrometers.

title: Mixed-halide ceramic ion conductor of scandium and zirconium and oxidation-stable lithium battery
abstract: A halide ceramic ion conductor comprises a trigonal crystal phase of a lithium metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Sc(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6. An all-solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved high-voltage stability. A cation disorder of 15% and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm are obtained at z of 0.1 to 0.35. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably Li3InCl6, Li3YCl6, and lithium fluoride (LiF). An argyrodite-type sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiCl, ScCl3, and ZrCl4 followed by heat treatment at 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. The zirconium substitution in an amount z of 0.1 to 0.35 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. The zirconium substitution lowers the raw material cost of the rare earth halide and improves the high-voltage stability and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Sc(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which scandium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein 0.1 <= z <= 0.35, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.56 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and polytetrafluoroethylene are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The lithium battery is operated at 25 degrees C under a stack pressure of 100 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for carbon dioxide with improved response time
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting carbon dioxide comprises a yttria-stabilized zirconia ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of carbon dioxide concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the lanthanum strontium manganite sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The sensor detects carbon dioxide with high selectivity and a response time of 2 seconds. The sensing electrode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The carbon dioxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 700 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The solid electrolyte of lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite is a dense ceramic of 97% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 650 to 800 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite cell. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and method for preparing the same
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25 and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated therein. The glass transition temperature is 200 degrees C, the crystallization onset is 260 degrees C, and the conductivity reaches 1.8 mS/cm. The glass phase contains GeS2 in an amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the Li7P3S11 phase. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 260 degrees C. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline solid electrolyte powder. The electrode mixture of the lithium secondary battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. Suitable compositions include Li7P3S11. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The crystallized glass combines the deformability of a vitreous phase with the high conductivity of the crystal phase, improving the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 8 hours, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 40% to 75%.

title: Oxide solid electrolyte having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition
abstract: An oxide solid electrolyte stable against oxidation above 4.8 V versus Li/Li+ comprises a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium. The electrochemical window measured by cyclic voltammetry on a blocking electrode extends to 5.5 V versus Li/Li+. A capacity retention of 80% after 200 cycles at 4.6 V is obtained with the substituted oxide. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li6PS5Cl and Li3PS4 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. Examples of the ion conductor include Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl and beta-Li3PS4. The material comprises Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl and beta-Li3PS4, and the decomposition current density at 5 V is 4 microamperes per square centimeter or less. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. A superionic Li6PS5X phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the solid electrolyte layer of the lithium secondary battery. The material is useful as a catholyte in a high-voltage positive electrode mixture, with improved moisture stability and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 75% or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 4 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Hafnium-substituted Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO ion-conductive solid stable above 4.8 V and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Described is an oxide ion-conductive solid whose decomposition current at 5 V is 40 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. In an all-solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the sinterability. Part of the titanium in the Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase is substituted by hafnium in an amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, which raises the anodic stability. The coating layer on the cathode particle suppresses the interfacial reaction with the sulfide. The wet film is peeled from the support film after drying. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. The interlayer reduces the interfacial resistance of the all-solid-state battery and keeps the contact area during volume change of the electrode. The oxide has an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm and an electrochemical window of 1.8 V to 4.8 V. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in an all-solid-state battery. The surface region acts as an oxidation barrier and improves the sinterability of the electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.2 V or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 100 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Described is a combination of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 300 cycles is 92% with the electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The combination of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite cell. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polypyrrole layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The capacitor has a capacitance of 470 microfarads, a rated voltage of 35 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 5 milliohms at 100 kHz. The polypyrrole is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The tantalum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The polypyrrole layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 5 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising polypyrrole particles doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass ceramic ion conductor containing a beta-Li3PS4 phase and method for preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a ceramic ion conductor comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 80%. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of an argyrodite-type component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and gives a pellet conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm after pressing at 360 MPa. A protected lithium metal negative electrode is one example of the counter electrode. The ceramic ion conductor may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or beta-Li3PS4 phase precipitates uniformly. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A lithium secondary battery containing the crystallized glass shows improved electrochemical window and rate performance.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 8 hours, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 200 degrees C to 280 degrees C, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 60% to 95%.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 45 degrees C. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. With 2 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The capacity retention of 88% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without fluoroethylene carbonate.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising fluoroethylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

assignee_db_group: BRIEXUS UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate at 1.5 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.3 V. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 45 degrees C. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The 1.5 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding vinylene carbonate in an amount of 1 wt%.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a stainless steel current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 15 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer of lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The cell operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a power density of 0.8 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 98% or more.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid resistant to hydrolysis under humid air
abstract: Disclosed is a sulfide ion-conductive solid whose hydrogen sulfide generation upon exposure to humid air is 10 cm3/g or less. After ball milling, the ion-conductive solid precursor is pressed and sintered. A hexachloride of yttrium or indium may serve as the catholyte. An H2S generation of 10 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 80% or more are obtained. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. The ion-conductive solid may comprise beta-Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. An all-solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. An all-solid-state lithium battery using the moisture-stable sulfide shows improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 1 hours is 65% or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 25 cm3/g or less.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and a film-forming additive
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The 1.0 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.5 V. With 1 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The stable passivation film formed by lithium difluorophosphate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide dissolved in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate and 1,3-propane sultone as an additive in an amount of 2 wt%. With 2 wt% of 1,3-propane sultone, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 2 wt% of 1,3-propane sultone is also described. The additive 1,3-propane sultone decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The combination of 1,3-propane sultone and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The capacity retention of 92% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without 1,3-propane sultone.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising 1,3-propane sultone, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The stable passivation film formed by 1,3-propane sultone suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The additive 1,3-propane sultone decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. With 3 wt% of 1,3-propane sultone, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyethylene oxide and lithium perchlorate and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The polymer electrolyte is laminated with a thin ceramic ion conductor layer to block dendrites. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The polymer matrix is polyethylene oxide and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyethylene oxide. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyethylene oxide; a lithium salt comprising lithium perchlorate; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide ceramic ion conductor and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a ceramic ion conductor whose anodic decomposition at high potential is suppressed by a surface region of 5 nm to 50 nm. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li7P3S11, beta-Li3PS4, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. The substitution amount is 8 mol%, which gives an oxidation limit of 4.2 V or more and a conductivity of 0.7 mS/cm or more. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. A protected lithium metal negative electrode is one example of the counter electrode. The oxide ceramic ion conductor enables the use of a 5 V class cathode and improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a substitution amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.2 V or more.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a non-aqueous electrolyte for a lithium ion battery with improved storage characteristics at 45 degrees C. The capacity retention of 88% after 1000 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. With 2 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, the capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Lithium indium chloride-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery
abstract: A core-shell positive electrode active material for a sulfide-based all-solid-state battery is described. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. The cubic argyrodite-type structure tolerates chlorine and bromine on the 4a and 4d sites. In an embodiment the material is Li3InCl6. A coverage of 85% and a thickness of 3 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 50%. The resulting Li3InCl6 material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. A halide coating of Li3InCl6 or Li3YCl6 may be formed on the positive electrode active material to further lower the interfacial resistance. The Li3InCl6 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. The coated particles are heat-treated at 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. An all-solid-state battery using the coated active material shows improved electrochemical window and high-voltage stability and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 500 degrees C, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 0.3 nm to 15 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more.

title: Negative electrode structure with uniform lithium nucleation and high critical current density
abstract: Disclosed is a dendrite-suppressing structure in which an indium-containing additive at the lithium interface raises the critical current density. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The material comprises Li3YCl6, beta-Li3PS4, and lithium fluoride (LiF), and the electronic conductivity of the solid electrolyte layer is 1 x 10^-9 S/cm or less to prevent lithium deposition inside the layer. The plating overpotential is 30 mV or less and the Coulombic efficiency is 99.5% after 100 cycles. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. An all-solid-state battery using the solid electrolyte shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved interfacial resistance. A stack pressure of 2.5 MPa to 10 MPa is applied so that void formation at the interface during stripping is suppressed. Because nucleation is uniform, the local current density is reduced and the interfacial resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a solid electrolyte layer; and an additive comprising indium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 1 MPa to 25 MPa, and wherein the content of the indium additive is 0.1 wt% to 5 wt%, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 0.8 mA/cm2 or more.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY Co., Ltd.
title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 600 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. A solid electrolyte sheet of 50 micrometers is used as the separator. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: Provided is a solid electrolyte comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 80%. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 72:28, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The material comprises Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, beta-Li3PS4, and Li7P3S11 in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the solid electrolyte layer of the all-solid-state battery. The content of Li2O is 5 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 320 degrees C, and the conductivity is 2.2 mS/cm or more. Precipitation of the metastable phase gives a conductivity higher than that of the glass, while the electrochemical window is retained.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 60% to 95%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 280 degrees C to 360 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 4 hours.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for ammonia with improved response time
abstract: Described is a thick film gas sensor whose sensing electrode is printed on a ceramic ion conductor. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 300 degrees C. The platinum electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The ceramic is sodium beta-alumina and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 300 degrees C. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 300 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising platinum, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of ammonia.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 10 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 650 to 800 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 50 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 650 to 800 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. The solid electrolyte layer of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and method for producing the same
abstract: A glassy sulfide ceramic ion conductor with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. The positive electrode active material may be coated with lithium niobate or a similar oxide to lower the interfacial resistance. Crystallization is performed at 240 degrees C to 320 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 12 hours, which precipitates a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. The precipitated Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and Li7P3S11. The LGPS, Li6PS5Cl, and Li7P3S11 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. Dendrite growth is suppressed by an additive that promotes uniform deposition. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The glassy matrix absorbs volume change of the electrode and improves the cycle life of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 240 degrees C to 320 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 16 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The cold isostatic pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 16 stacked cells.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 16 stacked cells
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a aluminum current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 500 kPa. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 60 degrees C after lamination. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. With 2 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. The capacity retention of 90% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without fluoroethylene carbonate.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising fluoroethylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a nickel sulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyvinylidene fluoride. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 600 mAh/g and retains 80% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. A separator coated with porous carbon traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The initial capacity of 600 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The active material nickel sulfide is combined with porous carbon and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. A lithium-sulfur battery with the nickel sulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising nickel sulfide, porous carbon, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the nickel sulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor powder
abstract: Provided is a method in which a solvate complex of Li3PS4 is precipitated from acetonitrile, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The reaction at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C for 24 hours gives a precipitate yield of 95% or more. The material comprises Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. A hexachloride of yttrium or indium may serve as the catholyte. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. The solvate complex precipitate is separated by filtration and the solvent is removed at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure. Specific examples are Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. A dry process in which the ceramic ion conductor powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the all-solid-state battery. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. The method does not require long mechanical milling and gives a ceramic ion conductor with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in acetonitrile to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 5 wt% to 20 wt%, and wherein the reaction temperature is 10 degrees C to 45 degrees C, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyethylene oxide and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing alumina nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The membrane of 20 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyethylene oxide and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 20 micrometers. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyethylene oxide matrix.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of polyethylene oxide and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 20 micrometers or less.

title: Tantalum-doped garnet ion-conductive solid sintered body with high relative density and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant tantalum stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. When v is 0.5, the cubic phase fraction is 97% or more and the conductivity is 1 mS/cm. The Li3PS4 and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in an all-solid-state battery. Suitable compositions include beta-Li3PS4 and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. Sintering is performed at 1150 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. The low grain boundary resistance results in improved cycle life and interfacial resistance compared with a garnet sintered without the aid.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Ta(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an average grain size of 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 92% or more.

title: Moisture-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor and method for handling in a dry room
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a hygroscopicity of 1 wt% or less and a tin-rich surface region is described. An all-solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved grain boundary resistance. The tin substitution amount is 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. The surface region is enriched in a soft-acid element so that the hydrolysis of the sulfide by water vapor is suppressed. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The substitution amount is 2 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 550 degrees C, and the conductivity is 3.1 mS/cm or more. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. The obtained powder is cast as a slurry in a nonpolar solvent with a rubber binder on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. Because H2S generation is reduced, the safety of the manufacturing process and the grain boundary resistance are improved.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 24 hours is 60% or more, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 40 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a tin substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having argyrodite structure with controlled halogen occupancy
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich argyrodite phosphosulfide having the composition Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x) and to an all-solid-state battery comprising the same. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. The bromine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 5.1 mS/cm. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. The material is useful as a ceramic ion conductor layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved grain boundary resistance and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein 0.4 <= x <= 0.85, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 500 kPa
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The lithium battery is operated at 120 degrees C under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 500 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the tantalum anode. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The equivalent series resistance is 15 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. A solid electrolyte of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of tantalum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) doped with p-toluenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 15 milliohms or less.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyethylene oxide matrix, lithium perchlorate as the lithium salt, and succinonitrile as a plasticizer. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The lithium perchlorate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyethylene oxide matrix. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers. The membrane of 50 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyethylene oxide and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, succinonitrile, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 12:1.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The capacitor has a capacitance of 470 microfarads, a rated voltage of 10 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 15 milliohms at 100 kHz. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 15 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The tantalum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous tantalum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 ion-conductive solid with reduced grain boundary resistance and lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sintering method for a garnet ion-conductive solid using a mother powder cover and a lithium excess of 5 mol%. The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 3.2 micrometers to 24 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. The ion-conductive component may be Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. A lithium secondary battery using a lithium metal anode together with the ion-conductive solid shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. The total ionic conductivity is 0.7 mS/cm or more and the grain boundary resistance is 20% or less of the total resistance. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. A lithium secondary battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved moisture stability. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ion-conductive solid layer of the lithium secondary battery. A lithium excess of 5 mol% is added to the mother powder to compensate the loss of lithium during sintering. The dense garnet body suppresses lithium penetration along grain boundaries and improves the moisture stability and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 2 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 94% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 1150 degrees C to 1300 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 650 to 800 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 650 to 800 degrees C. The cell can be operated at 650 to 800 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 5 micrometers. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. With 0.5 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing 1,3-propane sultone as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive.
