The dispersion of polyaniline gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 220 microfarad rating. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. The polyaniline layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 20 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The niobium capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. A capacitance of 220 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of niobium; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising polyaniline doped with polystyrene sulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 20 milliohms or less.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The anode support contains nickel oxide and lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer of lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. A power density of 0.8 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. The thin 10 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 0.8 W/cm2. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite cell.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 10 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing vinylene carbonate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V. With 0.5 wt% of vinylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. The combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.2 M and adding vinylene carbonate in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 40 degrees C. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyacrylonitrile chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The polymer electrolyte is laminated with a thin ceramic ion conductor layer to block dendrites. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyacrylonitrile; a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Wet coating method for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer on a release film and method for preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer that has a solid content of 30 wt% to 50 wt% and a viscosity of 500 mPa s to 2000 mPa s. The coating speed is 5 m/min and the layer dried at 60 degrees C to 100 degrees C has a thickness of 15 micrometers. The slurry has a solid content of 30 wt% to 50 wt% and a viscosity of 500 mPa s to 2000 mPa s at 25 degrees C, which is suitable for doctor blade casting. The ceramic ion conductor may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. The release film is a PET film having a silicone release layer, and the dried layer is peeled from the release film and pressed onto an electrode. Specific examples are lithium fluoride (LiF) and beta-Li3PS4. A lithium secondary battery comprising the LiF and Li3PS4 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The controlled viscosity gives a uniform thickness and improved ionic conductivity and dendrite suppression.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene block copolymer binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising butyl butyrate in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the thickness of the dried layer is 5 micrometers to 75 micrometers, and wherein the slurry has a binder content of 0.3 wt% to 15 wt%.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing vinylene carbonate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.2 M and a film-forming additive. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V. The 1.2 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. A solid electrolyte interphase rich in inorganic components is formed on the graphite.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and vinylene carbonate in an amount of 3 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by cold isostatic pressing
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a aluminum current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polyethylene oxide and lithium perchlorate and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The membrane of 30 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyethylene oxide and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The polyethylene oxide electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, succinonitrile, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: Solvent-free free-standing solid electrolyte sheet with fibrillated PTFE binder for lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a roll-pressing method for forming a solid electrolyte film without any solvent. With a binder content of 2 wt% and a roll temperature of 100 degrees C, the sheet has a porosity of 30% or less. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. The powder is mixed with the PTFE binder at a roll temperature of 100 degrees C to form a continuous film. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. No solvent is used in the process, so the solid electrolyte does not react with a polar solvent and retains its conductivity. A lithium secondary battery comprising the LATP and LLZO material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The method shortens the process and improves the interfacial resistance of the layer.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing solid electrolyte sheet, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the free-standing solid electrolyte sheet has a roll temperature of 70 degrees C to 130 degrees C, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 12 micrometers to 60 micrometers, and wherein the tensile strength of the sheet is 1.2 MPa or more.

title: Composite cathode comprising sulfur and ketjen black and lithium secondary battery
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which sulfur is confined in the pores of ketjen black to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. The carbon coating on the sulfur composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyvinylidene fluoride. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. A lithium battery comprising the positive electrode and a negative electrode of lithium metal or silicon is also provided. A separator coated with ketjen black traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. In an embodiment the cathode is pressed against a sulfide solid electrolyte layer instead of a separator.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising sulfur and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Negative electrode structure with uniform lithium nucleation and high critical current density
abstract: A negative electrode structure with a critical current density of 1 mA/cm2 or more and a method for suppressing void formation during stripping are provided. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The additive forms an alloy with lithium during plating, which provides uniform nucleation sites and suppresses filament formation. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. The silver additive is dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer by pressing a mixed powder layer. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. With the additive in an amount of 5 wt% and a stack pressure of 2 MPa, the Coulombic efficiency is 99.7%. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably lithium fluoride (LiF), Li3InCl6, and Li3YCl6. The additive is useful for an anode-free configuration, with improved electrochemical window and moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a ceramic ion conductor layer; and an additive comprising silver dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 99.2% or more, and wherein the content of the silver additive is 2 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a critical current density at 25 degrees C of 1 mA/cm2 or more.

title: Air-stable sulfide solid electrolyte having a soft-acid surface region and solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte having a hygroscopicity of 1 wt% or less and a silicon-rich surface region is described. A solid-state battery comprising the Li3PS4, Li6PS5Cl, and LLZO material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -20 degrees C and the exposure time is 2 hours. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. The silicon substitution amount is 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and a conductivity of 1 mS/cm. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the solid electrolyte layer of the solid-state battery. The solid electrolyte retains its conductivity after atmospheric exposure and shows improved ionic conductivity and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by silicon; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 4 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 2 hours is 80% or more.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor resistant to hydrolysis under humid air and method for preparing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a moisture-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor and to a method of handling it in a dry room. The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. Specific examples are Li7P3S11, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The synthesized powder is made into a self-supporting film by solvent-free rolling, and the film has a porosity of 10% or less. In a solid-state lithium battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the ionic conductivity. The tin substitution amount is 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and the substituting element is concentrated in a surface region of 2 nm to 30 nm. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 2 micrometers and a conductivity of 3.2 mS/cm. The suppressed hydrolysis allows the sulfide to be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box, improving the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -30 degrees C for 24 hours is 65% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a tin substitution amount of 0.4 mol% to 8 mol%.

title: Method for forming a conductive polymer layer on a dielectric oxide of a solid electrolytic capacitor
abstract: Disclosed is a method for forming a conductive polymer layer by impregnating a dielectric-coated anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles. The niobium anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The equivalent series resistance is 10 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The dispersion of polyaniline gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 220 microfarad rating. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polyaniline layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The polyaniline is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous niobium anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 8 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The scandia-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. A power density of 1.5 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 600 to 750 degrees C operating range. The reversible cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 95% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the tantalum capacitor. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polypyrrole layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. A solid electrolyte of polypyrrole replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor. The equivalent series resistance is 5 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. The tantalum anode body with the polymer cathode gives a volumetric efficiency higher than a liquid electrolyte capacitor. The polypyrrole is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous tantalum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass and lithium battery
abstract: A glassy sulfide ion-conductive solid with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. A coated NCM cathode with a shell of 5 nm to 10 nm is one example of a compatible positive electrode. In an all-solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the grain boundary resistance. The glass phase contains LiI in an amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 1 micrometers and gives a pellet conductivity of 3.1 mS/cm after pressing at 360 MPa. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. An all-solid-state battery containing the crystallized glass shows improved grain boundary resistance and rate performance.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the content of LiI is 1 mol% to 4 mol%.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium tantalate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium tantalate and to a method for producing the same. A halide phase of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type having a trigonal or monoclinic structure is also formed, and its composition is adjusted by yttrium or indium substitution. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The ion-conductive component may be lithium niobate (LiNbO3), argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li3YCl6. The coating layer has an average thickness of 10 nm and a coverage of 85%, and the interfacial resistance is reduced by 60% relative to uncoated particles. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. The coated particles are heat-treated at 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. The tumbling fluidized bed gives uniform coating and improved interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 4 nm to 20 nm, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 50% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. The capacity retention of 88% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without fluoroethylene carbonate. With 0.5 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate at 1.0 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.4 V. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor element with a polypyrrole layer and a carbon cathode layer
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a aluminum solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the aluminum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The dispersion of polypyrrole gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 100 microfarad rating. The capacitor has a capacitance of 100 microfarads, a rated voltage of 6.3 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 5 milliohms at 100 kHz. The capacitor rated at 6.3 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The anode body is a sintered pellet of aluminum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a aluminum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 6.3 V.

title: Method for co-sintering an anode support and a dense zirconia electrolyte layer for a solid oxide fuel cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C. A power density of 1.5 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 600 to 750 degrees C operating range. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The samarium-doped ceria electrolyte of 98% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising samarium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 15 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 2 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. The primer layer on the nickel-plated copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 2 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar copper current collectors. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 2 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide solid electrolyte using acetonitrile for lithium battery
abstract: Described is a liquid-phase route to a sulfide solid electrolyte that does not require long mechanical milling. An amorphous zirconate or tantalate shell on the nickel-rich active material suppresses the space-charge layer. In an embodiment the solid electrolyte layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. After drying, the residual solvent content is 0.5 wt% or less and the carbon content is 0.5 wt% or less. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 0.5 micrometers and a conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm. The reaction is performed in a stirred reactor having a volume of 10 L or more, and the precipitate is washed with fresh solvent. Because the raw materials react in the liquid phase, the method is scalable and gives a powder with improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in acetonitrile to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 0 degrees C to 140 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 70 degrees C to 250 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 250 degrees C to 500 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 0.6 mS/cm or more, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 70 degrees C to 250 degrees C, and wherein the reaction temperature is 0 degrees C to 140 degrees C.

assignee_raw: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY-ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
assignee_db_group: SEODAM NATIONAL UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with Li3InCl6 and method for producing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium indium chloride formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. A dry process is preferred for forming the solid electrolyte sheet because contact with a polar solvent is avoided. The coated particles are heat-treated at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. The active material having a halide coating is mixed with the material in a weight ratio of 70:30 to 85:15. Nickel accounts for 85 mol% of the transition metals, and the heat treatment is performed at 400 degrees C. A solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Calendering of the kneaded powder gives a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness. The solid electrolyte may comprise argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and Li3InCl6. A dendrite-suppressing additive such as magnesium or zinc may be placed at the lithium metal interface. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium indium chloride, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The lithium indium chloride shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the electrochemical window and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium indium chloride (Li3InCl6), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 75 mol% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 20% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 3.2 nm to 16 nm.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by uniaxial pressing at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. A solid electrolyte sheet of 50 micrometers is used as the separator. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The lithium battery is operated at 120 degrees C under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor element with a poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer and a carbon cathode layer
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a niobium solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. A capacitance of 47 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the niobium capacitor. The dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 47 microfarad rating.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous niobium anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium borate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium borate formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. The coated active material shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 100 cycles with a sulfide solid electrolyte. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. The coating layer comprises amorphous lithium borate (Li3BO3) and has an average thickness of 1.2 nm to 6 nm and a coverage of 85% or more determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 90%. An all-solid-state battery comprising the Li2ZrO3, Li6PS5Cl, and LiNbO3 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The suppression of the space-charge layer results in a smaller interfacial resistance and improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium borate (Li3BO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 75 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.2 nm to 6 nm.

title: Method for sintering a cubic garnet solid electrolyte using a mother powder
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant niobium stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 4 micrometers to 30 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. The cubic argyrodite structure tolerates chlorine and bromine on the 4a and 4d sites. The green pellet is covered with the mother powder during sintering at 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C, which compensates lithium volatilization. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Sintering at 1200 degrees C with a lithium excess of 5 mol% gives a relative density of 95% and a conductivity of 1 mS/cm. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. Because lithium volatilization is suppressed, the cubic phase is retained and the high-voltage stability is improved.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a relative density of 92% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a sintering temperature of 1120 degrees C to 1270 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 2 mol% to 10 mol%.

assignee_db_group: BRIEXUS UNIVERSITY INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION
title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 5 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The solid electrolyte layer of lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The thin 5 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 0.8 W/cm2. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The roll pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The laminate of 2 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by uniaxial pressing and the release film is peeled. A lithium battery pack comprising 8 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The laminate is pressed by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by uniaxial pressing. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The uniaxial pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Electrochemical gas sensor with a yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte for detecting sulfur dioxide
abstract: This disclosure concerns a multilayer ceramic sensor element produced by co-firing green sheets of zirconia and alumina. The protective layer improves the durability of the yttria-stabilized zirconia sensor in an exhaust gas. The sensor shows a response time of 20 seconds to a step change of sulfur dioxide concentration at 300 degrees C. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 300 degrees C. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 300 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. The sensing electrode comprises platinum and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting sulfur dioxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 300 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.3 V. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide ion-conductive solid and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: A NASICON-type or perovskite-type oxide ion-conductive solid with an oxidation limit of 4.7 V or more is described. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. An oxidation-resistant surface region comprising lithium phosphate is formed on the particles by an oxygen anneal after sintering. The coating layer on the cathode particle suppresses the interfacial reaction with the sulfide. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. A capacity retention of 90% after 200 cycles at 4.6 V is obtained with the substituted oxide. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li2ZrO3, LLZO, and LLTO material. The surface region acts as an oxidation barrier and improves the grain boundary resistance and high-voltage stability of the electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a perovskite-type LLTO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 75% or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 50 microamperes per square centimeter or less.

title: Potentiometric oxygen sensor having an auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting oxygen comprises a sodium beta-alumina ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising gold, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The multilayer structure with the sodium beta-alumina ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The limiting current is proportional to the oxygen concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium nitrite and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The protective layer improves the durability of the sodium beta-alumina sensor in an exhaust gas.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising sodium beta-alumina, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by warm isostatic pressing
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 2 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar copper current collectors. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The lithium battery is operated at 120 degrees C under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 200 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The bipolar stacking of 2 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Composite cathode comprising iron sulfide and porous carbon and lithium secondary battery
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. The iron sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with porous carbon by ball milling. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using carboxymethyl cellulose. The sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The active material iron sulfide is combined with porous carbon and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1000 mAh/g and retains 80% of the capacity after 100 cycles at 0.5 C. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and carboxymethyl cellulose.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising iron sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and a film-forming additive
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, 1,3-propane sultone, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 0.5 wt% of 1,3-propane sultone is also described. The stable passivation film formed by 1,3-propane sultone suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 1000 cycles. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The combination of 1,3-propane sultone and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising 1,3-propane sultone, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous niobium anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The polystyrene sulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 105 degrees C storage. The anode body is a sintered pellet of niobium powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the niobium capacitor. The capacitor withstands 105 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the niobium anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a niobium anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 25 V.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Oxygen-substituted sulfide ceramic ion conductor with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a sulfide ceramic ion conductor whose hydrogen sulfide generation upon exposure to humid air is 10 cm3/g or less. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3PS4 and LATP material. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -40 degrees C and the exposure time is 2 hours. After exposure to air with a dew point of -40 degrees C for 2 hours, the conductivity retention is 80%. In an embodiment the material is beta-Li3PS4 and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. A protected lithium metal negative electrode is one example of the counter electrode. The material is useful for electrode slurry processing in a dry room, with improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by oxygen; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 2 hours is 70% or more.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 solid electrolyte with reduced grain boundary resistance and method for producing the same
abstract: A garnet solid electrolyte sintered body having an average grain size of 10 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. A sintering aid comprising Al2O3 is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. The amount of the sintering aid is 2 wt%, the sintering temperature is 1250 degrees C, and the resulting density is 96%. The solid electrolyte may comprise Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and Li7P3S11. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The dense garnet body suppresses lithium penetration along grain boundaries and improves the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.16 mS/cm or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide solid electrolyte has a lithium excess of 10 mol% to 30 mol%.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having argyrodite structure with controlled halogen occupancy
abstract: An argyrodite ion-conductive solid represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y) and a method for producing the same are described. The obtained powder is cast as a slurry in a nonpolar solvent with a rubber binder on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ion-conductive solid powder. Devitrification of the amorphous phase is controlled by the heat treatment temperature. Partial substitution of chlorine with iodine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. A pellet pressed from the powder has a density of 1.85 g/cm3 or more and shows a conductivity of 8.5 mS/cm. An all-solid-state battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved sinterability. An all-solid-state battery using a lithium metal anode together with the ion-conductive solid shows stable plating and stripping for 300 cycles or more. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)I(y), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less, and wherein 1.1 <= a <= 1.5, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 430 degrees C to 530 degrees C.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 300 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. A lithium battery pack comprising 8 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 30 micrometers. The lithium hexafluorophosphate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyacrylonitrile matrix. The polymer matrix is polyacrylonitrile and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20 and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated therein. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 80:20, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The crystallized glass has an ionic conductivity of 3.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a degree of crystallinity of 50%. The Li6PS5X phase may be combined with a halogen-rich sulfide to raise the superionic conductivity. A lithium metal halide of the Li3YCl6 or Li3InCl6 type may be used as a catholyte on the positive electrode side. The ion-conductive solid is preferably beta-Li3PS4 and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3PS4 and LGPS material. The glass phase contains Li2O in an amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase. Because the crystal phase is precipitated inside the glass, the grain boundary resistance is small and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C, and wherein the content of Li2O is 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more.

title: Lithium metal halide solid electrolyte represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Ti(z)Cl6 and method for producing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a halide solid electrolyte in which titanium is substituted for part of the yttrium in a lithium yttrium chloride framework. Examples of the ion conductor include lithium fluoride (LiF), Li3YCl6, and Li3InCl6. The titanium substitution in an amount z of 0.1 to 0.35 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. The anodic decomposition at high voltage is suppressed when an oxidation-resistant oxide is used. The LiF, Li3YCl6, and Li3InCl6 material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state battery. The halide shows an activation energy of 0.35 eV or less and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm. The disclosure also provides a dry process for laminating the solid electrolyte layer onto an electrode of the solid-state battery without a drying step. A core-shell cathode particle with a nanometer-thick LiNbO3 coating of high coverage is used on the positive electrode side. Because the chloride framework is oxidation-resistant, the high-voltage stability at 4.3 V is improved.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Ti(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.32 mS/cm or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 180 degrees C to 420 degrees C.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using styrene-butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 4 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar copper current collectors. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The lithium battery is operated at 25 degrees C under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 200 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a copper current collector is also provided. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The structure with the copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 650 to 800 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 8 micrometers. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. The yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. The cell can be operated at 650 to 800 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The thin 8 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.5 W/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 8 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 4 stacked cells
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 4 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar stainless steel current collectors. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 200 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid electrolyte oxygen sensor element with a heater and protective layer
abstract: An amperometric sensor in which nitrogen oxide is pumped through a diffusion barrier by an oxide ion conducting ceramic is provided. The auxiliary electrode of lithium carbonate makes the sensor selective to nitrogen oxide against interfering gases. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 500 degrees C. The limiting current is proportional to the nitrogen oxide concentration from 0.1% to 20%. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The sensing electrode comprises platinum and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising lithium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects nitrogen oxide.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Wet coating method for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer on a release film and method for preparing the same
abstract: A method for producing a ceramic ion conductor sheet by slurry casting, drying, and peeling from a support film is provided. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. The viscosity of 1000 mPa s allows a uniform wet film, and the dried thickness variation is 5% or less. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The binder is a rubber that keeps the layer flexible after drying and does not block the ion conduction between particles. The nonpolar solvent does not degrade the ceramic ion conductor, and the layer shows improved ionic conductivity and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising anisole in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 0.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the slurry has a binder content of 2 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the solid content of the slurry is 50 wt% to 70 wt%.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The carbon coating on the molybdenum disulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. A lithium-sulfur battery with the molybdenum disulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% at 25 degrees C. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 85%. A separator coated with carbon nanotubes traps the polysulfides on the cathode side.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery, comprising: a porous carbon comprising carbon nanotubes; molybdenum disulfide impregnated in pores of the porous carbon in an amount of 60 wt% to 80 wt%; and a carbon coating layer having a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm on a surface of the porous carbon.

title: Protective layer suppressing lithium filament penetration and method for forming the same
abstract: A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode comprises an inorganic layer of lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. The inorganic layer comprises lithium fluoride or lithium phosphorus oxynitride and has a thickness of 500 nm. A lithium-ion conductive glass ceramic may be mixed with the solid electrolyte in the solid-state battery. The ion-conductive component may be Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The protective layer thickness is 200 nm to 1000 nm and the Coulombic efficiency is 98.5% or more. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. The polymer layer keeps the contact during volume change and improves the high-voltage stability and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 1 micrometers to 6 micrometers, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 98.5% or more, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 200 nm to 1000 nm.

title: Bromine-substituted Li6PS5X ion-conductive solid and lithium battery and solid-state lithium battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a halogen-rich Li6PS5X phosphosulfide having the composition Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x) and to a solid-state lithium battery comprising the same. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. When combined with a halide coating on the cathode particles, the oxidative decomposition at high potential is further suppressed. The LGPS material is used in a solid-state lithium battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode.
