title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 0.5 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate is also described. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 90% of its capacity after 500 cycles. The stable passivation film formed by lithium bis(oxalato)borate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using polytetrafluoroethylene and electrode produced thereby
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a stainless steel current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 600 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide ion-conductive solid and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is an oxidation-resistant oxide ion-conductive solid having a widened electrochemical window for use with a high-voltage positive electrode such as LiCoPO4. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. The electrochemical window measured by cyclic voltammetry on a blocking electrode extends to 5.5 V versus Li/Li+. The oxidation potential is 4.8 V versus Li/Li+, the decomposition current at 5 V is 5 microamperes per square centimeter, and the conductivity is 0.3 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The ion-conductive component may be Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A lithium battery using the oxide shows improved ionic conductivity at a charging voltage of 4.6 V.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.21 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.5 V or more.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 8 stacked cells
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and nitrile butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The lithium battery is operated at 80 degrees C under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for sulfur dioxide with improved response time
abstract: An amperometric sensor in which sulfur dioxide is pumped through a diffusion barrier by an oxide ion conducting ceramic is provided. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium nitrite and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The gold electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite makes the sensor selective to sulfur dioxide against interfering gases. The electromotive force across the solid electrolyte follows the Nernst equation. The sensor shows a response time of 20 seconds to a step change of sulfur dioxide concentration at 300 degrees C. The ceramic is NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 300 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Air-stable sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a soft-acid surface region and method for producing the same
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a hygroscopicity of 1 wt% or less and an arsenic-free antimony-rich surface region is described. The dew point of the handling atmosphere is -40 degrees C and the exposure time is 2 hours. The ion-conductive component may be argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. An argyrodite phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. The cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes of exposure to air with a dew point of -40 degrees C is 5 cm3/g. An H2S generation of 10 cm3/g or less and a conductivity retention of 80% or more are obtained. The ceramic ion conductor is a lithium ion conducting material for an all-solid-state battery. The ceramic ion conductor retains its conductivity after atmospheric exposure and shows improved ionic conductivity and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by arsenic-free antimony; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the cumulative H2S generation after 60 minutes is 10 cm3/g or less, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an arsenic-free antimony substitution amount of 1.5 mol% to 6 mol%, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 2 hours is 80% or more.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A glassy sulfide solid electrolyte with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. The solid electrolyte is preferably argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state lithium battery. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. An argyrodite-type sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. After heat treatment at 260 degrees C for 3 hours, the conductivity rises from 0.2 mS/cm for the glass to 2.5 mS/cm. The glass phase contains GeS2 in an amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, which lowers the crystallization temperature and stabilizes the Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase. Precipitation of the metastable phase gives a conductivity higher than that of the glass, while the cycle life is retained.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 30% to 65%, and wherein the content of GeS2 is 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for hydrogen with improved response time
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting hydrogen comprises a gadolinium-doped ceria ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising gold, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The ceramic is gadolinium-doped ceria and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 400 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the gadolinium-doped ceria ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The protective layer improves the durability of the gadolinium-doped ceria sensor in an exhaust gas. The auxiliary electrode comprises lithium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The sensor shows a response time of 20 seconds to a step change of hydrogen concentration at 400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising lithium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects hydrogen.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Described is a combination of fluoroethylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 60 degrees C. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The combination of fluoroethylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate is added in an amount of 3 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 3 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 3 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: This disclosure concerns a tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and a nickel cermet anode. The cell can be operated at 650 to 800 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The thin 15 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.0 W/cm2. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 15 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 650 to 800 degrees C. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Mixed potential type carbon dioxide sensor and method of manufacturing the sensing electrode
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting carbon dioxide comprises a sodium beta-alumina ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 700 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. The sensor operating at 700 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for carbon dioxide. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 700 degrees C. The limiting current is proportional to the carbon dioxide concentration from 0.1% to 20%.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising sodium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects carbon dioxide.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide and a film-forming additive
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 90% of its capacity after 300 cycles. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The additive 1,3-propane sultone decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The additive 1,3-propane sultone reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria with a thickness of 5 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the samarium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 600 to 750 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of samarium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 97% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.2 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 700 to 850 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. The reversible cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 10 micrometers. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 700 to 850 degrees C operating range. The solid electrolyte layer of scandia-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The cell can be operated at 700 to 850 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid through a solvate complex precipitate
abstract: Described is a liquid-phase route to a sulfide ion-conductive solid that does not require long mechanical milling. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A dry process in which the ion-conductive solid powder is kneaded with a fibrillated binder is used to form the layer of the solid-state battery. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ion-conductive solid layer of the solid-state battery. The dried precipitate is heat-treated at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C in an argon atmosphere to convert the complex into the crystalline sulfide. The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), which is obtained from the solution-based precursor after drying and heat treatment. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. A residual solvent content of 0.2 wt% or less is achieved by vacuum drying, and the conductivity is 3 mS/cm. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. Because the raw materials react in the liquid phase, the method is scalable and gives a powder with improved grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl propionate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, wherein the residual solvent content is 0.2 wt% or less, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the reaction temperature is 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C.

title: niobium solid electrolytic capacitor having a low equivalent series resistance
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. The anode body is a sintered pellet of niobium powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the niobium anode. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. A capacitance of 100 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous niobium anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M and a film-forming additive. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.3 V. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change. With 0.5 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, the capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate, a first additive comprising tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Wet coating method for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer on a release film and solid-state battery including the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a slurry composition with controlled viscosity and solid content for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer. The binder is styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene block copolymer in an amount of 0.8 wt% to 4 wt% and is dissolved in the nonpolar solvent a mixed solvent of toluene and heptane. The slurry has a solid content of 50 wt% and a viscosity of 1000 mPa s at 25 degrees C, and the dried layer has a thickness of 15 micrometers and a conductivity of 1.2 mS/cm. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. The negative electrode may be metallic lithium with a fluorinated protective layer. After ball milling, the ceramic ion conductor precursor is pressed and sintered. Also described is a solid-state battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The wet process is useful for forming a layer on a large area, with improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a styrene-ethylene-butylene-styrene block copolymer binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising a mixed solvent of toluene and heptane in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the slurry has a binder content of 0.8 wt% to 4 wt%, and wherein the viscosity of the slurry at 25 degrees C is 500 mPa s to 2000 mPa s, and wherein the solid content of the slurry is 40 wt% to 60 wt%.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.4 V. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.4 V. The 1.0 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 1 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite is also described. With 1 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, the capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with LiTaO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: Described is a cathode particle coated with a nanometer-thick LiTaO3 shell that lowers the interfacial resistance. Examples of the ion conductor include Li3InCl6 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. The reduction of the interfacial resistance is 20% or more, and the interfacial resistance after 50 cycles at 4.3 V is 30 ohm cm2 or less. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li3InCl6 and Li6PS5Cl material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The material comprises Li3InCl6 and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and the coating layer is disposed between the active material and the sulfide ion conductor. A precursor of the Li3InCl6 and Li6PS5Cl material obtained by ball milling of the starting materials is used. When a lithium metal anode is used, the layer facing the anode preferably has a thickness of 10 micrometers or more. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. A lithium secondary battery using the coated active material shows improved high-voltage stability and interfacial resistance and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 20% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 75 mol% or more.

title: Crystallized sulfide glass ion-conductive solid containing a thio-LISICON phase and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid in which a thio-LISICON type crystal is embedded in a glass is described, together with a solid-state battery using it. A halogen-rich Li6PS5X with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. The material comprises Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), Li7P3S11, and beta-Li3PS4 in which the glassy matrix fills the gaps between the precipitated crystals. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is thio-LISICON, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. After heat treatment at 320 degrees C for 5 hours, the conductivity rises from 0.2 mS/cm for the glass to 1.8 mS/cm. A Li6PS5X sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. The ion-conductive solid is a lithium ion conducting material for a solid-state battery. Precipitation of the metastable phase gives a conductivity higher than that of the glass, while the moisture stability is retained.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more, and wherein the content of LiI is 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by uniaxial pressing and the release film is peeled. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. A solid electrolyte sheet of 30 micrometers is used as the separator. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by uniaxial pressing. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 80 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The current collector of copper is used in a lithium battery with a 30 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1. The polycarbonate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 100 micrometers. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm are obtained. The polymer matrix is polycarbonate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor. The capacitor has a capacitance of 330 microfarads, a rated voltage of 25 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 8 milliohms at 100 kHz. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The tantalum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 105 degrees C storage.
first_claim: 1. A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles doped with naphthalenesulfonate, a polyhydric alcohol, and water, wherein the particles have a median diameter of 20 nm to 100 nm.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 700 to 850 degrees C with a barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C. The gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte of 95% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and gadolinium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. A 3 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

title: Lithium yttrium chloride-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a nickel-rich cathode material coated with lithium yttrium chloride and to a method for producing the same. The solid electrolyte may comprise lithium niobate (LiNbO3), Li3InCl6, and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). The electrode mixture of the lithium secondary battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium yttrium chloride, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LiNbO3, Li3InCl6, and Li2ZrO3 material. The coated particles are heat-treated at 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C in an oxygen-containing atmosphere so that the shell remains amorphous. A coverage of 95% and a thickness of 15 nm give an interfacial resistance reduction of 50%. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. The high coverage of the coating results in improved cycle life at a charging voltage of 4.3 V or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium yttrium chloride (Li3YCl6), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 40% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 400 degrees C.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate dissolved in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate and vinylene carbonate as an additive in an amount of 0.5 wt%. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The additive vinylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and vinylene carbonate in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by roll pressing
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by roll pressing and the release film is peeled. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The structure with the copper current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The current collector of copper is used in a lithium battery with a 100 micrometer thick electrolyte sheet. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 100 micrometers. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor having a porous aluminum anode body and a hybrid electrolyte
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. The capacitor withstands 105 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 105 degrees C storage. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The anode body is a sintered pellet of aluminum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor element with a polypyrrole layer and a carbon cathode layer
abstract: A conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and a capacitor using the dispersion are provided. The capacitor withstands 150 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The capacitor rated at 35 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The tantalum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The p-toluenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 150 degrees C storage.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 35 V.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria with a thickness of 3 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The solid electrolyte of gadolinium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 96% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The thin 3 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 0.8 W/cm2. The stack shows stable operation over 100 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 500 to 650 degrees C. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 3 micrometers and a relative density of 96%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Described is a solid electrolytic capacitor element whose leakage current is reduced by a repair step of the dielectric film. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the tantalum anode. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 125 degrees C storage. The capacitor has a capacitance of 47 microfarads, a rated voltage of 10 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 20 milliohms at 100 kHz. The conductive polymer layer contains a polyhydric alcohol as an additive that improves the coverage on the dielectric. The solid electrolyte layer covers the dielectric oxide film inside the pores of the anode body.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of tantalum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) doped with naphthalenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 20 milliohms or less.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 25 degrees C. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 25 degrees C. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a thermally crosslinked network of polyethylene oxide and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 20 micrometers or less.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing alumina nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 20 micrometers. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyethylene oxide. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The membrane of 20 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyethylene oxide and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a thermally crosslinked network of polyethylene oxide and lithium perchlorate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 20 micrometers or less.

title: Surface mount solid electrolytic capacitor and method of reducing leakage current
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. The polypyrrole is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The capacitor has a capacitance of 100 microfarads, a rated voltage of 35 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 5 milliohms at 100 kHz. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 150 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the polypyrrole layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The repair step reduces the leakage current and improves the reliability of the tantalum capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a tantalum anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 35 V.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor resistant to hydrolysis under humid air
abstract: Described is a moisture-resistant sulfide in which the soft acid tin binds the sulfur and reduces reaction with water vapor. The LLZO, Li7P3S11, and Li3PS4 material is also useful as a protective layer between a lithium metal anode and a sulfide layer. Coverage of the coating on the core particle is preferably 85% or more. The substitution amount is 2 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C, and the conductivity is 1 mS/cm or more. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), Li7P3S11, and beta-Li3PS4. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. Oxygen substitution of part of the sulfur forms P-O bonds that are stable against hydrolysis. An all-solid-state battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved grain boundary resistance. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), Li7P3S11, and beta-Li3PS4, and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 20 cm3/g or less. The reduced water vapor reaction lowers the interfacial resistance and improves the grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 300 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -20 degrees C for 1 hours is 65% or more.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: Provided is a ceramic ion conductor comprising a vitreous matrix and a metastable Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase, the material having a degree of crystallinity of 60%. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. Suitable compositions include argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). A sputtered inorganic protective layer of 100 nm may be used between the lithium and the material. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. The crystallized glass has an ionic conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a degree of crystallinity of 60%. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase precipitates uniformly. The SiS2 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the cycle life and electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 12 hours, and wherein the content of SiS2 is 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.3 mS/cm or more.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by warm isostatic pressing
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. The structure with the aluminum current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 300 MPa. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The current collector is a aluminum foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by uniaxial pressing
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a stainless steel current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 600 MPa. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 200 kPa
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 16 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar stainless steel current collectors. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The positive electrode mixture layer contains the solid electrolyte, lithium cobalt oxide, and a conductive agent. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Lithium fluoride protective layer for lithium metal negative electrode and lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to an artificial interphase formed on a lithium metal negative electrode by sputtering. The protective layer is deposited on a lithium foil of 20 micrometers thickness under an argon atmosphere. The resulting LLZO material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the protective layer forms an artificial interphase that is lithiophilic. A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. In a lithium secondary battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the sinterability. Cyclic voltammetry confirms that the oxide component is stable up to 5 V. After 300 cycles at 0.5 mA/cm2 the cell retains a Coulombic efficiency of 99.5% and no dendrite penetration is observed. A lithium metal battery using the protective layer shows improved sinterability and Coulombic efficiency.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 98.8% or more, and wherein the number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 150 cycles or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 1 micrometers to 6 micrometers.

title: Crystallized sulfide crystallized glass ion conductor containing a Li7P3S11 phase and all-solid-state battery including the same
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor in which a thio-LISICON type crystal is embedded in a glass is described, together with an all-solid-state battery using it. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. The content of P2O5 is 2 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 260 degrees C, and the conductivity is 2.2 mS/cm or more. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3PS4 material. The disclosure is applied to a lithium battery comprising the ceramic ion conductor. The crystallized glass combines the deformability of a vitreous phase with the high conductivity of the crystal phase, improving the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the degree of crystallinity is 50% to 85%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.2 mS/cm or more.

title: Solid electrolyte oxygen sensor element with a heater and protective layer
abstract: Provided is a potentiometric sensor having an auxiliary electrode phase of lithium carbonate that converts the ammonia concentration into an ionic activity. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 700 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode of lithium carbonate makes the sensor selective to ammonia against interfering gases. The sensor detects ammonia with high selectivity and a response time of 20 seconds. The ceramic is sodium beta-alumina and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 700 degrees C. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of ammonia.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and carboxymethyl cellulose binder
abstract: A positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery comprises titanium disulfide impregnated in carbon nanotubes and a carbon coating on the composite. The confinement of titanium disulfide in the carbon nanotubes suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the titanium disulfide cathode. The capacity retention after 500 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 90% of its capacity after 500 cycles is also described. The titanium disulfide is melt-diffused into carbon nanotubes at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. Polysulfide dissolution from the titanium disulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing titanium disulfide with carbon nanotubes; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the titanium disulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 50 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 25 degrees C. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm are obtained. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 500 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide dissolved in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate and lithium difluorophosphate as an additive in an amount of 1 wt%. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 1000 cycles is 88% with the electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The additive lithium difluorophosphate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The additive lithium difluorophosphate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The 1.2 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.2 M and adding lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 1 wt%.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite solid electrolyte having anion disorder and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: A lithium phosphosulfide solid electrolyte having a cubic argyrodite structure and a controlled halogen occupancy is described. The Li7P3S11 and LGPS material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. Partial substitution of chlorine with bromine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiCl impurity phase. The solid electrolyte exhibits an ionic conductivity of 5.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an activation energy of 0.28 eV or less. The raw materials of the solid electrolyte are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. A dendrite-suppressing additive such as magnesium or zinc may be placed at the lithium metal interface. The all-solid-state battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the solid electrolyte layer. A mixed-halogen argyrodite phase with a lattice parameter of 9.85 angstroms to 9.95 angstroms is obtained by firing at 550 degrees C. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. Compared with Li6PS5Cl, the bromine-substituted argyrodite shows a higher conductivity and better cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.8 mS/cm or more.

title: Method for suppressing lithium filament growth using an indium-containing additive layer
abstract: A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising an ion-conductive solid comprises a lithium metal layer, an ion-conductive solid layer, and an additive comprising indium dispersed at the interface to form uniform nucleation sites. A lithium secondary battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved ionic conductivity. An amorphous Li3PS4 glass with precipitated crystals is one example of a compatible conductor. The slurry may contain a dispersant and have a solid content of about 60 wt%. During stripping, the alloy phase of the additive keeps the contact and suppresses void growth. The critical current density at 25 degrees C is 1.5 mA/cm2 and the cell survives 500 cycles of plating and stripping without short circuit. The additive comprises indium in an amount of 0.4 wt% to 2 wt% and has an average particle size of 50 nm to 500 nm. The additive is useful for an anode-free configuration, with improved ionic conductivity and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising an ion-conductive solid, comprising: a lithium metal layer; an ion-conductive solid layer; and an additive comprising indium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the ion-conductive solid layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 2.5 MPa to 10 MPa, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 99% or more, and wherein the content of the indium additive is 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%.

title: Anode-supported solid oxide fuel cell having a thin yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode. The solid electrolyte layer of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 10 micrometers and a relative density of 95%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C. The thin 10 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.0 W/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass
abstract: A glassy sulfide solid electrolyte with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. The thickness of the interlayer is set to 50 nm to 2 micrometers so that the resistance increase is small. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. Specific examples are Li7P3S11 and beta-Li3PS4. An activation energy of 0.25 eV or less and a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C are obtained. The raw materials of the solid electrolyte are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The cell may employ a lithium metal anode, a lithium alloy anode, or a silicon-containing anode. A dense garnet layer of 95% relative density can be laminated with the material. The solid electrolyte shows improved moisture stability and ionic conductivity compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of GeS2 is 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 30% to 65%.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. The stable passivation film formed by tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 45 degrees C. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.0 M and adding tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 2 wt%.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 100 MPa. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Wet coating method for forming a solid electrolyte layer on a release film and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: A wet film of a solid electrolyte cast on a PET release film and dried in an oven is described. A halide with a close-packed chloride sublattice and octahedral yttrium is one example of an oxidation-stable conductor. The solid content is 60 wt% to 80 wt%, the viscosity is 1000 mPa s to 4000 mPa s, and the layer thickness is 6 micrometers to 30 micrometers. The solid electrolyte is applied as the electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The material comprises Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and the dispersant is an amine-based dispersant in an amount of 0.1 wt% to 1 wt%. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. The wet film is dried at 120 degrees C and the dried layer has a thickness of 6 micrometers to 30 micrometers. The nonpolar solvent does not degrade the solid electrolyte, and the layer shows improved cycle life and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a solid electrolyte layer, comprising: solid electrolyte particles; a hydrogenated nitrile butadiene rubber binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising butyl butyrate in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the slurry has a binder content of 2 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the solid content of the slurry is 60 wt% to 80 wt%, and wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 100 degrees C to 140 degrees C.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 200 kPa
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 120 degrees C after lamination. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The laminate of 2 cells forms a lithium battery whose negative electrode layer comprises silicon or lithium metal.
