The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 200 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Solid state electrochemical sensor for nitrogen oxide with improved response time
abstract: This disclosure concerns a multilayer ceramic sensor element produced by co-firing green sheets of zirconia and alumina. The nitrogen oxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 700 degrees C. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 700 degrees C. The sensor shows a response time of 2 seconds to a step change of nitrogen oxide concentration at 700 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. The ceramic is sodium beta-alumina and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 700 degrees C. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting nitrogen oxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising sodium beta-alumina; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 700 degrees C.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by cold isostatic pressing
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and nitrile butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 50 micrometer separator layer. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet. The module with 4 stacked cells has a voltage of 4 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The separator layer is a sheet of 50 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium perchlorate and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. The polymer matrix is poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. The lithium perchlorate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate matrix. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium perchlorate is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 60 degrees C. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 100 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The anode support contains nickel oxide and samarium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C. A power density of 1.5 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 700 to 850 degrees C operating range. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The solid electrolyte of samarium-doped ceria is a dense ceramic of 95% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The cell can be operated at 700 to 850 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 700 to 850 degrees C.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The lithium battery is operated at 60 degrees C under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. A solid electrolyte sheet of 30 micrometers is used as the separator. The current collector is a nickel-plated copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 200 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 200 kPa or more.

title: Li2O-containing vitreous sulfide ion-conductive solid and heat treatment method
abstract: This disclosure concerns a Li2S-P2S5 glass of 70:30 composition that is converted by quenching and reheating into a crystallized conductor. The content of Li2O is 2 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 300 degrees C, and the conductivity is 1.3 mS/cm or more. A trigonal or monoclinic halide of indium or scandium may be added to the positive electrode mixture. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 70:30, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. The ion-conductive component may be Li7P3S11, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4. The disclosure further provides a solid-state lithium battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li7P3S11, Li6PS5Cl, and Li3PS4 material. The material is useful as a separator layer or as a conductive component of an electrode, with improved electrochemical window and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of Li2O is 0.4 mol% to 8 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: Provided is a multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor in which capacitor elements are stacked and connected in parallel. The capacitor has a capacitance of 47 microfarads, a rated voltage of 6.3 V, and an equivalent series resistance of 20 milliohms at 100 kHz. The hybrid structure improves the self-healing of the dielectric film on the aluminum anode. The anode body is a sintered pellet of aluminum powder having a specific charge of 50,000 to 150,000 microfarad volts per gram. The polyaniline layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 20 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The dielectric oxide film is formed by anodizing the aluminum anode body in a phosphoric acid solution at a formation voltage of 2 to 4 times the rated voltage. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polyaniline particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: A single-ion conducting polymer electrolyte in which the anion is immobilized on the polymer backbone is provided. The polycarbonate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained. The polymer matrix is polycarbonate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1. titania nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polycarbonate matrix.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polycarbonate; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising succinonitrile in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm or more at 60 degrees C.

title: Self-supporting ion-conductive solid sheet having low porosity and method for calendering the same
abstract: A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet comprises ion-conductive solid particles and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network that binds the particles without a solvent. A lithium secondary battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved cycle life. The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the sheet is self-supporting and can be wound on a core having a diameter of 50 mm. The sheet has a thickness of 80 micrometers, a porosity of 10%, a tensile strength of 0.5 MPa, and an ionic conductivity of 1.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. The negative electrode may be metallic lithium with a fluorinated protective layer. A glass ceramic containing a crystalline phase in a glass matrix is preferred because of its deformability. The ion-conductive component may be argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The low porosity results in a low areal resistance and improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A free-standing ion-conductive solid sheet, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; and a fibrillated polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) binder forming a three-dimensional fibril network binding the particles without a solvent, wherein the porosity of the sheet is 20% or less, and wherein the thickness of the sheet is 32 micrometers to 160 micrometers, and wherein the content of the fibrillated binder is 0.8 wt% to 4 wt%.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The stable passivation film formed by lithium difluorophosphate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The 1.0 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 1 wt% of lithium difluorophosphate is also described. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and lithium difluorophosphate in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Positive electrode slurry containing a sulfide active material and polyvinylidene fluoride binder
abstract: Disclosed is a composite cathode in which titanium disulfide is confined in the pores of porous carbon to suppress the dissolution of polysulfides. The cathode with a loading of 5 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The titanium disulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with porous carbon by ball milling. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyvinylidene fluoride. With a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. The initial capacity of 1000 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The cathode delivering 1000 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising titanium disulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 650 to 800 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 3 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 650 to 800 degrees C is described. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 3 micrometers. The reversible cell with a lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The anode support contains nickel oxide and lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The solid electrolyte layer of lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 650 to 800 degrees C. The thin 3 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.5 W/cm2.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. The cell operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a power density of 1.2 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 50 cycles. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the gadolinium-doped ceria cell. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The solid electrolyte layer of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 8 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate and a film-forming additive
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium hexafluorophosphate dissolved in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate and vinylene carbonate as an additive in an amount of 1 wt%. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The additive vinylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 92% of its capacity after 500 cycles. The combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention after 500 cycles is 92% with the electrolyte. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and vinylene carbonate in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 50 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by warm isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 4 stacked cells. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 50 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 50 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The warm isostatic pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 8 stacked cells. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Li2O-containing vitreous sulfide ceramic ion conductor and heat treatment method
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28 and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated therein. The crystallized glass has an ionic conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a degree of crystallinity of 80%. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or thio-LISICON phase precipitates uniformly. Suitable compositions include Li7P3S11, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl. A superionic argyrodite-type phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. The material retains its conductivity after being shaped into a film by a dry process at room temperature. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ceramic ion conductor having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 240 degrees C. The Li2O addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a thio-LISICON crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.7 mS/cm or more, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 16 hours, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 40% to 100%.

title: Additive combination for a non-aqueous electrolyte of a lithium secondary battery
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, 1,3-propane sultone, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 2 wt% of 1,3-propane sultone is also described. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The 1.0 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising 1,3-propane sultone, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Electrochemical gas sensor with a yttria-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte for detecting oxygen
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid state electrochemical sensor element with a built-in heater that keeps the ceramic at 300 degrees C. The platinum electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode of lithium carbonate makes the sensor selective to oxygen against interfering gases. The sensing electrode comprises platinum and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode comprises lithium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 3 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 600 to 750 degrees C operating range. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The reversible cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The solid electrolyte layer of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

title: Oxide solid electrolyte with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes and method for producing the same
abstract: An oxide solid electrolyte that remains stable up to 4.8 V and a lithium battery with a high-voltage cathode are provided. The hygroscopic behavior of the sulfide is suppressed by a Sn-substituted surface. The LATP, LLZO, and LLTO material is used in an all-solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The oxidation potential is 4.8 V versus Li/Li+, the decomposition current at 5 V is 10 microamperes per square centimeter, and the conductivity is 0.5 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. An oxidation-resistant surface region comprising lithium phosphate is formed on the particles by an oxygen anneal after sintering. The coating layer on the cathode particle suppresses the interfacial reaction with the sulfide. The ion-conductive component may be Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). The material comprises Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and the decomposition current density at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less. The suppression of anodic decomposition results in a stable interface and improved high-voltage stability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 87% or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.35 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.5 V or more.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a molybdenum disulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The active material molybdenum disulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The composite shows a capacity of 1400 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The carbon coating on the molybdenum disulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of molybdenum disulfide. A lithium-sulfur battery with the molybdenum disulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 90%.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising molybdenum disulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Core-shell sulfur cathode particles for a lithium-sulfur battery
abstract: Described is a lithium sulfide cathode that is activated by a first charge above 3.5 V. The graphene framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of nickel sulfide. The nickel sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with graphene by ball milling. The nickel sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. A lithium-sulfur battery with the nickel sulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. Polysulfide dissolution from the nickel sulfide cathode into the electrolyte is suppressed by a polar metal oxide additive that adsorbs polysulfides. The composite shows a capacity of 800 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing nickel sulfide with graphene; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the nickel sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 20 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by roll pressing and the release film is peeled. A lithium battery pack comprising 4 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 500 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The edge of the 20 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 500 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a aluminum foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyacrylonitrile matrix, lithium perchlorate as the lithium salt, and an ionic liquid as a plasticizer. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The alumina nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyacrylonitrile. The polymer matrix is polyacrylonitrile and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 12:1. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. The lithium perchlorate salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyacrylonitrile matrix. Also provided is a lithium battery in which the polyacrylonitrile based electrolyte of 20 micrometers is sandwiched between a positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Oxide ceramic ion conductor having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition and production method thereof
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a ceramic ion conductor whose anodic decomposition at high potential is suppressed by a surface region of 5 nm to 50 nm. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. With germanium substitution of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, the oxidation potential rises by 0.4 V or more compared with the unsubstituted oxide. The material comprises Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and the decomposition current density at 5 V is 10 microamperes per square centimeter or less. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. A superionic argyrodite phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP) and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. The surface region acts as an oxidation barrier and improves the ionic conductivity of the electrolyte layer.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a NASICON-type LATP phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by germanium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 25 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.4 V or more.

title: Electrochemical gas sensor with a gadolinium-doped ceria solid electrolyte for detecting hydrogen
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a solid state electrochemical sensor element with a built-in heater that keeps the ceramic at 300 degrees C. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The auxiliary electrode of sodium carbonate makes the sensor selective to hydrogen against interfering gases. The platinum electrode keeps a stable output over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The sensing electrode comprises platinum and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The sensor shows a response time of 20 seconds to a step change of hydrogen concentration at 300 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising platinum, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of hydrogen.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: A reversible solid oxide cell with a 10 micrometer electrolyte operable in fuel cell mode and electrolysis mode at 600 to 750 degrees C is described. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 10 micrometers and a relative density of 95%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 600 to 750 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%. The thin 10 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.2 W/cm2. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of yttria-stabilized zirconia is a dense ceramic of 95% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite ion-conductive solid having anion disorder and method for producing the same
abstract: A sulfide ion-conductive solid for an all-solid-state battery has an argyrodite crystal structure and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Br(x)I(y). The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 3 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 9.6 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. After ball milling, the ion-conductive solid precursor is pressed and sintered. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. Partial substitution of bromine with iodine increases the anion disorder between the sulfur and halogen sites without forming a LiBr impurity phase. The interlayer reduces the interfacial resistance of the all-solid-state battery and keeps the contact area during volume change of the electrode. Dissolution of the raw materials in a nonaqueous solvent allows coating of the particles. The ion-conductive component may be argyrodite Li6PS5Cl and beta-Li3PS4. In an all-solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the cycle life. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Br(x)I(y), wherein 1.1 <= a <= 1.9, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.09 or less, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a firing temperature of 330 degrees C to 580 degrees C.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by cold isostatic pressing
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium iron phosphate positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 30 micrometers. The dry electrode process with polytetrafluoroethylene shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a stainless steel current collector is also provided. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa through an elastic sheet. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing 1,3-propane sultone as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate dissolved in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate and 1,3-propane sultone as an additive in an amount of 3 wt%. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.4 V. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V. With 3 wt% of 1,3-propane sultone, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The additive 1,3-propane sultone decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.2 M and adding 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 3 wt%.

title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a sintering method for a garnet ion-conductive solid using a mother powder cover and a lithium excess of 8 mol%. The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. The viscosity of the slurry is adjusted for doctor blade coating on a PET film. In an all-solid-state battery the ion-conductive solid forms the electrolyte layer and improves the grain boundary resistance. A sulfide synthesized by the liquid-phase method is one example of a compatible conductor. The sintered body has a relative density of 92%, an average grain size of 5 micrometers, and a total conductivity of 0.4 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The method gives reproducible densification and improved grain boundary resistance at a lower cost.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Al(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 1070 degrees C to 1220 degrees C, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a lithium excess of 5 mol% to 13 mol%, and wherein 0.25 <= v <= 0.6.

title: Multilayer ceramic gas sensor element and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Provided is a potentiometric sensor having an auxiliary electrode phase of sodium nitrite that converts the sulfur dioxide concentration into an ionic activity. The ceramic is sodium beta-alumina and conducts ions at the operating temperature of 400 degrees C. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of sulfur dioxide concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature. The sulfur dioxide sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 400 degrees C. The auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite makes the sensor selective to sulfur dioxide against interfering gases.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising gold, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of sulfur dioxide.

title: semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium perchlorate for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The 100 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 100 micrometers. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 60 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 8:1.

title: Densified garnet oxide ion-conductive solid and lithium battery including the same
abstract: A sintered garnet pellet with a relative density of 95% and a method of hot pressing the same are described. Lithium filament penetration along grain boundaries is suppressed when the current density is below the critical value. The oxidation stability against a high-voltage cathode is improved by an oxidation-resistant oxide component. Sintering is performed at 1250 degrees C for 4 hours to 12 hours in an alumina crucible under a bed of the mother powder. The amount of the sintering aid is 2 wt%, the sintering temperature is 1250 degrees C, and the resulting density is 95%. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of an all-solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. A sintering aid comprising LiF is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% and forms a liquid phase that wets the garnet grains during sintering. A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. The ion-conductive component may be lithium fluoride (LiF), Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and beta-Li3PS4. Because lithium volatilization is suppressed, the cubic phase is retained and the interfacial resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising LiF present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an average grain size of 1 micrometers to 60 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a sintering temperature of 1050 degrees C to 1400 degrees C.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained. A composite electrolyte in which an inorganic ion conductor such as LLZO or LATP is dispersed in the polymer is also provided. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 20 micrometers. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.2 mS/cm. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The polymer matrix is polyethylene oxide and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, an ionic liquid, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 16:1.

title: thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator. The plasticizer succinonitrile is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The thermally crosslinked network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.2 mS/cm. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.2 mS/cm are obtained. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers. The lithium salt is lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 50 micrometers. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. A solid electrolyte based on the polymer host is used without any ceramic component.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 20 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 25 degrees C. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The 20 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 25 degrees C. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C.

title: Li6PS5X sulfide ion-conductive solid with mixed chlorine-bromine substitution and lithium battery
abstract: A lithium phosphosulfide ion-conductive solid having a cubic Li6PS5X structure and a controlled halogen occupancy is described. The Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and LGPS composition can be prepared as a glass ceramic by heat treatment of the glassy precursor. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. The Li6PS5X phase has a cubic lattice and a conductivity of 5.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C measured by AC impedance on a pressed pellet. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. The material comprises Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), wherein the Li6PS5X crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, chlorine, and bromine. The Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and LGPS material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a lithium secondary battery. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. In an embodiment the material is Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The site occupancy of bromine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. Compared with Li6PS5Cl, the bromine-substituted Li6PS5X shows a higher conductivity and better electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.15 or less, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.2 <= y/a <= 0.5.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 45 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The stable passivation film formed by tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The capacity retention of 85% after 500 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, a separator, and the non-aqueous electrolyte is also provided. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. With 2 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Protective layer suppressing lithium filament penetration and method for forming the same
abstract: A method for forming a protective layer on lithium metal by thermal evaporation followed by solution coating of a polymer is described. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The layer may be formed by casting a slurry in a nonpolar solvent such as xylene with a rubber binder. The inorganic layer suppresses the penetration of lithium filaments, while the polymer layer absorbs the cracks caused by volume change of the negative electrode. The halide is applied to the positive electrode active material by a wet coating with an alkoxide-free solution, giving a coated cathode. The raw materials of the ion-conductive solid are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. The inorganic layer has a thickness of 200 nm and the polymer layer has a thickness of 1 micrometers, giving an average Coulombic efficiency of 99% over 100 cycles. The material comprises Li3InCl6 and lithium fluoride (LiF), and the protective layer forms an artificial interphase that is lithiophilic. Because the inorganic layer blocks electron leakage, the decomposition of the ion-conductive solid at the negative electrode is suppressed and the ionic conductivity is improved.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium fluoride (LiF) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.1 micrometers to 10 micrometers, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 20 nm to 1200 nm, and wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97% or more.

title: Slurry composition for a ceramic ion conductor layer using a nonpolar solvent and polyisobutylene
abstract: Disclosed is a wet coating method in which a slurry of a ceramic ion conductor is cast on a release film by a doctor blade and dried to form a layer. The cubic Li6PS5X structure tolerates chlorine and bromine on the 4a and 4d sites. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise beta-Li3PS4, Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). A lithium secondary battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved sheet formability. The release film is a PET film having a silicone release layer, and the dried layer is peeled from the release film and pressed onto an electrode. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the dispersant is an amine-based dispersant in an amount of 0.1 wt% to 1 wt%. An oxide of the NASICON type such as LATP may be included to widen the electrochemical window at high potential. The particles have a median diameter D50 of 1 micrometers and the layer has a conductivity of 0.8 mS/cm. The wet process is useful for forming a layer on a large area, with improved sheet formability and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming a ceramic ion conductor layer, comprising: ceramic ion conductor particles; a polyisobutylene binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising xylene in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the slurry has a binder content of 0.4 wt% to 2 wt%, and wherein the solid content of the slurry is 40 wt% to 60 wt%, and wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 40 degrees C to 80 degrees C.

assignee_raw: DRIOSTUS ADVANCED MATERIALS TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 5 micrometers. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 700 to 850 degrees C. The reversible cell with a samarium-doped ceria electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 700 to 850 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising samarium-doped ceria formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with Li2ZrO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: Described is a cathode particle coated with a nanometer-thick Li2ZrO3 shell that lowers the interfacial resistance. In an embodiment the ceramic ion conductor layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. A sheet with a fibrillated binder and low porosity can be wound on a roll. An argyrodite-type phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. The disclosure is applicable to Li3InCl6. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium zirconate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. An all-solid-state battery comprising the Li3InCl6 material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. Nickel accounts for 60 mol% of the transition metals, and the heat treatment is performed at 350 degrees C. The shell suppresses the space-charge layer and the diffusion of transition metals into the sulfide during charging above 4.3 V. The high coverage of the coating results in improved high-voltage stability at a charging voltage of 4.3 V or more.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 6 nm to 30 nm, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 50% or more.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate. The 1.5 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte membrane for a lithium battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene matrix, lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and an ionic liquid as a plasticizer. The anion is covalently bonded to the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C. The lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene matrix. The polymer solid electrolyte is used in an all-solid-state battery with a lithium metal negative electrode. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery whose separator is replaced by the polymer electrolyte membrane. The polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm or more at 60 degrees C.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell having a bilayer electrolyte of zirconia and ceria and method of producing the electrolyte
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 650 to 800 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode. The reversible cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 97%. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 650 to 800 degrees C. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 3 micrometers and a relative density of 97%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 650 to 800 degrees C. The solid electrolyte of scandia-stabilized zirconia is a dense ceramic of 97% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Halide ion-conductive solid having a close-packed bromide sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: Provided is a trigonal halide ion-conductive solid in which scandium and titanium occupy octahedral sites of a close-packed chloride lattice. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The halide is synthesized by mechanochemical reaction of LiBr, ScBr3, and TiBr4 followed by heat treatment at 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. The oxidation stability limit is 4.1 V or more and the conductivity is 1.47 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. A superionic Li6PS5X phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. The ion-conductive solid is a lithium ion conducting material for an all-solid-state battery. A battery using the halide in the positive electrode mixture shows improved electrochemical window and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A halide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Sc(1-z)Ti(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which scandium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C, and wherein the halide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.1 V or more, and wherein 0.2 <= z <= 0.45.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a transition metal sulfide active material that intercalates lithium with a high capacity. The positive electrode comprises the composite, a conductive agent, and carboxymethyl cellulose in a weight ratio of 80:10:10. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of iron sulfide. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 5 mg/cm2. The composite shows a capacity of 1200 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The iron sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with ketjen black by ball milling. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the iron sulfide cathode.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing iron sulfide with ketjen black; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the iron sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Oxide ceramic ion conductor having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition and method for producing the same
abstract: Disclosed is an oxidation-resistant oxide ceramic ion conductor having a widened electrochemical window for use with a high-voltage positive electrode such as a 5 V spinel. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the zirconium substitution and the surface region. The anodic decomposition product layer after 100 cycles is 10 nm or less and the capacity retention is 80%. In an embodiment the ceramic ion conductor layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. A crystallized glass with a tetragonal phase may be added to improve the conductivity of the mixture. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The all-solid-state lithium battery may further include an interlayer between the positive electrode layer and the ceramic ion conductor layer. The suppression of anodic decomposition results in a stable interface and improved sinterability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by zirconium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.9 V or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 75% or more, and wherein the oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.49 mS/cm or more.

title: Lithium tantalate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium tantalate formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. Specific examples are lithium niobate (LiNbO3), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The coating layer further contains boron in an amount of 0.01 wt% to 0.5 wt% relative to the core particles. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. Nickel accounts for 85 mol% of the transition metals, and the heat treatment is performed at 450 degrees C. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 90%. The resulting LiNbO3, Li2ZrO3, and Li6PS5Cl material is compatible with a dry process for electrode and separator layer fabrication. In a solid-state battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the electrochemical window. The solid electrolyte may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. The coating layer suppresses interfacial reactions between the high-nickel active material and the sulfide, improving the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 75 mol% or more, and wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 2 nm to 10 nm, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 40% or more.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The additive vinylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The combination of vinylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate at 1.5 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.3 V. The cell retains 92% of its capacity after 1000 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 45 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive vinylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding vinylene carbonate in an amount of 1 wt%.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. The naphthalenesulfonate doped polymer keeps its conductivity after 125 degrees C storage. The conductive polymer layer is formed by chemical polymerization of the monomer in the presence of an oxidant followed by impregnation with a polymer dispersion. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 8 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The solid electrolyte is the conductive polymer layer that serves as the true cathode of the capacitor. The equivalent series resistance is 8 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous aluminum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more during cycling is described. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The bipolar stacking of 16 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 16 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The module with 16 stacked cells has a voltage of 16 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The separator layer is a sheet of 20 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate and the battery is a lithium battery with 16 stacked cells.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a nickel-plated copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor powder for lithium battery
abstract: Described is a liquid-phase route to a sulfide ceramic ion conductor that does not require long mechanical milling. A lithium secondary battery comprising the LLZO material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The raw materials of the ceramic ion conductor are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. The reaction is performed in a stirred reactor having a volume of 10 L or more, and the precipitate is washed with fresh solvent. The reaction at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C for 24 hours gives a precipitate yield of 95% or more. A halogen-rich Li6PS5X with anion disorder is one option for the counterpart layer. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. The liquid-phase route yields fine particles with a narrow size distribution and improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl propionate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, wherein the reaction temperature is 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 7.5 wt% to 30 wt%.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide ceramic ion conductor and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is an oxidation-resistant oxide ceramic ion conductor having a widened electrochemical window for use with a high-voltage positive electrode such as LiNi0.5Mn1.5O4. In a lithium secondary battery the ceramic ion conductor forms the electrolyte layer and improves the sinterability. The electrochemical window measured by cyclic voltammetry on a blocking electrode extends to 5.5 V versus Li/Li+. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). The substitution amount is 8 mol%, which gives an oxidation limit of 4.2 V or more and a conductivity of 0.7 mS/cm or more. A sulfide glass ceramic can be used as the matrix of the ceramic ion conductor layer of the lithium secondary battery. A Li6PS5X phase with partial bromine substitution on the halogen site may be added as a conductive additive. A garnet pellet with a grain size of a few micrometers and low grain boundary resistance is compatible with the material.
