The cell retains 90% of its capacity after 500 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The 1.2 M lithium hexafluorophosphate solution in ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 2 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and lithium bis(oxalato)borate in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. A 5 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 0.8 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 100 cycles. The reversible cell with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The cell may also be combined with a lithium battery in a hybrid power system operating at 600 to 750 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by cold isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 8 cells and a case is also provided. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The cold isostatic pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The lithium battery is operated at 80 degrees C under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 100 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: Disclosed is a solid oxide fuel cell in which a thin yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte is co-sintered with an anode support to lower the ohmic resistance of the cell. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the yttria-stabilized zirconia cell. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 600 to 750 degrees C. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 600 to 750 degrees C.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The capacity retention of 85% after 1000 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without vinylene carbonate. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 3 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M and vinylene carbonate as an additive.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 100 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by cold isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The edge of the 100 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa through an elastic sheet. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The dry electrode process with nitrile butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 16 stacked cells.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 2 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar aluminum current collectors. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 2 stacked cells. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 200 kPa. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 80 degrees C after lamination. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 80 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 200 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 200 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a aluminum current collector and a primer layer
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a cell structure in which an edge sealing portion prevents short circuit between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 600 kPa. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a aluminum current collector is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 100 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The membrane of 100 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The membrane is assembled with a lithium cobalt oxide positive electrode and a lithium metal negative electrode into a lithium battery. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 60 degrees C.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 10 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The thin 10 micrometer electrolyte lowers the ohmic resistance and improves the power density of the cell to 1.5 W/cm2. A power density of 1.5 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. A 10 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the samarium-doped ceria cell.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising samarium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing vinylene carbonate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lithium secondary battery whose capacity retention at 60 degrees C is improved by an additive combination. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.4 V. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.2 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. With 3 wt% of vinylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 88% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The additive vinylene carbonate is added in an amount of 3 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The additive vinylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 3 wt% of vinylene carbonate is also described.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising vinylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with silica nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The polymer matrix is poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 16:1. The thermally crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate electrolyte suppresses leakage and improves the safety of the lithium battery. The polymer film serves as the solid electrolyte between the lithium metal and the positive electrode. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Oxide solid electrolyte having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition
abstract: Described is an oxide solid electrolyte whose decomposition current at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. The disclosure is applicable to Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The LATP material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state battery. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. The solid electrolyte is chemically compatible with a lithium metal anode and suppresses the growth of lithium filaments. Reduction of titanium at 1.5 V versus Li/Li+ is suppressed by the hafnium substitution and the surface region. The decomposition current density at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less and the capacity retention after 200 cycles is 87% or more. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The oxide solid electrolyte enables the use of a 5 V class cathode and improves the sinterability.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a phosphate-based NASICON phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a substitution amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.2 V or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 87% or more.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 5 micrometers and a relative density of 98%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 650 to 800 degrees C. Because the barrier layer prevents interfacial reaction with the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode, the degradation rate is reduced to 1% per 1000 hours. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The stack of 200 cells can be paired with a lithium battery for load leveling. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 98% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 5 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 650 to 800 degrees C.

title: Amperometric carbon dioxide sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: This disclosure concerns a multilayer ceramic sensor element produced by co-firing green sheets of zirconia and alumina. The auxiliary electrode comprises lithium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The sensing electrode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature. The auxiliary electrode of lithium carbonate makes the sensor selective to carbon dioxide against interfering gases. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The multilayer structure with the gadolinium-doped ceria ceramic allows mass production by co-firing.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer ceramic sensor element comprising a ceramic layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, an alumina layer with an embedded platinum heater, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and a porous protective layer, wherein the layers are co-fired.

title: titanium disulfide positive electrode material with a carbon coating and lithium battery including the same
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a titanium disulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyacrylic acid. The composite shows a capacity of 1000 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The carbon coating on the titanium disulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 90%. The sulfur loading of 4 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The titanium disulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with graphene by ball milling.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing titanium disulfide with graphene; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the titanium disulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide ion-conductive solid using ethyl acetate
abstract: A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid by stirring the raw materials in ethyl acetate at 60 degrees C and filtering the precipitate is described. The powder is formed into a sheet by kneading with a fibrillated PTFE binder and roll-pressing without a solvent to a thickness of 30 micrometers to 80 micrometers. The reaction is performed in a stirred reactor having a volume of 10 L or more, and the precipitate is washed with fresh solvent. A lithium secondary battery comprising the Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and LATP material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The disclosure is applicable to Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, Li7P3S11, and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The carbon content of the heat-treated powder is 0.3 wt% and the conductivity is 3 mS/cm. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. The fibrillization of the binder under shear gives a free-standing film. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline ion-conductive solid powder. The electrode mixture of the lithium secondary battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. Dissolution and precipitation give a homogeneous composition and improved moisture stability and sinterability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ion-conductive solid, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 45 degrees C to 80 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 2.1 mS/cm or more, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 2.5 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the drying temperature under vacuum is 110 degrees C to 190 degrees C.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, ketjen black, and polyvinylidene fluoride is described. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the iron sulfide cathode. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g and retains 80% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. The cathode with a loading of 3 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate. The iron sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The active material iron sulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. A lithium-sulfur pouch cell comprising the composite cathode and retaining 80% of its capacity after 500 cycles is also described.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode for a lithium secondary battery, comprising a current collector and a positive electrode mixture layer disposed thereon, the positive electrode mixture layer comprising iron sulfide, ketjen black, and polyvinylidene fluoride, wherein a loading of the iron sulfide is 3 mg/cm2 or more.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing LiI. The lithium metal negative electrode is preferably covered by a lithiophilic bilayer protective layer. Crystallization is performed at 220 degrees C to 300 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 20 hours, which precipitates a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ion-conductive solid particles during pressing. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The content of LiI is 8 mol%, the crystallization temperature is 260 degrees C, and the conductivity is 2.8 mS/cm or more. The disclosure is applicable to Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). A lithium secondary battery containing the crystallized glass shows improved cycle life and rate performance.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 72:28; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the content of LiI is 4 mol% to 16 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 60% to 95%.

title: LiI-containing vitreous sulfide solid electrolyte and heat treatment method
abstract: A sulfide solid electrolyte in which a thio-LISICON type crystal is embedded in a glass is described, together with an all-solid-state battery using it. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li3PS4 material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. The glass transition temperature is 200 degrees C, the crystallization onset is 280 degrees C, and the conductivity reaches 2.5 mS/cm. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A zirconium-substituted Li2ZrCl6-type halide is one option for the counterpart layer. Crystallization is performed at 240 degrees C to 320 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 4 hours, which precipitates a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. Lithium ions migrate through the material at 25 degrees C with a transference number close to unity. The solid electrolyte shows improved electrochemical window and moisture stability compared with a fully crystalline powder of the same composition.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 4 hours, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the content of LiI is 1 mol% to 4 mol%.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid having a surface region suppressing anodic decomposition and production method thereof
abstract: An oxide ion-conductive solid stable against oxidation above 4.5 V versus Li/Li+ comprises a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The coating layer on the cathode particle suppresses the interfacial reaction with the sulfide. The positive electrode active material is a 5 V spinel, which is charged to 4.6 V or more against the oxide ion-conductive solid. Examples of the ion conductor include argyrodite Li6PS5Cl and beta-Li3PS4. The oxide has an ionic conductivity of 0.7 mS/cm and an electrochemical window of 1.8 V to 4.5 V. A styrene-butadiene rubber binder dissolved in a nonpolar solvent may be used for the wet film. The oxide ion-conductive solid enables the use of a 5 V class cathode and improves the interfacial resistance and ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a Li2ZrO3-modified LLZO phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by tin; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 75% or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 40 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite with a thickness of 3 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte of 95% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. A diffusion barrier layer of gadolinium-doped ceria is disposed between the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte and the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode to prevent the formation of strontium zirconate. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 3 micrometers. The cell can be operated at 600 to 750 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects. A power density of 1.0 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 600 to 750 degrees C operating range. A 3 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Gallium-doped garnet ceramic ion conductor sintered body with high relative density
abstract: Provided is a cubic garnet oxide of the LLZO type in which the dopant gallium stabilizes the cubic phase and the sintering aid promotes densification. The LLZO material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. Suitable compositions include Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and the densification is achieved by hot pressing at 10 MPa to 50 MPa. The halogen occupancy and anion disorder of a Li6PS5X component can be adjusted to tune the conductivity. The total ionic conductivity is 0.28 mS/cm or more and the grain boundary resistance is 20% or less of the total resistance. Slurry casting with a controlled solid content forms the layer on a release film. The densification improves the mechanical strength and the sinterability of the garnet layer.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-3v)Ga(v)La3Zr2O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an average grain size of 2 micrometers to 15 micrometers, and wherein 0.15 <= v <= 0.5, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.28 mS/cm or more.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate and a film-forming additive
abstract: Described is a combination of fluoroethylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The 1.5 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. The cell retains 85% of its capacity after 300 cycles at 25 degrees C and shows a thickness increase of 5% or less after storage at 60 degrees C for 4 weeks. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 2 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 600 MPa and 25 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 4 cells and a case is also provided. The unit cells are stacked 4 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 25 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The lithium cobalt oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 100 kPa
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by roll pressing at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. A lithium battery pack comprising 8 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 30 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by polytetrafluoroethylene. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The structure with the stainless steel current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The electrode laminate pressed at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 100 kPa or more.

title: Oxide ion-conductive solid with widened electrochemical window for high-voltage cathodes and lithium battery
abstract: Described is an oxide ion-conductive solid whose decomposition current at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. The oxide has an ionic conductivity of 0.7 mS/cm and an electrochemical window of 1.8 V to 5.2 V. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. An all-solid-state lithium battery using the ion-conductive solid shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved sinterability. Part of the titanium in the NASICON-type LATP phase is substituted by hafnium in an amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, which raises the anodic stability. An oxidation-resistant surface region comprising lithium phosphate is formed on the particles by an oxygen anneal after sintering. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO) and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The widened electrochemical window improves the sinterability and grain boundary resistance of a high-voltage lithium battery.
first_claim: 1. An oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a NASICON-type LATP phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.49 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has a substitution amount of 1 mol% to 4 mol%, and wherein the oxide ion-conductive solid has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.9 V or more.

title: Lithium tungstate-coated positive electrode active material for sulfide-based solid-state battery and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a coating layer of lithium tungstate formed by wet coating with an alkoxide solution on nickel-rich NCM particles. The LiNbO3 and Li6PS5Cl material is combined with a negative electrode of graphite, silicon, or lithium metal in a solid-state battery. Specific examples are lithium niobate (LiNbO3) and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The coated particles have a specific surface area of 0.3 m2/g to 1.5 m2/g and the shell thickness is 10 nm. An artificial interphase on the metallic lithium improves the wettability and suppresses filament growth. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 90%. A solid-state battery using the coated active material shows improved interfacial resistance and cycle life and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tungstate (Li2WO4), wherein the coverage of the coating layer determined by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy is 85% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 20% or more.

title: Solid polymer electrolyte film with improved mechanical strength and ionic conductivity
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 16:1. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 40 degrees C. The lithium salt is lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 50 micrometers. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid obtained by controlled crystallization of a Li2S-P2S5 glass for lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a crystallized sulfide glass in which a beta-Li3PS4 phase is precipitated from a vitreous Li2S-P2S5 matrix containing GeS2. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. A germanium-containing glass precursor gives a Li10GeP2S12-type crystal upon annealing at 260 degrees C. The disclosure is applicable to Li7P3S11. A superionic argyrodite-type phosphosulfide may be mixed in as a second ion-conductive component. The precipitated beta-Li3PS4 phase has an average crystallite size of 50 nm, and the material shows a conductivity of 5.5 mS/cm. A moisture-resistant sulfide with low hydrolysis is one example of the conductor. The material transports lithium between the positive electrode and the negative electrode of the all-solid-state battery. Because the crystal phase is precipitated inside the glass, the grain boundary resistance is small and the moisture stability is improved.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 75:25; and a beta-Li3PS4 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 20 hours, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 3.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the content of GeS2 is 4 mol% to 16 mol%.

title: Positive electrode active material with lithium tantalate coating layer suppressing interfacial reaction and lithium battery
abstract: Disclosed is a coated positive electrode active material whose LiTaO3 shell suppresses the interfacial reaction with a sulfide ion-conductive solid. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. A lithium secondary battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The coating solution contains a lithium alkoxide and a precursor of the lithium tantalate, and is applied to the core particles in a tumbling fluidized bed. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 80%. The ion-conductive solid may comprise lithium niobate (LiNbO3), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl. The raw materials of the ion-conductive solid are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. The core particles have a median diameter D50 of 3 micrometers and nickel content of 70 mol% or more. The lithium tantalate shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the interfacial resistance and cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium tantalate (LiTaO3), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 1.5 nm to 75 nm, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a nickel content among transition metals of 50 mol% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 230 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Hafnium-substituted phosphate-based NASICON solid electrolyte stable above 5.2 V and method for preparing the same
abstract: A NASICON-type or perovskite-type oxide solid electrolyte with an oxidation limit of 4.9 V or more is described. The solid electrolyte may comprise Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO) and lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3). A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. With hafnium substitution of 4 mol% to 16 mol%, the oxidation potential rises by 0.4 V or more compared with the unsubstituted oxide. The substituted phase has a NASICON or perovskite framework in which the phosphate or titanate units are oxidation-resistant. An all-solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. A lithium battery using the oxide shows improved high-voltage stability at a charging voltage of 4.6 V.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a phosphate-based NASICON phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.9 V or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.21 mS/cm or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a substitution amount of 4 mol% to 16 mol%.

title: Halogen-rich argyrodite ceramic ion conductor having anion disorder for lithium battery
abstract: An argyrodite ceramic ion conductor represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Br(x)I(y) and a method for producing the same are described. The iodine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the bromine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. The site occupancy of iodine on the 4a site, refined by Rietveld analysis, is 60% or more. Specific examples are beta-Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li6PS5Cl material. The Li3PS4, Li7P3S11, and Li6PS5Cl material is also useful as a protective layer between a lithium metal anode and a sulfide layer. Firing is performed at 500 degrees C for 2 hours to 10 hours in an argon atmosphere, which yields a conductivity of 3.5 mS/cm. The anion disorder lowers the activation barrier for lithium hopping and thereby improves the electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Br(x)I(y), wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a firing temperature of 380 degrees C to 630 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein 0.9 <= a <= 1.7.

title: Slurry composition for an ion-conductive solid layer using a nonpolar solvent and polyisobutylene
abstract: Provided is a slurry in which ion-conductive solid particles are dispersed in butyl butyrate with a rubber binder and a dispersant. The disclosure further provides a lithium secondary battery in which at least one of the positive electrode layer and the separator layer comprises the LLZO, LATP, and Li6PS5Cl material. An argyrodite sulfide of the Li5.5PS4.5Cl1.5 type is one example of a compatible ion conductor. The solid content is 50 wt% to 70 wt%, the viscosity is 500 mPa s to 2000 mPa s, and the layer thickness is 12 micrometers to 60 micrometers. A perovskite-type LLTO or a phosphate-based oxide may be added as a catholyte stable above 4.5 V. The slurry is applied onto a release film at a coating speed of 1 m/min to 10 m/min and dried at 60 degrees C to 100 degrees C in an oven. The ion-conductive solid is preferably Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP), and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl. The controlled viscosity gives a uniform thickness and improved ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A slurry for forming an ion-conductive solid layer, comprising: ion-conductive solid particles; a polyisobutylene binder; a nonpolar solvent comprising butyl butyrate in which the binder is dissolved; and a dispersant, wherein the slurry has a binder content of 2 wt% to 10 wt%, and wherein the ionic conductivity of the layer at 25 degrees C is 1.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the slurry has a drying temperature of 60 degrees C to 100 degrees C.

title: In situ polymerized electrolyte for a lithium ion battery and method of manufacturing the battery
abstract: This disclosure concerns a solid polymer electrolyte film with an ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm are obtained. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. A solid electrolyte based on the polymer host is used without any ceramic component.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium hexafluorophosphate, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising polycarbonate and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polycarbonate matrix, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide as the lithium salt, and succinonitrile as a plasticizer. The lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide salt gives a wide electrochemical window of 4.5 V in the polycarbonate matrix. A lithium transference number of 0.5 or more and a conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm are obtained. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 25 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the thermally crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The anion is covalently bonded to the polycarbonate chain, which gives a lithium transference number of 0.8 or more.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a lithium battery, comprising: assembling a positive electrode, a separator, and a negative electrode; injecting a composition comprising a monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, and an initiator; and polymerizing the composition in situ to form a gel polymer electrolyte.

title: Lithium metal negative electrode having an artificial interphase formed by thermal evaporation and method for preparing the same
abstract: A method for forming a protective layer on lithium metal by thermal evaporation followed by solution coating of a polymer is described. An all-solid-state lithium battery using the ceramic ion conductor shows stable operation at 25 degrees C and 60 degrees C with improved cycle life. In an embodiment the material is Li3YCl6, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and beta-Li3PS4. The inorganic layer is formed by thermal evaporation to a thickness of 200 nm to 1000 nm and has an ionic conductivity of 1 x 10^-6 S/cm or more at 25 degrees C. The number of cycles without short circuit at 0.5 mA/cm2 is 150 cycles or more and the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.25 micrometers to 1.5 micrometers. A cubic garnet of the Li7La3Zr2O12 type sintered to high relative density may be used as a counterpart layer. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. The sintering of a tantalum-doped garnet with a mother powder cover suppresses lithium volatilization. The material comprises Li3YCl6, Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO), and beta-Li3PS4, and the protective layer forms an artificial interphase that is lithiophilic. The protective layer suppresses the growth of lithium dendrites and improves the cycle life and interfacial resistance of the lithium metal battery.
first_claim: 1. A protective layer for a lithium metal negative electrode, comprising: an inorganic layer comprising lithium phosphorus oxynitride (LiPON) in contact with the lithium metal; and a fluorine-containing polymer layer disposed on the inorganic layer, wherein the protective layer has an average Coulombic efficiency over 100 cycles of 97.2% or more, and wherein the thickness of the polymer layer is 0.05 micrometers to 5 micrometers, and wherein the thickness of the protective layer is 50 nm to 3000 nm.

title: Lithium ion battery electrolyte with improved high temperature storage characteristics
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. The 1.2 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 88% of its capacity after 500 cycles. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The stable passivation film formed by tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 60 degrees C. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at low temperature and method of preparing the same
abstract: Described is a combination of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite and a sulfur-containing additive for a non-aqueous electrolyte. The capacity retention of 92% after 1000 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate at 1.0 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.3 V. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.3 V. The cell charged to 4.3 V retains 92% of its capacity after 1000 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 3 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Surface mount solid electrolytic capacitor and method of reducing leakage current
abstract: This disclosure concerns a surface mount capacitor with a conductive polymer cathode and a lead frame. The capacitor withstands 105 degrees C for 1000 hours with a capacitance change of 10% or less. The capacitor shows improved heat resistance at 105 degrees C and can be mounted by reflow soldering. The solid electrolyte of the capacitor is formed from a conductive polymer dispersion. The capacitor rated at 35 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The tantalum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with naphthalenesulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion.
first_claim: 1. A solid electrolytic capacitor comprising: an anode body comprising a porous sintered body of tantalum; a dielectric layer formed on a surface of the anode body; a conductive polymer layer disposed on the dielectric layer and comprising poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) doped with naphthalenesulfonate; and a cathode layer comprising carbon and silver disposed on the conductive polymer layer, wherein an equivalent series resistance of the capacitor at 100 kHz is 8 milliohms or less.

title: Halide ceramic ion conductor having a close-packed chloride sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: Described is a lithium yttrium chloride ceramic ion conductor prepared by a water-mediated route and dehydrated under vacuum. The zirconium substitution in an amount z of 0.2 to 0.45 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. An interlayer formed by sputtering is used to suppress the side reaction at the interface. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li7P3S11. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. A solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. A mixed-halide composition containing both chloride and bromide is used so that the lattice is expanded. The oxidation stability limit is 4 V or more and the conductivity is 0.84 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C. The halide ceramic ion conductor is stable in contact with a layered oxide cathode without a coating, improving the grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A halide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which yttrium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4 V or more, and wherein 0.2 <= z <= 0.45, and wherein the halide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.84 mS/cm or more.

title: Li6PS5X sulfide solid electrolyte with mixed chlorine-bromine substitution and electrode mixture containing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a Li6PS5X solid electrolyte in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by bromine. The halogen-rich composition keeps the Li6PS5X phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. The material comprises Li7P3S11, Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), wherein the Li6PS5X crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, chlorine, and bromine. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li7P3S11, Li6PS5Cl, and LGPS material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. The active material having a halide coating is mixed with the material in a weight ratio of 70:30 to 85:15. Uniform nucleation of lithium during plating raises the critical current density of the cell. A solid-state battery comprising the Li7P3S11, Li6PS5Cl, and LGPS material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. Firing is performed at 550 degrees C for 2 hours to 10 hours in an argon atmosphere, which yields a conductivity of 7.3 mS/cm. The mixed halogen substitution improves the moisture stability of the solid-state battery.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 1.4 <= a <= 1.8, and wherein 0.25 <= y/a <= 0.55, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less.

title: Solid oxide fuel cell with a lanthanum strontium cobalt ferrite cathode and a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite with a thickness of 15 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The electrolyte layer has a thickness of 15 micrometers and a relative density of 97%, and the open circuit voltage is 1.1 V at 700 to 850 degrees C. The lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 97%. The electrolyte layer is a bilayer of zirconia and ceria with a total thickness of 15 micrometers. The cell can be operated at 700 to 850 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising a plurality of planar unit cells each having an anode, an electrolyte layer comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite and a cathode, metal interconnects disposed between adjacent unit cells, and a glass sealant, wherein the stack operates at 700 to 850 degrees C.

title: Gel polymer electrolyte comprising poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is a semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte in which a crosslinked network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate holds a lithium salt and provides dimensional stability. The lithium salt is lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide and the membrane has a thickness of 50 micrometers. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C. alumina nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 60 degrees C. The polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide is used in a lithium secondary battery operated at 60 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium bis(trifluoromethanesulfonyl)imide, tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 20:1.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by roll pressing and the release film is peeled. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 200 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The unit cells are stacked 2 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The structure with the stainless steel current collector is applied to an all-solid-state battery for a vehicle. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 200 MPa. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 200 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A battery cell comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, a separator layer disposed therebetween, and an edge sealing portion of an insulating resin surrounding the positive electrode layer, wherein the separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.5 V is provided. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 500 cycles. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 92% of its capacity after 500 cycles. The non-aqueous electrolyte is injected into a lithium battery and the battery is stored at 45 degrees C. The fluorinated solvent improves the oxidation stability of the electrolyte at 4.5 V. The lithium salt is lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M and fluoroethylene carbonate as an additive.

title: Solid electrolytic capacitor with a conductive polymer solid electrolyte layer and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a tantalum solid electrolytic capacitor with a low equivalent series resistance and a high rated voltage. The capacitor rated at 16 V can be used in a power supply circuit of an electronic device with a low ripple voltage. The tantalum capacitor element is encapsulated in an epoxy resin with the anode lead and cathode terminal exposed. The equivalent series resistance is 5 milliohms or less and the leakage current is 0.01 CV or less. A re-formation step after polymer formation repairs defects in the dielectric film and reduces the leakage current. The dispersion of polypyrrole gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 47 microfarad rating.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid electrolytic capacitor, comprising: anodizing a porous tantalum anode body to form a dielectric oxide film; impregnating the anode body with a dispersion of polypyrrole particles having a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm; drying the dispersion to form a conductive polymer layer; and forming a carbon layer and a silver layer on the conductive polymer layer.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: Provided is an electrode with a stainless steel current collector and a conductive primer layer that lowers the contact resistance with the electrode mixture layer. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 600 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a stainless steel current collector is also provided. The warm isostatic pressing step at 600 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 600 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria with a thickness of 8 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. The anode support contains nickel oxide and gadolinium-doped ceria in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The solid electrolyte layer of gadolinium-doped ceria conducts oxide ions and separates the fuel from the air. The cell operates at 700 to 850 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the lanthanum strontium manganite cathode at 700 to 850 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 200 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 700 to 850 degrees C. The gadolinium-doped ceria electrolyte of 96% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 8 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Multilayer ceramic gas sensor element and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a multilayer ceramic sensor element produced by co-firing green sheets of zirconia and alumina. The protective layer improves the durability of the sodium beta-alumina sensor in an exhaust gas. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The auxiliary electrode comprises lithium carbonate and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 700 degrees C. The sensor operating at 700 degrees C has a detection limit of 1 ppm for nitrogen oxide.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting nitrogen oxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising sodium beta-alumina; a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 700 degrees C.

title: Exhaust gas sensor with a pumping cell and a sensing cell on a zirconia substrate
abstract: An amperometric sensor in which nitrogen oxide is pumped through a diffusion barrier by an oxide ion conducting ceramic is provided. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 400 degrees C. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The sensor detects nitrogen oxide with high selectivity and a response time of 10 seconds. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature. The protective layer improves the durability of the NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate sensor in an exhaust gas. The sensor output changes by 50 mV per decade of nitrogen oxide concentration in the range of 10 ppm to 1000 ppm.
first_claim: 1. An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting nitrogen oxide, comprising: a ceramic body comprising NASICON-type sodium zirconium phosphate; a sensing electrode comprising platinum disposed on a first surface of the ceramic body; a reference electrode disposed on a second surface of the ceramic body; and a heater that heats the ceramic body to 400 degrees C.

title: Bromine-substituted argyrodite solid electrolyte and lithium battery and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: Disclosed is an argyrodite solid electrolyte in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by bromine. The material comprises beta-Li3PS4, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and Li7P3S11, wherein the argyrodite crystal phase is superionic and the anion sublattice contains sulfur, chlorine, and bromine. The powder has a median particle diameter D50 of 3 micrometers and an ionic conductivity of 8.5 mS/cm after cold pressing at 370 MPa. The bromine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. A layer cast from a heptane slurry and dried in an oven is one option for the separator layer. The solid electrolyte may comprise beta-Li3PS4, Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and Li7P3S11. A glass prepared by quenching and partially crystallized to a thio-LISICON phase can be used in the electrode mixture. In a lithium secondary battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the moisture stability. Because the lithium halide impurity is suppressed, the moisture stability of the material is retained after storage.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein 0.25 <= x <= 1.05.

title: Transition metal sulfide cathode material for a lithium ion battery and method of synthesizing the same
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a molybdenum disulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. Also provided is a lithium secondary battery whose positive electrode contains the composite and polyacrylic acid. A separator coated with graphene traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g and retains 90% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. The carbon coating on the molybdenum disulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene. The graphene framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of molybdenum disulfide.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing molybdenum disulfide with graphene; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the molybdenum disulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and styrene-butadiene rubber are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The primer layer on the copper foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The lithium battery is operated at 80 degrees C under a stack pressure of 100 kPa. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 50 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Lithium sulfide based cathode active material with suppressed polysulfide dissolution
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. The nickel sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with carbon nanotubes by ball milling. The method is scalable and compatible with a conventional slurry coating process using polyacrylic acid. With a sulfur loading of 3 mg/cm2, the areal capacity is 3 mAh/cm2 or more. A separator coated with carbon nanotubes traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. A lithium-sulfur battery with the nickel sulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 80%.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing nickel sulfide with carbon nanotubes; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the nickel sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: Provided is a composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, and an initiator. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 20:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. A composite electrolyte in which an inorganic ion conductor such as LLZO or LATP is dispersed in the polymer is also provided. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 20 micrometers. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the semi-interpenetrating polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 40 degrees C.
