The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising gadolinium-doped ceria, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 5 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Method of laminating an electrolyte layer and electrode layers for a solid-state cell
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 300 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The primer layer on the stainless steel foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The lithium battery is operated at 60 degrees C under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The cold isostatic pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The edge of the 50 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a stainless steel foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: This disclosure concerns a lamination method in which a transfer sheet of the 30 micrometer separator layer is pressed onto the electrode layer by cold isostatic pressing and the release film is peeled. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The solid electrolyte layer is sandwiched between the lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide positive electrode layer and the negative electrode layer. The cold isostatic pressing step at 200 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The separator layer is a sheet of 30 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 200 kPa. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide and the battery is a lithium battery with 2 stacked cells.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 200 MPa and 80 degrees C.

title: Battery module with a restraining member, an elastic sheet, and a cooling plate for 2 stacked cells
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by roll pressing at 100 MPa and 25 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The laminate is pressed by roll pressing at 100 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The roll pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The module with 2 stacked cells has a voltage of 2 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The all-solid-state battery is manufactured by stacking the layers and pressing them by roll pressing. The current collector is a stainless steel foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium cobalt oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 30 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by roll pressing at 100 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for an all-solid-state battery by warm isostatic pressing
abstract: Disclosed is a method of manufacturing an electrode laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 500 MPa and 60 degrees C so that the electrode layers and the ion-conducting separator layer are bonded. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The lithium battery is operated at 60 degrees C under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The edge sealing portion prevents short circuit and improves the reliability of the cell with a 30 micrometer separator layer. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 60 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 500 kPa or more.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a nickel-plated copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar nickel-plated copper current collectors. The unit cells are stacked 8 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. A lithium battery pack comprising 8 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The roll pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The solid-state battery is restrained in a module at a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The dry electrode process with styrene-butadiene rubber shortens the manufacturing time and avoids solvent recovery. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium cobalt oxide, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 30 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate and a film-forming additive
abstract: Disclosed is an electrolyte additive, fluoroethylene carbonate, that forms a stable passivation film on the negative electrode and suppresses gas generation. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate is added in an amount of 1 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The lithium salt is lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M in a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate in a volume ratio of 3:7. The combination of fluoroethylene carbonate and a sulfur-containing additive improves both the cycle life and the low temperature performance. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 1 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate is also described. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety.
first_claim: 1. An electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate, a mixed solvent of propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate, a first additive comprising fluoroethylene carbonate, and a second additive comprising a sulfur-containing compound, wherein a weight ratio of the first additive to the second additive is 1:0.2 to 1:2.

title: Wet-chemical method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte with low residual solvent for lithium battery
abstract: Provided is a method in which a solvate complex of Li3PS4 is precipitated from ethyl acetate, dried under vacuum, and heat-treated. The reaction is performed in a stirred reactor having a volume of 10 L or more, and the precipitate is washed with fresh solvent. The solid electrolyte powder may be refined by ball milling to a median diameter D50 of 5 micrometers. A silver-containing protective layer on the lithium metal improves the deposition uniformity. The suspension has a solid concentration of 7.5 wt% to 30 wt% and is reacted at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring for 6 hours to 72 hours. The electrode mixture of the solid-state lithium battery may include an active material provided with a halide coating instead of an oxide coating. The powder is handled in a dry room with a dew point of -40 degrees C or lower. The solid electrolyte obtained by the method has an ionic conductivity of 2.2 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a residual solvent content of 0.3 wt%. The glass ceramic shows a lower grain boundary resistance than a fully crystalline solid electrolyte powder. The wet-chemical process is suitable for coating an active material and improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide solid electrolyte, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in ethyl acetate to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 65 degrees C to 100 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 160 degrees C to 240 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 7.5 wt% to 30 wt%, and wherein the heat treatment temperature is 500 degrees C to 600 degrees C, and wherein the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte solution containing lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive and lithium secondary battery including the same
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.3 V is provided. The passivation film on the positive electrode suppresses the dissolution of transition metals at 4.3 V. The 1.5 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate reduces gas generation during storage at 45 degrees C and improves safety. The negative electrode comprises graphite and silicon oxide, and the positive electrode comprises a nickel-rich layered oxide charged to 4.3 V. The additive lithium bis(oxalato)borate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The solid electrolyte interphase on the silicon particles accommodates the volume change. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 3 wt% of lithium bis(oxalato)borate is also described.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode comprising graphite and silicon, a separator, and a non-aqueous electrolyte, wherein the non-aqueous electrolyte comprises lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.5 M and lithium bis(oxalato)borate as an additive.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having Li6PS5X structure with controlled halogen occupancy and all-solid lithium cell
abstract: Disclosed is a Li6PS5X solid electrolyte in which part of the chlorine on the halogen site is replaced by bromine. The Li6PS5X crystal phase accounts for 90% or more of the crystalline phases, the balance being a trace of LiCl and Li3PS4. Firing is performed at 500 degrees C for 2 hours to 10 hours in an argon atmosphere, which yields a conductivity of 8.5 mS/cm. In an embodiment the solid electrolyte layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a solid electrolyte layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Examples of the ion conductor include Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and beta-Li3PS4. The bromine occupies the 4a site of the cubic F-43m lattice while the chlorine occupies the 4d site, which widens the lithium diffusion pathway. The solvent is removed under vacuum so that the residual solvent is below 0.5 wt%. A dew point controlled atmosphere is used during processing to avoid hydrolysis. The material is useful as a solid electrolyte layer or as an ion conductor in an electrode mixture, with improved cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having a Li6PS5X crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(7-a)PS(6-a)Cl(x)Br(y), wherein 0.35 <= y/a <= 0.65, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 450 degrees C to 550 degrees C, and wherein 1.2 <= a <= 1.6.

title: Tubular solid oxide fuel cell with a nickel cermet anode and a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a planar solid oxide fuel cell stack comprising unit cells with a yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte, metal interconnects, and a glass sealant. The stack shows stable operation over 200 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 600 to 750 degrees C. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 95%. The anode support contains nickel oxide and yttria-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 95% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The solid electrolyte of yttria-stabilized zirconia is a dense ceramic of 95% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 0.8 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 95% or more.

title: Stacked solid-state battery with bipolar current collectors and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 8 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar copper current collectors. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. A lithium battery pack comprising 8 modules of the stacked cells is also described. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 100 micrometers to 150 micrometers. The cold isostatic pressing step at 100 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. An all-solid-state battery comprising the laminate of 8 cells and a case is also provided. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 100 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium iron phosphate on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by cold isostatic pressing at 100 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane comprises a polycarbonate matrix, lithium perchlorate as the lithium salt, and succinonitrile as a plasticizer. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 100 micrometers. The UV-crosslinked network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 1.0 mS/cm at 60 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. A pouch type lithium battery comprising the UV-crosslinked polymer electrolyte and a graphite negative electrode is also described. The plasticizer succinonitrile enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 60 degrees C. The polymer matrix is polycarbonate and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 20:1.
first_claim: 1. A composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer, lithium perchlorate, succinonitrile, and a photoinitiator, wherein a molar ratio of ethylene oxide units to lithium is 20:1.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Dry electrode manufacturing method using nitrile butadiene rubber and electrode produced thereby
abstract: A stacked battery comprises 16 unit cells each having a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer, the unit cells being stacked in series through bipolar aluminum current collectors. The primer layer on the aluminum foil lowers the contact resistance and improves the rate capability. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 500 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The warm isostatic pressing step at 500 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The unit cells are stacked 16 in series, and the bipolar current collector has the positive electrode on one side and the negative electrode on the other. The electrode laminate pressed at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C has an interfacial resistance of 10 ohm cm2 or less.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 20 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by warm isostatic pressing at 500 MPa and 120 degrees C.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing silica nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The plasticizer an ionic liquid enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 25 degrees C. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. The polymer matrix is polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 8:1. The lithium salt is lithium hexafluorophosphate and the membrane has a thickness of 30 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium hexafluorophosphate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 30 micrometers or less.

title: Amperometric ammonia sensor using an oxide ion conducting ceramic and gas sensor system
abstract: Provided is a potentiometric sensor having an auxiliary electrode phase of sodium nitrite that converts the ammonia concentration into an ionic activity. A porous protective layer of alumina covers the gold sensing electrode to prevent poisoning by particulates. The ammonia sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 400 degrees C. The solid electrolyte layer is a dense ceramic sintered at 1400 degrees C. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 400 degrees C. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 400 degrees C. The sensor shows a response time of 20 seconds to a step change of ammonia concentration at 400 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising gold, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of ammonia.

title: Halide solid electrolyte having a close-packed bromide sublattice and cation disorder
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a lithium metal halide of the Li3MX6 type with a close-packed bromide anion sublattice and to a battery using the same. Examples of the ion conductor include Li3InCl6, Li3YCl6, and lithium fluoride (LiF). A stack pressure of a few MPa suppresses void formation during stripping. The solid electrolyte may be a glass ceramic obtained by partially crystallizing a glass. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. Heat treatment at 250 degrees C for 2 hours to 12 hours gives a trigonal phase with a conductivity of 0.84 mS/cm or more. Atomic layer deposition of a thin nitride or oxide protective layer on the lithium metal is one option. The metal halide particles have a median diameter D50 of 0.9 micrometers to 9 micrometers and are mixed with the positive electrode active material without a coating. An all-solid-state battery with an electrolyte layer of the solid electrolyte having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The halide phase is free of a LiBr secondary phase and has a crystallite size of 30 nm to 300 nm. The close-packed anion sublattice gives a low activation energy and improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: a trigonal crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Y(1-z)Ti(z)Br6; and a close-packed bromide anion sublattice in which yttrium and titanium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 130 degrees C to 370 degrees C, and wherein 0 <= z <= 0.8, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.48 mS/cm or more.

title: Sulfide ceramic ion conductor having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: A sulfide ceramic ion conductor comprises a glass phase of Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20 and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated therein. An all-solid-state battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and a ceramic ion conductor layer disposed therebetween is also provided. The ceramic ion conductor may comprise Li7P3S11, argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and beta-Li3PS4. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is Li7P3S11, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. The suspension route avoids long milling and gives a homogeneous powder. The vitreous precursor is obtained by melt quenching or mechanical amorphization and has a glass transition temperature of 180 degrees C to 230 degrees C. In an embodiment the ceramic ion conductor layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. An activation energy of 0.25 eV or less and a conductivity of 2.2 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C are obtained. The material conducts lithium ions and is used in an all-solid-state battery. The glassy matrix absorbs volume change of the electrode and improves the ionic conductivity of the cell.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.2 mS/cm or more, and wherein the content of Li2O is 1.6 mol% to 32 mol%, and wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment time of 0.1 hours to 8 hours.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a stainless steel current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A battery module with a restraining member that maintains a stack pressure of 500 kPa or more during cycling is described. The separator layer is a sheet of 100 micrometers thickness transferred from a release film by pressing. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 500 kPa. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 25 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 100 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by polytetrafluoroethylene. A lithium battery module comprising the laminate and a stainless steel current collector is also provided. An insulating resin frame surrounds the electrode layers and is cured at 25 degrees C after lamination. The bipolar stacking of 4 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing an electrode laminate for a battery, comprising: forming a positive electrode layer comprising lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide on a current collector; placing an electrolyte sheet having a thickness of 100 micrometers on the positive electrode layer; placing a negative electrode layer on the electrolyte sheet; and pressing the laminate by uniaxial pressing at 500 MPa and 25 degrees C.

title: Potentiometric oxygen sensor having an auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting oxygen comprises a yttria-stabilized zirconia ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The oxygen sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 700 degrees C. A solid electrolyte based sensor does not require a liquid electrolyte and operates at high temperature. The auxiliary electrode of sodium nitrite makes the sensor selective to oxygen against interfering gases. The auxiliary electrode comprises sodium nitrite and is in contact with both the ceramic and the gas. The sensor shows a response time of 10 seconds to a step change of oxygen concentration at 700 degrees C. A heater pattern of platinum is embedded in an alumina layer laminated to the ceramic to keep the sensor at 700 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A mixed potential type gas sensor comprising a zirconia ceramic, a first electrode comprising a metal oxide, and a second electrode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite, wherein a potential difference between the first electrode and the second electrode depends on a concentration of oxygen.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 100 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V. silica nanoparticles with a diameter of 10 nm to 50 nm are dispersed in the polymer in an amount of 5 wt% to 15 wt%. The 100 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The lithium salt is lithium perchlorate and the membrane has a thickness of 100 micrometers. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a thermally crosslinked network of polyvinylidene fluoride-hexafluoropropylene and lithium perchlorate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 100 micrometers or less.

title: Liquid-phase synthesis of a sulfide ceramic ion conductor using acetonitrile
abstract: A solution-based process for preparing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor powder from a suspension in an organic solvent is provided. The Li6PS5Cl and LLZO material is used in a solid-state battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. After drying, the residual solvent content is 0.3 wt% or less and the carbon content is 0.5 wt% or less. A high-voltage stable phosphate oxide may form part of the positive electrode mixture. A protective layer of LiPON or lithium fluoride may be formed on the lithium metal by sputtering. Mechanical mixing by ball milling under an inert atmosphere is applied to the raw material mixture. Specific examples are Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl and Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO). The dissolution of P2S5 in the solvent is followed by precipitation of a complex that contains one to three solvent molecules per formula unit. A halide coating layer may be used together with the ceramic ion conductor to improve the cycle life of the solid-state battery. The suspension concentration is 10 wt%, the reaction temperature is 40 degrees C, and the drying temperature is 180 degrees C. Because the raw materials react in the liquid phase, the method is scalable and gives a powder with improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A method for producing a sulfide ceramic ion conductor, the method comprising: dispersing Li2S and P2S5 in acetonitrile to form a suspension; reacting the suspension at 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C with stirring to form a solvate complex precipitate; removing the solvent at 140 degrees C to 220 degrees C under reduced pressure; and heat-treating the dried precipitate at 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C, wherein the ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C is 1.5 mS/cm or more, and wherein the solid concentration of the suspension is 5 wt% to 20 wt%, and wherein the reaction temperature is 25 degrees C to 60 degrees C.

title: Solid-state battery cell with an edge sealing portion and battery module including the same
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 300 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The cell shows a capacity retention of 90% or more after 300 cycles under a stack pressure of 300 kPa. The lithium iron phosphate electrode layer pressed at 60 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 300 MPa. The restraining member comprises end plates and bolts that apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa through an elastic sheet. The bipolar stacking of 8 cells raises the voltage of the battery without external wiring. The edge of the 30 micrometer separator layer extends beyond the positive electrode layer by 0.5 mm to 2 mm to prevent contact with the negative electrode.
first_claim: 1. A battery module comprising a laminated cell, a pair of end plates, an elastic sheet disposed between the cell and one of the end plates, and bolts connecting the end plates, wherein the end plates apply a stack pressure of 300 kPa or more to the cell.

title: Composition for a polymer electrolyte comprising a crosslinkable monomer and a lithium salt
abstract: A polymer electrolyte membrane containing titania nanoparticles that disrupt the crystallinity of the polymer is described. The polymer matrix is polyacrylonitrile and the ethylene oxide to lithium molar ratio is 12:1. The semi-interpenetrating network improves the mechanical strength while keeping the conductivity at 0.5 mS/cm. The semi-interpenetrating network is formed by irradiating the composition with ultraviolet light for 1 minute to 10 minutes. A lithium metal battery with the polymer electrolyte and a lithium foil of 50 micrometers is also provided. The 30 micrometer membrane is flexible and suitable for a pouch cell. The polymer electrolyte shows an ionic conductivity of 0.5 mS/cm at 40 degrees C and an electrochemical window of 4.5 V.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a semi-interpenetrating network of polyacrylonitrile and lithium hexafluorophosphate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 30 micrometers or less.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a lithium sulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The confinement of lithium sulfide in the ketjen black suppresses the shuttle effect and improves the cycle life to 100 cycles. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the lithium sulfide cathode. The lithium sulfide is melt-diffused into ketjen black at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The cathode delivering 600 mAh/g is assembled into a lithium battery with a lithium metal foil. The composite shows a capacity of 600 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The carbon coating on the lithium sulfide composite has a thickness of 5 nm to 30 nm and is formed by chemical vapor deposition of acetylene.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Tin-substituted sulfide ceramic ion conductor with suppressed hydrogen sulfide generation and production method thereof
abstract: A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor comprises a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element. The substitution amount is 5 mol%, the heat treatment temperature is 450 degrees C, and the conductivity is 1 mS/cm or more. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11. The lanthanum zirconium garnet may be sintered at 1150 degrees C using a sintering aid. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. The material comprises argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl and Li7P3S11, and the H2S generation measured in a 1 L sealed chamber at 25 degrees C is 20 cm3/g or less. The ceramic ion conductor is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state lithium battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The suppressed hydrolysis allows the sulfide to be handled in a dry room instead of a glove box, improving the grain boundary resistance.
first_claim: 1. A moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a lithium phosphosulfide phase in which part of the phosphorus or sulfur is substituted by tin; and a surface region enriched in a soft-acid element, wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a tin substitution amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, and wherein the conductivity retention after exposure to air having a dew point of -40 degrees C for 6 hours is 80% or more, and wherein the moisture-resistant sulfide ceramic ion conductor has a heat treatment temperature of 400 degrees C to 500 degrees C.

title: Sulfur-carbon composite positive electrode active material for a lithium-sulfur battery and method of preparing the same
abstract: Provided is a core-shell cathode particle having a iron sulfide core and a conductive carbon shell. The positive electrode is used in a lithium secondary battery with a loading of 3 mg/cm2. The active material iron sulfide is combined with ketjen black and undergoes a conversion or intercalation reaction with lithium. The polar additive adsorbs polysulfides and improves the capacity retention to 85%. The carbon coating improves the electronic conductivity of the iron sulfide cathode. The iron sulfide is melt-diffused into ketjen black at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. The composite shows a capacity of 1400 mAh/g at 0.2 C and a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising iron sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Conductive polymer dispersion for a solid electrolytic capacitor and capacitor using the same
abstract: A hybrid capacitor combining a conductive polymer layer and an electrolytic solution is described. A solid electrolyte of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) replaces the liquid electrolyte of a conventional electrolytic capacitor. A carbon layer and a silver paste layer are formed on the poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer to serve as the cathode lead-out. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) is doped with polystyrene sulfonate and has a particle size of 20 nm to 100 nm in the dispersion. The poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) layer lowers the equivalent series resistance to 10 milliohms compared with manganese dioxide. A capacitance of 330 microfarads is obtained in a case size of 7.3 mm by 4.3 mm. The dispersion of poly(3,4-ethylenedioxythiophene) gives a uniform polymer layer and a high capacitance appearance rate for the 330 microfarad rating.
first_claim: 1. A multilayer solid electrolytic capacitor comprising a plurality of capacitor elements stacked and electrically connected in parallel, each capacitor element comprising a niobium anode body, a dielectric layer, and a conductive polymer layer, and a resin encapsulation, wherein the capacitor has a rated voltage of 16 V.

title: Polymer electrolyte membrane with silica nanoparticles and battery including the same
abstract: Described is a free-standing polymer electrolyte film of 30 micrometers thickness for a lithium battery. A lithium secondary battery comprising the polymer electrolyte, a positive electrode, and a lithium metal or graphite negative electrode is also provided. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. The polymer electrolyte is laminated with a thin ceramic ion conductor layer to block dendrites. The cell with the polymer electrolyte retains 85% of its capacity after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The electrolyte is polymerized in situ at 40 degrees C after the cell is assembled, so that the contact with the electrodes is intimate. The silica nanoparticles improve the conductivity by disrupting the crystallinity of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate. The plasticizer tetraethylene glycol dimethyl ether enables operation of the polymer electrolyte cell at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A lithium secondary battery comprising a positive electrode, a negative electrode, and a polymer electrolyte disposed therebetween, wherein the polymer electrolyte comprises a UV-crosslinked network of poly(ethylene glycol) diacrylate and lithium hexafluorophosphate, and wherein the polymer electrolyte has a thickness of 30 micrometers or less.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at a concentration of 1.0 M and a film-forming additive. The additive is decomposed to form a solid electrolyte interphase that is stable at 60 degrees C. The additive vinylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The additive vinylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The 1.0 M electrolyte has an ionic conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C and a viscosity of 4 cP or less. The electrolyte further contains a fluorinated ether as a co-solvent to improve the oxidation stability at 4.5 V. The electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide at 1.0 M is used in a lithium secondary battery charged to 4.5 V. The 1.0 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising propylene carbonate and dimethyl carbonate; and vinylene carbonate in an amount of 1 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Multilayer ceramic gas sensor element and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: An electrochemical gas sensor for detecting ammonia comprises a yttria-stabilized zirconia ceramic, a sensing electrode comprising gold, and a reference electrode exposed to a reference gas. The sensor detects ammonia with high selectivity and a response time of 10 seconds. The solid electrolyte of yttria-stabilized zirconia conducts ions between the sensing electrode and the reference electrode. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 300 degrees C. The sensing electrode comprises gold and a metal oxide and is printed on the ceramic and fired at 1000 degrees C. The sensor element is sealed in a metal housing with a gas inlet protected by a double cover. The ammonia sensor can be used for combustion control and emission monitoring at 300 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising sodium nitrite in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects ammonia.

title: Sulfide ion-conductive solid having a glassy matrix and precipitated crystal phase
abstract: This disclosure concerns a Li2S-P2S5 glass of 70:30 composition that is converted by quenching and reheating into a crystallized conductor. The powder may be formed into a free-standing sheet using a fibrillated PTFE binder without a solvent. Roll-pressing the powder with PTFE fibrils forms the separator layer. The ion-conductive solid can be used as an interlayer that prevents direct contact between the sulfide layer and the electrode of the all-solid-state lithium battery. The disclosure further provides an all-solid-state lithium battery comprising the ion-conductive solid and a lithium metal anode pressed at 2 MPa to 10 MPa. The crystal phase precipitated in the glass is Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal, and a Li4P2S6 phase formed by devitrification is 5% or less. An all-solid-state lithium battery with an electrolyte layer of the ion-conductive solid having a thickness of 20 micrometers to 100 micrometers and the material in the positive electrode layer is also provided. The crystallized glass has an ionic conductivity of 1.8 mS/cm at 25 degrees C and a degree of crystallinity of 80%. Li2S and P2S5 in the glass are in a molar ratio of 70:30, and the precipitated crystal phase is metastable at room temperature. The crystallized glass combines the deformability of a vitreous phase with the high conductivity of the crystal phase, improving the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 70:30; and a Li10GeP2S12-type tetragonal crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a heat treatment time of 0.5 hours to 4 hours, and wherein the sulfide ion-conductive solid has a crystallization heat treatment temperature of 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 60% to 95%.

title: Electrode for a solid-state battery with a copper current collector and a primer layer
abstract: A pressure jig that applies a uniform stack pressure of 300 kPa to a laminated cell and a method of using the jig are provided. The restraining member keeps the laminate of 8 cells under pressure for the life of the module. The module with 8 stacked cells has a voltage of 8 times the cell voltage and an energy density of 350 Wh/L. The laminate is pressed by cold isostatic pressing at 300 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified. The battery is a lithium battery in which the negative electrode layer comprises graphite, silicon, or lithium metal. The cold isostatic pressing step at 300 MPa improves the contact between the layers and lowers the resistance of the cell. The positive electrode layer comprises lithium iron phosphate, a conductive agent, and a binder, and has a thickness of 20 micrometers to 150 micrometers.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 300 kPa or more.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: A solid oxide fuel cell includes a porous nickel-cermet anode support, a dense electrolyte layer comprising gadolinium-doped ceria with a thickness of 15 micrometers or less, a diffusion barrier layer of doped ceria, and a perovskite cathode. A 15 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the gadolinium-doped ceria cell. The cell operates at 600 to 750 degrees C with a power density of 1.5 W/cm2 and shows thermal cycling durability of 200 cycles. The lanthanum strontium manganite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 600 to 750 degrees C. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 600 to 750 degrees C. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified.
first_claim: 1. A method of manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell, comprising: tape casting an electrolyte green sheet comprising gadolinium-doped ceria; laminating the green sheet on an anode support green body; co-sintering the laminate at 1300 to 1400 degrees C; and forming a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite on the sintered electrolyte.

title: Nickel-rich cathode material coated with Li2ZrO3 and method for producing the same
abstract: Described is a cathode particle coated with a nanometer-thick Li2ZrO3 shell that lowers the interfacial resistance. The glass ceramic phase improves the contact between ion-conductive solid particles during pressing. The core particles have an average diameter of 3 micrometers to 12 micrometers and the coverage of the shell is 85%. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The disclosure is applicable to Li6PS5X Li6PS5Cl, lithium niobate (LiNbO3), and Li3InCl6. The core particles have a median diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and nickel content of 60 mol% or more. The core particles are secondary particles of a layered oxide in which nickel accounts for 60 mol% or more of the transition metals. An LLZO garnet sintered with a lithium borate aid is one example of a dense oxide layer. Also described is an all-solid-state battery comprising the ion-conductive solid in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The lithium zirconate shell lowers the oxidative decomposition of the sulfide at the cathode interface, improving the electrochemical window and interfacial resistance.
first_claim: 1. A positive electrode active material for a battery comprising a sulfide ion-conductive solid, comprising: core particles comprising a layered lithium nickel transition metal oxide; and a coating layer disposed on a surface of the core particles and comprising an amorphous lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), wherein the average thickness of the coating layer is 6 nm to 30 nm, and wherein the reduction of interfacial resistance relative to uncoated particles is 20% or more, and wherein the positive electrode active material has a heat treatment temperature of 350 degrees C to 450 degrees C.

title: Composite cathode comprising lithium sulfide and graphene and lithium secondary battery
abstract: A positive electrode slurry containing the sulfide active material, graphene, and polyvinylidene fluoride is described. The lithium sulfide cathode material is inexpensive and environmentally benign. The lithium sulfide particles have a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers and are mixed with graphene by ball milling. The cathode delivers an initial capacity of 1200 mAh/g and retains 80% of the capacity after 500 cycles at 0.5 C. The lithium sulfide is melt-diffused into graphene at 155 degrees C, and the composite contains 60 wt% to 80 wt% of the active material. A lithium-sulfur battery with the lithium sulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The sulfur loading of 2 mg/cm2 gives a high energy density of the lithium-sulfur battery. A solid electrolyte interphase is formed on the lithium metal negative electrode during the first cycles.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a positive electrode active material, comprising: mixing lithium sulfide with graphene; heating the mixture at 150 to 160 degrees C to diffuse the lithium sulfide into the carbon; and coating the composite with carbon by chemical vapor deposition.

title: Sulfide solid electrolyte having argyrodite structure with controlled halogen occupancy and method for preparing the same
abstract: This disclosure provides an argyrodite solid electrolyte whose anion sublattice is partially disordered by mixed chlorine-bromine substitution. In an all-solid-state battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the electrochemical window. The halogen-rich composition keeps the argyrodite phase as the main crystal phase and suppresses the precipitation of lithium halide impurity. A niobate-coated positive electrode active material may be included in the electrode mixture. An ionic conductivity of 8.4 mS/cm or more at 25 degrees C is obtained when x satisfies 0.4 to 0.85. Examples of the ion conductor include Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS) and beta-Li3PS4. A gallium-doped garnet sintered body is one option for the oxide component. Compared with Li6PS5Cl, the bromine-substituted argyrodite shows a higher conductivity and better electrochemical window.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide solid electrolyte, comprising: a crystal phase having an argyrodite crystal structure; and a composition represented by Li(6-x)PS(5-x)Cl(1+x), wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a peak intensity ratio IA/IB of 0.12 or less, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has a firing temperature of 470 degrees C to 570 degrees C, and wherein the sulfide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 8.4 mS/cm or more.

title: Electrolyte additive for forming a stable passivation film on a silicon negative electrode
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte containing a fluorinated carbonate solvent for a lithium battery charged to 4.5 V is provided. The additive vinylene carbonate forms a passivation film on the positive electrode that suppresses electrolyte oxidation at 4.5 V. The additive vinylene carbonate decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. With 0.5 wt% of vinylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 500 cycles is 85% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The 1.5 M lithium tetrafluoroborate solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. A pouch type lithium ion battery comprising a nickel-rich positive electrode, a graphite negative electrode, and the electrolyte is also provided. The additive vinylene carbonate reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium tetrafluoroborate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.5 M and adding vinylene carbonate in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Niobium-doped garnet ion-conductive solid sintered body with high relative density and method for producing the same
abstract: Disclosed is a method for sintering a niobium-doped Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet to a relative density of 91% or more while suppressing lithium volatilization. The ion-conductive solid is applied as the electrolyte of a solid-state battery whose positive electrode layer comprises a layered lithium transition metal oxide. The garnet grains are bonded through a thin lithium borate or lithium fluoride phase at the grain boundaries. The ion-conductive solid may comprise Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3), and Li1.3Al0.3Ti1.7(PO4)3 (LATP). The total ionic conductivity is 0.84 mS/cm or more and the grain boundary resistance is 20% or less of the total resistance. An alloy-forming additive improves the Coulombic efficiency of plating and stripping. The low grain boundary resistance results in improved high-voltage stability and grain boundary resistance compared with a garnet sintered without the aid.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)Nb(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Li2CO3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.48 mS/cm or more.

title: Zirconium-substituted lithium scandium chloride solid electrolyte with orthorhombic structure for lithium battery
abstract: Provided is an orthorhombic halide solid electrolyte in which scandium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites of a close-packed chloride lattice. A core-shell cathode particle with a nanometer-thick LiNbO3 coating of high coverage is used on the positive electrode side. The material comprises lithium fluoride (LiF), Li3YCl6, and argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and the hexachloride framework tolerates partial substitution by scandium or a rare earth element. Heat treatment at 300 degrees C for 2 hours to 12 hours gives an orthorhombic phase with a conductivity of 1.47 mS/cm or more. Also described is a lithium secondary battery comprising the solid electrolyte in the electrode mixture and in the electrolyte layer. The zirconium substitution in an amount z of 0.02 to 0.25 introduces lithium vacancies that raise the ionic conductivity of the metal halide. The material is also used as a coating layer on core particles of a nickel-rich positive electrode active material, with a coverage of 85% or more and a thickness of 5 nm to 20 nm. A silver or indium additive at the negative electrode interface is one option for dendrite suppression. A battery using the halide in the positive electrode mixture shows improved electrochemical window and rate capability.
first_claim: 1. A halide solid electrolyte, comprising: an orthorhombic crystal phase of a metal halide represented by Li(3-z)Sc(1-z)Zr(z)Cl6; and a close-packed chloride anion sublattice in which scandium and zirconium occupy octahedral sites, wherein the halide solid electrolyte has a heat treatment temperature of 250 degrees C to 350 degrees C, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an oxidation stability limit versus Li/Li+ of 4.1 V or more, and wherein the halide solid electrolyte has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 1.47 mS/cm or more.

assignee_raw: QILUNHE NEW ENERGY TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
title: Pressure jig for a laminated battery cell and method of applying stack pressure of 600 kPa
abstract: Described is a dry electrode process in which an active material, a conductive agent, and polytetrafluoroethylene are mixed without a solvent and formed into a film. The lithium nickel cobalt manganese oxide electrode layer pressed at 120 degrees C keeps its contact during cycling. The separator layer is a solid electrolyte layer of 20 micrometers comprising sulfide particles bonded by polytetrafluoroethylene. The pressure jig keeps the stack pressure of 600 kPa uniform and improves the cycle life. The separator layer transferred by pressing has a thickness variation of 5% or less at 20 micrometers. The current collector is a copper foil of 10 micrometers to 20 micrometers thickness with a carbon primer layer. The negative electrode layer of the lithium battery comprises graphite and is pressed at 600 MPa. The laminate is pressed by warm isostatic pressing at 600 MPa so that the interfaces between the layers are densified.
first_claim: 1. A stacked battery comprising: a plurality of unit cells each comprising a positive electrode layer, a separator layer, and a negative electrode layer; and bipolar current collectors each comprising a copper foil and disposed between adjacent unit cells, wherein the unit cells are stacked in series and the stack is pressed at 600 kPa or more.

title: Solid-state lithium cell with improved plating and stripping stability under stack pressure
abstract: The present disclosure relates to the suppression of lithium filament growth in a solid-state cell by an additive that promotes uniform plating and stripping. In an embodiment the solid electrolyte layer comprises a glass ceramic having a crystallinity of 50% to 90%. The magnesium additive is dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer by pressing a mixed powder layer. The plating overpotential is 30 mV or less and the Coulombic efficiency is 99.5% after 100 cycles. A powder-to-film process with heated rollers is one option for forming the layer. The material may be used together with a halogen-substituted argyrodite-type having an impurity-free X-ray pattern. In a solid-state lithium battery the solid electrolyte forms the electrolyte layer and improves the moisture stability. The mixture for the solid electrolyte is subjected to ball milling in a planetary mill and then heat-treated. The material comprises Li7P3S11, argyrodite-type Li6PS5Cl, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS), and the electronic conductivity of the solid electrolyte layer is 1 x 10^-9 S/cm or less to prevent lithium deposition inside the layer. The additive is useful for an anode-free configuration, with improved moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A negative electrode structure for a battery comprising a solid electrolyte, comprising: a lithium metal layer; a solid electrolyte layer; and an additive comprising magnesium dispersed at the interface between the lithium metal layer and the solid electrolyte layer to form uniform nucleation sites, wherein the negative electrode structure has a stack pressure of 1 MPa to 4 MPa, and wherein the negative electrode structure has a Coulombic efficiency of 99% or more, and wherein the content of the magnesium additive is 0.2 wt% to 1 wt%.

title: Lithium secondary battery with reduced gas generation during high temperature storage
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium hexafluorophosphate at a concentration of 1.2 M and a film-forming additive. With 0.5 wt% of tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 92% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is compatible with a silicon-containing negative electrode. The capacity retention of 92% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite. The electrolyte containing lithium hexafluorophosphate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. The additive tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described. The solid electrolyte interphase formed by the additive has a thickness of 10 nm to 50 nm and contains lithium fluoride and lithium carbonate.
first_claim: 1. A method of preparing a non-aqueous electrolyte, comprising dissolving lithium hexafluorophosphate in a mixed solvent of ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate to a concentration of 1.2 M and adding tris(trimethylsilyl) phosphite in an amount of 0.5 wt%.

title: Crystallized sulfide crystallized glass ion conductor containing a Li7P3S11 phase and production method thereof
abstract: A glassy sulfide ceramic ion conductor with a precipitated crystal phase and a method for its heat treatment are provided. Crystallization is performed at 260 degrees C to 340 degrees C for 0.5 hours to 12 hours, which precipitates a Li7P3S11 phase with a crystallite size of 20 nm to 200 nm. Ball milling of the raw materials for the Li7P3S11, Li6PS5Cl, and LGPS material in a sealed pot is performed prior to firing. The ceramic ion conductor is preferably Li7P3S11, argyrodite Li6PS5Cl, and Li10GeP2S12 (LGPS). The precursor may be precipitated from ethyl acetate and dried before use. The glass is heat-treated above its crystallization temperature so that a tetragonal or Li7P3S11 phase precipitates uniformly. The powder has a median diameter D50 of 1.5 micrometers and gives a pellet conductivity of 4 mS/cm after pressing at 360 MPa. A solution-based process with stirring and filtration may be used to obtain the sulfide precursor. The Li7P3S11, Li6PS5Cl, and LGPS material is used in a lithium secondary battery together with a positive electrode active material and a negative electrode. The P2O5 addition suppresses devitrification to low-conductivity phases and improves the moisture stability.
first_claim: 1. A sulfide ceramic ion conductor, comprising: a glass phase comprising Li2S and P2S5 in a molar ratio of 80:20; and a Li7P3S11 crystal phase precipitated in the glass phase, wherein the sulfide ceramic ion conductor has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 2.8 mS/cm or more, and wherein the degree of crystallinity is 60% to 95%, and wherein the content of P2O5 is 4 mol% to 16 mol%.

title: Multilayer ceramic gas sensor element and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: An amperometric sensor in which ammonia is pumped through a diffusion barrier by an oxide ion conducting ceramic is provided. The sensor is stable within 5% over 1000 hours at 700 degrees C. The diffusion barrier is a porous ceramic with a pore size of 1 micrometer to 10 micrometers that limits the gas flux. The reference electrode is exposed to atmospheric air through a channel in the laminated body. The multilayer structure with the lanthanum fluoride ceramic allows mass production by co-firing. The built-in heater shortens the warm-up time of the sensor to 700 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A potentiometric gas sensor comprising an ion conducting ceramic, a sensing electrode, a reference electrode, and an auxiliary electrode comprising lithium carbonate in contact with the sensing electrode and the ceramic, wherein the sensor detects ammonia.

title: Oxidation-resistant oxide solid electrolyte and high-voltage lithium battery
abstract: Described is an oxide solid electrolyte whose decomposition current at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less, enabling operation with a 5 V class cathode. Part of the titanium in the titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase is substituted by hafnium in an amount of 2.5 mol% to 10 mol%, which raises the anodic stability. The raw materials of the solid electrolyte are mixed by ball milling for 4 hours to 40 hours before heat treatment. A mixed-halide chloride-bromide conductor may be combined with the material. A protected lithium metal negative electrode is one example of the counter electrode. The oxide has an ionic conductivity of 0.7 mS/cm and an electrochemical window of 1.8 V to 5.2 V. The material comprises Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO), and the decomposition current density at 5 V is 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less. An all-solid-state battery comprising the LLZO and LLTO material and a method for manufacturing the same are also provided. The disclosure is applicable to Li7La3Zr2O12 garnet (LLZO) and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). The oxide solid electrolyte enables the use of a 5 V class cathode and improves the ionic conductivity.
first_claim: 1. An oxide solid electrolyte, comprising: a titanium-free NASICON-type oxide phase in which part of the titanium is substituted by hafnium; and an oxidation-resistant surface region having a thickness of 5 nm to 50 nm, wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a decomposition current density at 5 V of 20 microamperes per square centimeter or less, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has a capacity retention after 200 cycles of 83% or more, and wherein the oxide solid electrolyte has an oxidation potential versus Li/Li+ of 4.9 V or more.

title: Positive electrode for a lithium-sulfur battery with a high sulfur loading and method of manufacturing the same
abstract: A positive electrode with a sulfur loading of 5 mg/cm2 and a method of manufacturing the same are provided. In an embodiment the cathode is pressed against a sulfide solid electrolyte layer instead of a separator. A lithium-sulfur battery with the lithium sulfide cathode, a lithium metal negative electrode, and an ether electrolyte is also described. The capacity retention after 200 cycles is 90% at 25 degrees C. The initial capacity of 1400 mAh/g is retained with a Coulombic efficiency of 98% or more. The ketjen black framework keeps the electrode conductive during the volume change of lithium sulfide. A separator coated with ketjen black traps the polysulfides on the cathode side. The cathode with a loading of 5 mg/cm2 is combined with a lithium metal negative electrode and an ether-based electrolyte containing lithium nitrate.
first_claim: 1. A core-shell particle for a positive electrode, comprising a core comprising lithium sulfide and a shell comprising a conductive carbon, wherein the particle has a median diameter of 1 micrometer to 5 micrometers.

title: Polymer electrolyte with a plasticizer for room temperature operation of a lithium battery
abstract: The present disclosure relates to a gel polymer electrolyte containing lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide for a lithium secondary battery and to a method of forming it in situ inside the cell. The plasticizer an ionic liquid is added in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt% to lower the glass transition temperature of the polymer. A lithium secondary battery using the electrolyte shows a capacity retention of 85% after 200 cycles at 40 degrees C. The membrane of 50 micrometers is formed by casting a solution of polyacrylonitrile and the salt in acetonitrile and drying under vacuum. The in situ polymerization gives low interfacial resistance with the electrodes and a thickness of 50 micrometers. The ethylene oxide to lithium ratio of 8:1 balances conductivity and mechanical strength. The membrane has a tensile strength of 2 MPa or more and a conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm at 40 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A polymer electrolyte membrane comprising: a polymer matrix comprising polyacrylonitrile; a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; and a plasticizer comprising an ionic liquid in an amount of 10 wt% to 40 wt%, wherein the membrane has an ionic conductivity of 0.1 mS/cm or more at 40 degrees C.

title: Planar solid oxide fuel cell stack with metal interconnects and a glass sealant
abstract: Provided is an oxygen-ion conducting ceramic electrolyte for a fuel cell that operates at 500 to 650 degrees C with a lanthanum strontium manganite cathode. The solid electrolyte of yttria-stabilized zirconia is a dense ceramic of 97% density that blocks electrons and gas while conducting oxide ions. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 500 to 650 degrees C. The yttria-stabilized zirconia electrolyte of 97% density blocks gas crossover and raises the open circuit voltage. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 500 to 650 degrees C. The stack shows stable operation over 50 thermal cycles without gas leakage at 500 to 650 degrees C. The cathode comprises lanthanum strontium manganite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising yttria-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 97% or more.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: An electrolyte for a lithium ion battery operable at -20 degrees C and a method of preparing it are described. With 0.5 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate, the capacity retention after 300 cycles is 90% and the gas generation is reduced by 40%. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. A lithium ion battery containing the electrolyte with 0.5 wt% of fluoroethylene carbonate is also described. The additive fluoroethylene carbonate is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% based on the total weight of the electrolyte. The stable passivation film formed by fluoroethylene carbonate suppresses the consumption of the electrolyte and improves the cycle life to 300 cycles. The capacity retention of 90% after 300 cycles is higher than that of an electrolyte without fluoroethylene carbonate.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and ethyl methyl carbonate; and fluoroethylene carbonate in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery comprises lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide dissolved in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate and 1,3-propane sultone as an additive in an amount of 0.5 wt%. A second additive selected from 1,3-propane sultone and succinonitrile is added in an amount of 0.5 wt% to suppress the dissolution of transition metals from the positive electrode. The additive 1,3-propane sultone reduces gas generation during storage at 60 degrees C and improves safety. The additive 1,3-propane sultone decomposes on the negative electrode during the first charge and forms a passivation film rich in lithium fluoride. The 1.2 M lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide solution in ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate keeps a conductivity of 8 mS/cm or more. The cell charged to 4.5 V retains 85% of its capacity after 500 cycles. The disclosure further provides a lithium ion battery in which the electrolyte contains the additive combination.
first_claim: 1. A non-aqueous electrolyte solution for a lithium secondary battery, comprising: a lithium salt comprising lithium bis(fluorosulfonyl)imide; a non-aqueous solvent comprising ethylene carbonate and diethyl carbonate; and 1,3-propane sultone in an amount of 0.5 wt% to 5 wt% based on a total weight of the electrolyte solution.

title: Garnet-type Li7La3Zr2O12 ion-conductive solid with reduced grain boundary resistance
abstract: A garnet ion-conductive solid sintered body having an average grain size of 2 micrometers and a low grain boundary resistance is provided. The dopant tungsten occupies the zirconium or lithium site in an amount v of 0.25 to 0.6, which stabilizes the cubic garnet phase. Ball milling with zirconia balls at 300 rpm to 600 rpm is used to obtain an amorphous precursor. Specific examples are lithium zirconate (Li2ZrO3) and Li0.33La0.56TiO3 (LLTO). A solvent-free sheet formed by roll-pressing may be laminated onto the electrode. The sintered body consists of garnet grains having an average grain size of 0.8 micrometers to 6 micrometers and a tetragonal garnet phase of 3% or less. The grain size is 0.8 micrometers to 6 micrometers and the relative density is 92% or more after sintering at 1150 degrees C to 1300 degrees C. A metal halide synthesized by a water-mediated route can be mixed with the material. A solid-state lithium battery comprising a positive electrode layer, a negative electrode layer, and an ion-conductive solid layer disposed therebetween is also provided. Because lithium volatilization is suppressed, the cubic phase is retained and the grain boundary resistance is improved.
first_claim: 1. A garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid, comprising: a sintered body of a cubic garnet phase represented by Li(7-v)La3Zr(2-v)W(v)O12; and a sintering aid comprising Al2O3 present at grain boundaries, wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has a relative density of 87% or more, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an average grain size of 0.2 micrometers to 12 micrometers, and wherein the garnet-type oxide ion-conductive solid has an ionic conductivity at 25 degrees C of 0.48 mS/cm or more.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 650 to 800 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: A method for manufacturing a solid oxide fuel cell by tape casting a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte green sheet and laminating it on an anode support green body is provided. The interconnect is a ferritic stainless steel plate coated with a manganese cobalt spinel to suppress chromium evaporation at 650 to 800 degrees C. The glass sealant has a thermal expansion coefficient matched to the scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte and seals the fuel and air compartments. The scandia-stabilized zirconia solid electrolyte is co-sintered with the anode support at 1300 to 1400 degrees C. A power density of 1.5 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 650 to 800 degrees C operating range. The reversible cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. The cell can be operated at 650 to 800 degrees C, which allows the use of metal interconnects.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising lanthanum strontium manganite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Solid oxide electrolysis cell and reversible fuel cell having a thin dense electrolyte
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 3 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. A power density of 1.2 W/cm2 at 0.7 V is obtained at the upper end of the 500 to 650 degrees C operating range. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite cell. The cathode comprises barium strontium cobalt ferrite and is sintered at 1000 to 1100 degrees C after the electrolyte is densified. Hydrogen or reformed natural gas is supplied to the anode and air is supplied to the barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode at 500 to 650 degrees C. The barium strontium cobalt ferrite cathode gives a low polarization resistance at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A solid oxide fuel cell comprising: a porous anode support comprising nickel and a ceramic; an electrolyte layer disposed on the anode support and comprising lanthanum strontium gallate magnesite, the electrolyte layer having a thickness of 3 micrometers or less; a barrier layer comprising doped ceria disposed on the electrolyte layer; and a cathode comprising barium strontium cobalt ferrite disposed on the barrier layer.

title: Electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell operable at 500 to 650 degrees C and fuel cell system
abstract: Described is an electrolyte-supported solid oxide fuel cell with a 8 micrometer thick ceramic electrolyte. The anode support contains nickel oxide and scandia-stabilized zirconia in a weight ratio of 60:40 and has a porosity of 30% to 40% after reduction. The reversible cell with a scandia-stabilized zirconia electrolyte improves the round trip efficiency of hydrogen production and power generation. A 8 micrometer solid electrolyte reduces the ohmic loss of the solid oxide fuel cell. The co-sintering process at 1300 to 1400 degrees C reduces the number of firing steps and the manufacturing cost of the scandia-stabilized zirconia cell. The electrolyte layer is formed by tape casting and co-sintering at 1300 to 1400 degrees C with the anode support, which gives a relative density of 96%. The area specific resistance of the cell is 0.3 ohm cm2 or less at 500 to 650 degrees C.
first_claim: 1. A tubular solid oxide fuel cell comprising a nickel cermet anode tube, an electrolyte layer comprising scandia-stabilized zirconia formed on the anode tube, and a cathode layer, wherein the electrolyte layer has a relative density of 96% or more.

title: Non-aqueous electrolyte with a fluorinated solvent for a high voltage lithium battery
abstract: Provided is an electrolyte composition comprising lithium tetrafluoroborate at a concentration of 1.2 M and a film-forming additive. The electrolyte containing lithium tetrafluoroborate is injected into a pouch cell and the cell is formed at 0.1 C for the first cycle. A lithium secondary battery comprising the electrolyte and a silicon-containing negative electrode is also described.
